programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After the attack on Mordhaus, Dethklok is left without a manager and plagued by greedy record execs and forced to face the brutality of the slumping economy while dabbling in interior design. Will they spend everything and sign a deal that will render them powerless? Or worse, will they allow Murderface to turn the living room into an Arizona-styled sandscape?

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok joins their own Dethklok tribute band as a last ditch effort to connect with their rock and roll roots.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After a near-death experience, Dethklok realizes they would rather be sick and not know then face the brutality of going to a doctor. After home remedies including drinking bleach, Dethklok learns that their ultimate fear will be realized, one of them has a terminal illness. Meanwhile Nathan tries to brave the brutality of going to the dentist and Murderface faces the possibility of being gay after accidentally ejaculating on a doctors face. Part of Season 3.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok must experience the ultimate brutality of the Holiday season; spending time with their MOTHERS. Meanwhile Murderface ringleads the ultimate Christmas special that ends up being backed by the Christian church. And a particular ROCK AND ROLL clown makes a holiday appearance. Part of season 3.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After an onslaught of paternity suits, Skwisgaar realizes he will never change until he quits the band to find his father who abandoned him before birth.Meanwhile, Dethklok realizes they all have father abandonment issues and Murderface decides to repair the damages by appointing himself "Band Father."

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki falls head over heals for a girl he meets online. When things sour he tries to break it off and instead has to bear the brutality of being her date at her father's vegan funeral in 110 degree heat. Meanwhile Nathan experiences the brutality of dating a performance artist. And Murderface must attend a sexual harassment seminar after trying to match Skwisgaar's sexual prowess.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Murderface wants the easy life but still wants all the rewards. After the band decides to kick him out for making their jobs more difficult, Murderface realizes the EASIEST way to make BIG money is to start his own label.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Drunk driving HOVER DRUMS and causing billions in damage Pickles the drummer is thrown into rehab and his worst nightmares are realized when he is replaced- by a drum machine.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki tries to turn the life of his rock-and-roll clown friend, Dr. Rockzo, around by investing Dethklok's vacation fund. Everything goes smoothly until the media peers into Rockzo's past and discovers the clown's darkest secret.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: While Dethklok's manager, Charles Offdensen, is absent cleaning up hundreds of problems caused by the band, Dethklok double books a gig--between Syria and Israel on the same day.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Despite his bandmates' warnings, Nathan begins seriously dating one of his fans. But as the evidence of her past piles up, to prove her innocence, he follows her to the most brutal place on earth: Klokikon - the annual Dethklok fan convention filled with cosplay geeks and homosexual fan art. Meanwhile, the rest of the band starts smoking after Murderface lands the cover of Smokaroonie Aficionado.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Dethklok is accused of being racist at a huge press conference, they combat the charges by opening an Urban Youth Dethcenter. Meanwhile, Toki, after being left behind, starts a special club that promotes equality and love but excludes Murderface because he doesn't have the right look.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: With their new album finally shipping, Dethklok plans their post-release traditions of vacationing, goofing off, palling around, and prank calls. Nathan, however, can't shake the feeling that something is wrong with the record... After being humiliated by Murderface's prank calls, Skwisgaar and Toki swear revenge.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok heads to Tomahawk, Wisconsin to open a Dethfair in hopes that it will stimulate the economy they destroyed. Pickles uses this time at home to reconnect with his disapproving mother who tells him that she won't respect him until he gets a real job. Pickles decides to hang up his drumsticks and goes into an even more brutal profession: he becomes a realtor.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Tired of taking verbal abuse from his bandmate, Toki writes a tell-all book called Skwisgaar Is Ams Dick and takes over as Dethklok's lead guitarist. But can Toki handle the spotlight? Meanwhile, Nathan buys a new favorite toy for the band: a defibrillator.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After spending all their time with sluts and squandering the budget on their new record, Dethklok is shocked to find they've been assigned a new producer: A WOMAN. She sends them on a pre-writing vacation that turns out to be a brutal trip to a third world country where they're mistaken as women and captured as sex slaves.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In an effort to make friends, Toki goes to Rockaroonie Fantasy Camp - a weekend getaway to rub elbows with rock and roll royalty (but he attends as a camper.) Instead of meeting friends, he is bullied by other campers and has no one to turn to but celebrity counselor, Magnus Hammersmith; ex-Dethklok guitarist with a troubled past. With Toki - the diabetic scaredy cat - out of Mordhaus, Skwisgaar and Murderface act out and over do it with candy and scary movies.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Murderface is announced as the recipient of this year's Most Brutal Looking Musician Award, he travels to Mexico to get the best and cheapest plastic surgery possible. Meanwhile, the rest of Dethklok deal with the brutality of aging and letting themselves go.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok returns to the water to record in their new Dethsub but, plagued with the lack of women, carpel tunnel sets in from excessive masturbation. The band regresses to an animal mindset. Pickles and Nathan spend their energy crossing the workplace relationship line and competing for the only woman on the sub: their producer.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: As Dethklok hosts the most important dinner of their career, the divvying of album credits, over tagging on social networking sites, and fights over a girl come to head. Can CFO keep their issues in check? Will the record executives forgive them for the past year of mistakes? Or will it be a total, brutal disaster?

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: While the world awaits the final Dethklok performance, members of the band prepare for their post-Dethklok careers. Pickles starts a winery for the most alcoholic wine ever, Nathan and Swkisgaar look for a brand new sound that doesn't suck, and Toki works with Murderface on his campaign for congressman. Meanwhile, Salacia takes Dethklok's weakness as the opportune time to strike!

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok is notified of a looming secret that's been around for hundreds of years: the secret of the Metalocalypse. Before they can contemplate what this means, however, Nathan must give a eulogy and do the most brutal thing he has ever done: get in touch with his emotions.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.sub-title: METALOCALYPSE: the DOOMSTAR REQUIEM A KLOK OPERA
programme.desc: Will Dethklok find their lost bandmate Toki Wartooth? Find out in this hour long Rock Opera special featuring a 50 piece orchestra and special guests Mark Hamill, Malcolm McDowell, and Cannibal Corpse's George "Corpsegrinder" Fisher.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After performing a coffee jingle in the farthest reaches of the Arctic Circle to a sold-out crowd, Dethklok witnesses their French chef being chopped to pieces by the blade of their helicopter restaurant. The bad news is that Dethklok is now faced with the daunting task of cooking dinner themselves.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In an attempt to make their next album the most brutal ever, Dethklok commissions a Russian nuclear submarine to record deep in the Nordic waters. Underwater, the band copes with seasickness, whale and radar pings infecting their tracks, and loss of food and oxygen.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The band plays a song that unintentionally wakes a deadly Nordic Forest Troll. Dethklok doesn't care until they learn that the Troll is knocking out all DSL lines, making their Internet really slow. Dethklok must write the world's first Death Metal Lullaby to put the demonic beast back to sleep.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In a legendary bad move, Dethklok decides to do standup comedy. Pickles remains traumatized by a heckler while the rest of Dethklok learns that comedy is all about embracing the hate. Dethklok finds that they are very much naturals at this. The physical comedy routine they work out really kills.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Uncomfortable and embarrassed, Dethklok painfully endures while their parents are in town for a visit. The guys are at first pissed and doubtful when their parents announce the release of their "Parents of Dethklok" album, but are then impressed by the depth of their parents' anger.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Pickles reunites with his old hair band, "Snakes 'N' Barrels", which has the rest of Dethklok worried that their drummer may leave them. When the ten-years-sober "Snakes 'N' Barrels" are given experimental psychotropic drugs before their performance, the result is something beyond brutal.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok has opened up their home for their annual Dethfan Day. Dethklok continues with their "normal" everyday activities (like liver transplant surgery and scrubbing toilets) while fans are ushered around the house, guided by an animated skull and a maze of velvet rope. Dethklok finds themselves in a sticky situation when two Internet geeks threaten to bring down Dethklok with their advanced Photoshopping skills.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In a last-ditch scramble for tax breaks, Dethklok agrees to host an event with the London Philharmonic, but only under one condition: Dethklok gets to produce their own kind of laser light show. They've also taken in a distempered fat kid they found, and must juggle the responsibilities of parenting while upholding their charitable agreement.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Skwisgaar is to host the Skwisgaar Skwigelf Advanced Hand Finger Wizard Master Class Pay Per View Event, to promote the sales of a new guitar line, which includes the Skwisarmyatar, and the Antfarmatar.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok has an end of the quarter employee evaluation to find out who's been embezzling from the company. The patronizing evaluation heads off with a pep talk and a corporate video that will have audiences and Dethfans alike vying for a spot on the Dethklok payroll.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Plagued by his stupidity, Nathan Explosion embarks on the dicey journey of earning his GED.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Depressed, Dethklok is whisked away to the Mississippi Delta to "discover" the Blues.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Murderface searches for a religion after a near-death experience leaves him longing for greater meaning. He samples everything from Christianity to Satanism before finding his true church.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki tries to compensate for his adorable charm by over-brutalizing his intentions and actions.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The Tribunal commissions Dr. Rockzo, The Rock N Roll Clown, to gather information on Dethklok. Dr. Rockzo and Toki's sudden friendship has the rest of Dethklok uneasy.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok is asked to host the American Pornography Awards, but Nathan's controlling girlfriend puts a damper on the situation for the whole band.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Dethklok is given a Carte Blanche development deal, the future of silver screen entertainment rests in their hands.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In this first season finale, the Metalocalypse creeps closer to fulfillment when Dethklok executes their most brutal performance to date, and the Tribunal finally makes their move.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Since Dethklok's withdrawal from the public following the purported Dethwater Live "fan attack", the world economy teeters on the brink of disaster. Dethklok is finally lured back into the outside world with their protective "pelvic-thrust mace belts" to be a part of the world's largest public execution of criminals in recorded history.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki Wartooth is fed up playing in the shadow of Skwisgaar's lead guitar. Under the tutelage of a crusty old guitar master, Toki learns that the heart, too, has strings.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The wounded, the scared, and the disfigured unite. Meanwhile, an oblivious Dethklok spends their studio time recording onto the purest of all analog formats: water.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Fearing for their safety after a public gun mishap/bloodbath, the CFO hires look-a-likes of Dethklok to make public appearances while the band prepares for a Duncan Hills Coffee promotional event.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When promoting a new clothing line, Dethklok experiences the brutality of negative body image, dieting, and bulimia.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dr. Rockzo, the Rock n Roll Clown, gets help from Dethklok to overcome his cocaine addition and come c-c-c-clean!

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Metal meets mid-west etiquette when Pickles' brother, Seth, invites Dethklok to his Wisconsin wedding.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Pickles' popularity soars when he gets a personal P.R. agent, prompting the rest of Dethklok to form a rival P.R. firm. Meanwhile, Pickles' P.R. woman has dark, otherworldy, and religious motives behind her Evil Press Releases.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok travels to the Amazon where they learn about native brutality from the Yannemango Indians.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Nathan Explosion serves an emergency term as temporary governor for the state of Florida, sending Florida into a state of further emergency.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: William Murderface creates the "Nascar-type Theatrical Hybrid Event" and takes all creative and logistical control upon himself. Nathan and Pickles try to be supportive of their overwhelmed pal, while Skwisgaar and Toki attempt to get their driver licenses.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Nathan learns that his ex-girlfriend, Rebecca Nightrod, has already found new love while still in a coma, he decides to return to the dating scene. Unfortunately, the rest of the band makes it difficult for Nathan to make a true love connection.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The band is fed up with Offdenson knowing more than they do. They want their fifth of everything and decide to hire an efficiency expert to tighten up matters at Mordhaus and maximize their weekly allowance.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Toki gets news that his dad is dying, he's forced to travel back to his home town in Norway. The rest of the band decides to make a vacation out of it, citing "album inspiration" as their excuse to further put off working on their delayed album.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The world economy is crumbling and waiting for the next Dethklok album to stimulate it back into order. It's up to Dethklok to get the album just right and finished on time.

programme.sub-title: Robot Chicken: Star Wars Episode III
programme.desc: The Emmy Award-winning Robot Chicken returns with its third send-up of the Star Wars universe! programme.desc: Voltron engages in an old-school dance-off in "You Got Robo-Served." The secret lives of nature's most fascinating beasts are exposed in "Secrets of the Animal Kingdom." Testicles are terrorized in "Ode to the Nut Shot."

programme.title: Go For Broke
programme.desc: During WWII Lt. Michael Grayson (Van Johnson) is a newly commissioned American Army officer, who looks forward to being assigned to the 36th Texas Division. Instead, he is put in charge of Japanese-American soldiers.

programme.title: Vietnam in HD
programme.desc: Bob Clewell's helicopter crew comes under intense fire. Joe Galloway returns to Vietnam. Barry Romo throws down his medals in protest. The last American troops return home. The fall of Saigon brings the unification of Vietnam.

programme.title: Top Ten Warfare
programme.desc: Trace the development of influential tanks from the Mark I to the Sherman, Panzer, T-34 and M1 Abrams.

programme.title: Greatest Tank Battles
programme.desc: The U.S. Marine tanks played a key role in the Pacific Campaign. They fought against fanatical Japanese forces that defended the now infamous Islands of Guadalcanal, Tarawa, Saipan, Iwo Jima and Okinawa.

programme.title: Operation Barbarossa
programme.desc: Vivid colorized archival footage, this documentary chronicles Operation Barbarossa, Hitler's massive 1941 invasion of the Soviet Union, and the campaign's brutal descent into stalemate.

programme.title: Dictators Hideouts
programme.desc: Newly discovered microfilm reveals the underground headquarters beneath Ksiaz Castle, a vast complex built as a potential Nazi command center.

programme.title: Last Days of the Nazis
programme.desc: After World War II, Allied interrogations reveal Speer's ambition, Nazi youth indoctrination, mystical influences, propaganda spectacle, and Streicher's grim downfall.

programme.title: Rise of the Superbombs
programme.desc: A special examining the new era of military technology sparked by the "Mother of All Bombs," featuring rare Pentagon access and top-secret testing sites to reveal how a global arms race is transforming the power and precision of modern non-nuclear we

programme.title: Missions That Changed the War: Enola Gay
programme.desc: Theodore "Dutch" Van Kirk, navigator of the Enola Gay, the B-29 that dropped the first atomic bomb used as a weapon of war on Hiroshima, Japan, offers his first-person account of the historic mission, flown on 8/6/45.

programme.title: Missions That Changed the War: Enola Gay
programme.desc: The Enola Gay - most famous B-29 in history, dropped the first atomic bomb on Hiroshima, 8/6/45. Theodore Van Kirk - last remaining crew member, gives a first-person account of the plane, crew, target selection, & training for the historic mission.

programme.title: WWII in HD
programme.desc: The Allies are bogged down in Normandy's hedgerows in the aftermath of D-Day, while on Saipan, victory turns to horror.

programme.title: The Nazi War Machine of WWII
programme.desc: The story of the creation of the Nazi War Machine, tracing their origins from street thugs battling in the German streets after The Great War. We show the growth of the Panzer Corps, the mighty Luftwaffe, and the feared SS.

programme.title: Victory at Sea
programme.desc: Step back in time to WWII's combat at sea. Included are scenes of everyday life on aircraft carriers, and emotional moments such as an injured seaman receiving last rites.

programme.title: How to Lose a War
programme.desc: Discover how Axis brutality and exploitation in occupied territories fueled resistance and diverted troops from the front lines.

programme.title: WWII in HD
programme.desc: As the Allies prepare to invade France, Bert Stiles and the 8th Air Force battle to clear Normandy's skies while the Pacific stalls, leading to D-Day.

programme.title: Pakistan : Liberté Pour Tous Les Captifs
programme.desc: Aux captifs la liberté, une expression d’Isaïe chapitre 61, résume l'essence du travail pastoral du père Tomas. Tout en s'occupant des besoins spirituels des membres des tribus du Sind, il leur apprend qu'ils sont des enfants de Dieu avec la plus grande dignité et non les scories du système de castes. En même temps, il aide des familles à briser les liens du travail en servitude qui nie leurs droits d'êtres humains les plus élémentaires. Le père Tomas s'occupe des besoins spirituels des personnes qui ont embrassé la foi chrétienne dans cette région du sud du Pakistan, un pays à majorité musulmane, mais avec de fortes traces du système de castes hindou. La plupart des chrétiens convertis viennent de plus bas sous-groupes du système millénaire des castes de l'Inde, ce qui en fait des cibles faciles pour l’exploitation et les abus.

programme.desc: Este documental cuenta la historia del primer santo argentino Héctor Valdivielso Sáez quien hizo parte de los ocho católicos mártires de la llamada Revolución de Asturias. El y sus compañeros fueron fusilados sin acusación ni juicio previo.

programme.title: Vaticano
programme.desc: Esta semana en Vaticano, exploramos el camino cristiano hacia la eternidad. Desde las antiguas catacumbas de Roma, donde los primeros cristianos sepultaban a sus difuntos y proclamaban su esperanza en la vida después de la muerte, hasta el Dicasterio de las Causas de los Santos, donde la Iglesia sigue presentando a hombres y mujeres de virtudes heroicas como modelos de santidad, descubrimos qué significa vivir con el cielo como destino último. También conversamos con un capellán de hospital sobre el sacramento de la Unción de los Enfermos y visitamos el Museo de las Almas del Purgatorio para profundizar en la enseñanza de la Iglesia sobre el purgatorio y en la esperanza que une a vivos y difuntos.

programme.title: La misericordia y el perdón
programme.desc: Cristo es la Cabeza de la Iglesia y todos sus miembros forman parte de ese Cuerpo Místico. Una bella reflexión de cómo ser Iglesia.

programme.title: Canta y no llores
programme.desc: Serie de programas de una hora de duración, grabados en España, con la participación de cantautores y grupos de lo más destacado del panorama de la música religiosa. Presentado por el cantautor hispano - Uruguayo: Luis Alfredo Díaz. Canta y no llores, es un encuentro en profundidad con la música y la espiritualidad.

programme.title: Tertulias de fe
programme.desc: El Padre Gerardo Mendoza es un sacerdote de la Diócesis de San Bernardino que fue ordenado en julio de 1988 y cuenta con casi cuatro décadas de trayectoria pastoral en el sur de California. A lo largo de su ministerio, ha servido como párroco en iglesias de ciudades como Norco e Indio, donde la comunidad hispana lo reconoce por su calidez y su guía espiritual. Además de su labor en las parroquias, ayudó a fundar en 2011 el capítulo en español del movimiento católico Magnificat con la aprobación del obispo de la región.

programme.title: Siervo de todos
programme.desc: En un tiempo en el que la voz del Señor parece ahogada por «otras voces» y la propuesta de seguirlo entregando la propia vida puede parecer un absurdo, Dios sigue llamando a quien quiere, otorgando a través del Sacramento del Orden, la misión de servir en nombre y representación de Cristo-Cabeza en medio de la comunidad. A toda la Iglesia le urge responder a esta llamada.

programme.title: Mientras el mundo gira
programme.desc: Los modales son buenas costumbres y cortesía, son las acciones, posturas y comportamientos externos con los que una persona demuestra respeto, educación y refinamiento hacia los demás. El saludar al llegar, dar las gracias, pedir permiso o escuchar sin interrumpir, son ejemplos básicos. El Padre Willie nos advierte que la falta de ellos causa desaprobación social. Los modales son como una caricia, no han pasado de moda, solo que están escasos.

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica
programme.sub-title: Ante la superstición: ¡Sólo Jesús tiene poder!
programme.desc: El Padre Pedro nos explica que la superstición nos lleva a poner nuestra confianza en cosas o personas que, en sí, no tienen poder alguno. La superstición es, por lo tanto, una desviación de la fe en el Único que tiene poder para darnos vida nueva y vida abundante, y ese es Jesucristo. Además responde a las preguntas llegadas al programa vía telefónica, el correo electrónico (padrepedro@ewtn.com) y Facebook (www.facebook.com/ppedronunez).

programme.title: Perspectiva Católica
programme.desc: En una época en la que la bandera de la libertad parece flamear casi en todas partes, se dan cada vez más y más atropellos en contra de la libertad de vivencia y profesión de la fe. Magdalena Lira, directora nacional de ACN (Ayuda a la Iglesia que sufre) en Chile, nos ofrece un panorama de la situación en el país, que se encuentra en observación en materia de libertad religiosa.

programme.title: Informe provida
programme.sub-title: Cuando la desesperación tiene una salida
programme.desc: En este programa nos uniremos en oración por la defensa de la vida, inspirados en el legado del Beato Fulton J. Sheen y su profunda devoción a la Hora Santa. A través de la adoración eucarística y la oración por los niños por nacer, reflexionaremos sobre la importancia de interceder por quienes se encuentran en peligro de aborto, confiando en el poder de la oración y en la misericordia de Dios.

programme.title: Vaticano
programme.desc: Esta semana en Vaticano, exploramos el camino cristiano hacia la eternidad. Desde las antiguas catacumbas de Roma, donde los primeros cristianos sepultaban a sus difuntos y proclamaban su esperanza en la vida después de la muerte, hasta el Dicasterio de las Causas de los Santos, donde la Iglesia sigue presentando a hombres y mujeres de virtudes heroicas como modelos de santidad, descubrimos qué significa vivir con el cielo como destino último. También conversamos con un capellán de hospital sobre el sacramento de la Unción de los Enfermos y visitamos el Museo de las Almas del Purgatorio para profundizar en la enseñanza de la Iglesia sobre el purgatorio y en la esperanza que une a vivos y difuntos.

programme.desc: El Padre Gerardo Mendoza es un sacerdote de la Diócesis de San Bernardino que fue ordenado en julio de 1988 y cuenta con casi cuatro décadas de trayectoria pastoral en el sur de California. A lo largo de su ministerio, ha servido como párroco en iglesias de ciudades como Norco e Indio, donde la comunidad hispana lo reconoce por su calidez y su guía espiritual. Además de su labor en las parroquias, ayudó a fundar en 2011 el capítulo en español del movimiento católico Magnificat con la aprobación del obispo de la región.

programme.desc: Los modales son buenas costumbres y cortesía, son las acciones, posturas y comportamientos externos con los que una persona demuestra respeto, educación y refinamiento hacia los demás. El saludar al llegar, dar las gracias, pedir permiso o escuchar sin interrumpir, son ejemplos básicos. El Padre Willie nos advierte que la falta de ellos causa desaprobación social. Los modales son como una caricia, no han pasado de moda, solo que están escasos.

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica
programme.sub-title: Ante la superstición: ¡Sólo Jesús tiene poder!
programme.desc: El Padre Pedro nos explica que la superstición nos lleva a poner nuestra confianza en cosas o personas que, en sí, no tienen poder alguno. La superstición es, por lo tanto, una desviación de la fe en el Único que tiene poder para darnos vida nueva y vida abundante, y ese es Jesucristo. Además responde a las preguntas llegadas al programa vía telefónica, el correo electrónico (padrepedro@ewtn.com) y Facebook (www.facebook.com/ppedronunez).

programme.title: Perspectiva Católica
programme.desc: En una época en la que la bandera de la libertad parece flamear casi en todas partes, se dan cada vez más y más atropellos en contra de la libertad de vivencia y profesión de la fe. Magdalena Lira, directora nacional de ACN (Ayuda a la Iglesia que sufre) en Chile, nos ofrece un panorama de la situación en el país, que se encuentra en observación en materia de libertad religiosa.

programme.title: Vaticano
programme.desc: Esta semana en Vaticano, exploramos el camino cristiano hacia la eternidad. Desde las antiguas catacumbas de Roma, donde los primeros cristianos sepultaban a sus difuntos y proclamaban su esperanza en la vida después de la muerte, hasta el Dicasterio de las Causas de los Santos, donde la Iglesia sigue presentando a hombres y mujeres de virtudes heroicas como modelos de santidad, descubrimos qué significa vivir con el cielo como destino último. También conversamos con un capellán de hospital sobre el sacramento de la Unción de los Enfermos y visitamos el Museo de las Almas del Purgatorio para profundizar en la enseñanza de la Iglesia sobre el purgatorio y en la esperanza que une a vivos y difuntos.

programme.title: Tertulias de fe
programme.desc: El Padre Gerardo Mendoza es un sacerdote de la Diócesis de San Bernardino que fue ordenado en julio de 1988 y cuenta con casi cuatro décadas de trayectoria pastoral en el sur de California. A lo largo de su ministerio, ha servido como párroco en iglesias de ciudades como Norco e Indio, donde la comunidad hispana lo reconoce por su calidez y su guía espiritual. Además de su labor en las parroquias, ayudó a fundar en 2011 el capítulo en español del movimiento católico Magnificat con la aprobación del obispo de la región.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.desc: Dave Stotts open in Jerusalem and discuss the impact of Jesus over the last 2,000 years. He presents the set-up for the arrival of Jesus in the context of Jewish and Roman history. He travel to Nazareth and present the four different Gospel writers, Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John and learns the importance of genealogies as they related to a promised Jewish Messiah.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Miracle of the Annunciation
programme.desc: Dave Stotts stays in Nazareth and investigates the Annunciation, where the Angel Gabriel delivered very special news to a virgin girl named Mary. He explore the concepts of angels, miracles, and the importance of the Virgin Birth. He discusses the Roman census and the trip by Joseph and Mary to Bethlehem and examines the importance of Bethlehem in the ancient prophecies about a coming Messiah.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.desc: Dave Stotts visit the Church of the Nativity in Bethlehem and takes a look at the accounts of Jesus’ birth. He examines the birthplace of Jesus and the accounts of shepherds in the fields nearby. He explores the journey of the "Wise Men" from the East, known as Magi, and the Star of Bethlehem that summoned them. Dave Stotts then investigates the date for Jesus’ birth and the importance of Christmas traditions throughout the centuries.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Grows Up During the Reign of King Herod
programme.desc: Dave Stotts delve into the world of Herod the Great at the time of Jesus’ birth. He examines the “slaughter of the innocents” in Judea. He then visits a number of awesome archaeological sites in Israel built by Herod, including the massive Herodium about seven miles south of Jerusalem. He learn about the escape of Joseph, Mary and Jesus to Egypt until Herod’s death and travels to Jesus’ hometown of Nazareth where he later grew up.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: John the Baptist and the Start of Jesus' Ministry
programme.desc: Dave Stotts starts with the world of Jesus’ youth after the death of Herod the Great. He delves into the Roman occupation and its impact on the Jewish people and learns about John the Baptizer and his ministry of repentance in the wilderness. We experience the baptism of Jesus at the Jordan River and his testing in the Judean desert shortly thereafter.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Returns to Galilee
programme.desc: Dave Stotts explores the Sea of Galilee where Jesus begins his active ministry and gathers his first disciples Peter, Andrew, James and John.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Turns Water to Wine and Confronts Legalism
programme.desc: Dave Stott visit Chorazin, another location in Jesus’ ministry. He examine Cana and the first miracle performed by Jesus at the wedding in Cana, Jesus turns water to wine, astounding the guests. He follow Jesus to Jerusalem, where Jesus occasionally travelled during special Jewish festivals. He gets angry at the treatment of the temple in Jerusalem and he confronts the religious elites. Jesus meets a Pharisee named Nicodemus and delivers a very special message about eternal life.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Teachings Change Lives
programme.desc: Dave Stotts travel to Samaria and learn about the history of the Samaritans. He learns the story of the Samaritan woman at the well. He again travel to Jerusalem and investigate two pools where Jesus performed special miracles and learns that Jesus brings Living Water. We hear Jesus proclaim himself as the Light of the World.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Sermon on the Mount
programme.desc: Dave Stotts visit the hillsides of Galilee and hear Jesus deliver the Sermon on the Mount. He walk the Mount of the Beatitudes and explore many of Jesus’ radically new teachings. He learn about salted fish at Magdala and Roman roads at Hippos and delves into Jesus' use of parables, including many of the most famous delivered by Jesus during his ministry.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.desc: Travel to Caesarea Philippi where Jesus started to wrap-up his public ministry. Also, witness a mountaintop miracle known as the Transfiguration.

programme.title: 2024 YETI National Championships: Men's & Women's Boulder Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The 2024 YETI National Championships will be held at the USA Climbing National Training Center in Salt Lake City, UT. Join us to cheer for Team USA and the world’s best competition climbers as IFSC World Cups return to Salt Lake City. The Boulder and Speed World Cup returns May 3-5, while the Paraclimbing World Cup returns May 7-8.

programme.title: Respect Raptor Closures
programme.desc: Climbing Magazine associate editor, Sam Macilwaine, explains the importance of closing climbing routes to preserve bird nesting sites. Climbers can be good stewards of the outdoors by respecting closures and alerting land managers if they discover a raptor nest.

programme.title: 2023 National Team Trials: Women's & Men's Speed Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The 2023 USA Climbing National Team Trials presented by YETI is at the new Mesa Rim climbing facility in Austin, TX. For Team Trials, athletes compete in all three climbing disciplines Bouldering, Lead, and Speed. The 2023 U.S. National Team will comprise the top five ranked U.S. athletes per gender in each discipline, including a Boulder & Lead Team. In 2023, athletes from the newly formed Boulder & Lead Team and Speed Team will begin their quest to earn a spot for Team USA at the Paris 2024 Olympics. In speed climbing, athletes race against the clock and strive to set new records and achieve the fastest times possible. This fast-paced competition will leave you on the edge of your seat.

programme.title: Essential Self-Rescue for Climbers: Belaying from the Top CLIMB 16 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Learn basic self-rescue skills, and how to think critically in a climbing emergency. In this episode, guide and search-and-rescue pro Karsten Delap teaches you proper belaying from the top with different belay device styles.

programme.title: Review: Black Diamond Men’s Alpine Light Pants
programme.desc: Senior Editor at Climbing Magazine, Anthony Walsh, shares his review of the Black Diamond Alpine Light pants, which he says are the best all around climbing pants of 2025. He points out that they have light weather protection including PFC-free DWR finish, 4-way stretch, a gusseted crotch, articulated knees, and offer good breathable protection. He also notes the pockets are well placed, although he wishes there was an internal pocket garage for his phone. The pants are also sold in a women’s version.

programme.title: What Happens When There’s No Ice at Ice Fest?
programme.desc: Maya Silver, Editor-in-Chief at Climbing, talks about the 2026 Ouray Ice Fest, which up until the week before the event, had no ice. The organizers pivoted to an “ice-less” fest, and planned clinics around rock rescue, training for ice climbing, and dry tooling. Luckily, the week before the event, temperatures dropped and the park was able to create ice walls, but kept their planned schedule. Maya was able to learn to like dry tooling slightly more, and climb some empty ice.

programme.title: Little Brushy Opens to Climbers in Tennessee
programme.desc: Montage of climbing footage in Sequatchie Valley, Tennessee, with informational text popups. Until now, climbers have been unable to legally access Little Brushy. Access Fund and the Southeastern Climbers Coalition unlocked new access to the difficult sport climbing area, which will begin sometime this fall. There is also potential for additional route development and bouldering!

programme.title: The Art of Redpointing: Overcoming Obstacles CLIMB 22 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Unlock pro tips and world-class training techniques to get yourself redpoint ready. In this episode, pro climber Heather Weidner and mental-training expert Arno Ilgner teach you how to overcome the most common redpointing hurdles.

programme.title: The Best Ice Climbing Gear
programme.desc: Anthony Walsh, Senior Editor at Climbing Magazine, shares his reviews for some of the best ice climbing gear of the year. He recommends the La Sportiva G-Summit Boots, a double-booted model with a BOA fit system, as well as the Petzl Dart Crampon, which features a sharp bite. He also shares the Blue Ice Aero Ice Screw, which is the lightest steel screw on the market. He likes the updates to the Camp X-Dream Ice Tool, and finally reveals the Petzl Whisper Harness, which is lightweight and good for ice climbing.

programme.title: YETI Climbing National Championships 2026 - Lead Semi-Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The USA Climbing 2026 National Championships for Youth (YETI Nationals) at High Point Climbing and Fitness in Orlando, FL, bringing together top young climbers for Boulder, Lead, and Speed events to crown national champions and select athletes for national teams, showcasing Florida's competitive climbing scene.

programme.title: Paddy'O Sucks at Climbing
programme.desc: PaddyO doesnt just suck at climbinghe actively dislikes it, insisting s a fear-based sport where the fun never shows up. Can national climbing champ Kai Lightner change his mind? Will PaddyOs dislike of sucking beat his dislike of being scared? Can he get his massive hooves into climbing shoes without crying like a baby? Great questions!

programme.title: Episode 10, Weekend Whipper — A 15-Foot Ground Fall
programme.desc: On this episode of Weekend Whipper, belayer Matt Gowie is traumatized when climber Luis Armando takes a a 15-foot fall, all the way to the ground. The route is 'Partners in Crime', a 5.11a trad climb in Squamish, British Columbia. On the ground, the climbing partners react to the crazy fall.

programme.title: Episode 8 | Weekend Whipper | Upside-Down in South Africa
programme.desc: In this episode of Weekend Whipper, climber Greg Wright takes a giant whip on "Explorer" (24/5.11c) at Slanghoek Amphitheatre in Western Cape, South Africa, in which he flips fully upside-down.

programme.title: Climbings Newest Hotbed
programme.desc: Sasha travels to Manikia, a small village in Greece, to experience an emerging climbing destination. Manikia has only recently come into the spotlight as a potential world-class climbing destination. Sasha is joined on this adventure by fellow climbers from the Petzl team. The ultimate goal is to help establish a new climbing area the right way. During this trip, Sasha and the team set new routes in calibration with local climbers and guides while discussing ecotourism's positive and negative effects on local communities.

programme.title: Precision Footwork: Technique and Drills CLIMB Ep 9 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Learn to power your movement starting with your feet in order to climb to new heights. In this episode, pro climber Paige Claassen takes you through advanced moves and some drills to help up your footwork game.

programme.title: Ashtanga Yoga
programme.desc: Sasha finally gets the opportunity to learn more about ashtanga yoga and shares her new favorite recipe for maca bars.

programme.title: What is Lobbying? Climb the Hill with DiGiulian, Honnold, and Caldwell
programme.desc: Sasha, Alex Honnold, and Tommy Caldwell climb capitol hill and talk outdoor access in DC.

programme.title: The Trilogy
programme.desc: On July 12, 2018, professional climber, Sasha DiGiulian, set out to become the first woman and second person in history to complete the Rocky Mountain Trilogy, a compilation of three of the hardest 5.14 big walls in the Canadian Rockies. The imposing climbs, on Castle Mountain, Mount Louis, and Mount Yamnuska, respectively will take Sasha 2 months of continued effort with the ultimate goal of ascending each sheer wall in a single day push, with zero falls — a combined average of over 9,000 vertical feet of climbing at a lung-busting average elevation of 7,000ft. Setbacks with climbing partners, a shoulder injury, and mounting wildfires, DiGiulian is faced with ever-increasing obstacles and forced to balance her goals with her safety. This is not only an extraordinarily unique physical journey, but a universal introspective story of overcoming fear, the importance of self-confidence, and finding friends when and where you least expect them. Pushing through the uncomfortable moments and riding the ups and downs of life, DiGiulian drives herself through mounting fatigue and a closing weather window to strive for her historical goal.

programme.title: One-Legged Injury Training in Boulder, CO
programme.desc: A nagging injury means Sasha is in a walking boot, but doesnt let that stop her training. Physical Therapist Josslyn works through rehab training.

programme.title: There Are More Urban Climbing Areas Than You Think
programme.desc: Kush Khandelwal, Climbing contributor, highlights some little-known crags near major cities in states including Ohio, Minnesota, Virginia, and Illinois. Crags near urban areas help people get climbing after work. Talking head with burned-in captions and minimal stock imagery of the locations.

programme.title: The Golden Pitons Return
programme.desc: Kitty Calhoun, Alpinist and Activist, Tommy Caldwell, Former Golden Piton Winner and Pro Climber, Kai Lightner, Pro Climber and Founder of Climbing for Change, Beth Rodden, Former Golden Piton Winner and Pro Climber, and Mason Earle, Former Golden Piton Winner and Former Pro Climber, help re-launch the Golden Piton Awards for Climbing Mag, telling people to vote by January 31st.

programme.title: Master Dynamic Movement CLIMB Ep 10 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Learn how to tackle boulder problems and routes with explosive, dynamic power, and transform your climbing. In this episode, pro climber Carlo Traversi teaches you how to use your energy and momentum to send your next climb.

programme.title: Paige Claassen's Two-Shoe Tip
programme.desc: A professional climber Paige Claassen does a two-shoe tip on the bouldering problem 'Trice', a v12 in Flagstaff, Arizona.

programme.title: Field Tested: The North Face Advanced Mountain Kit
programme.desc: Climbing Senior Editor Anthony Walsh reviews the new Advanced Mountain Kit by The North Face. The kit includes some useful pieces, and some that are poorly design. Anthony covers the pros and cons of five pieces from the Summit Series Advanced Mountain Kit: its 40L Pack, VENTRIX Crop Pants, Vest, Verto FA Boots, and FUTURELIGHT Climb Pants. Direct-to-camera gear review with original product and field b roll.

programme.title: Yoga for Climbers: Yoga for Better Alignment and Power CLIMB 23 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Whether you're a veteran big waller, casual gym climber, or just getting started, doing yoga will help you send. In this episode, pro climber and yoga instructor Heidi Wirtz will help better align your shoulders and strengthen your core.

programme.title: Yoga for Climbers: Yoga to Help You Send CLIMB 30 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Whether you're a veteran big waller, casual gym climber, or just getting started, doing yoga will help you send. In this episode, pro climber and yoga instructor Heidi Wirtz takes you through various yoga flows to help improve your climbing.

programme.title: Cowboy Country
programme.desc: Deep in cowboy country, pro climber Alex Honnold joins endurance runner Peyton Thomas for an unexpected adventure in the Ruby Mountains. Off the trail, he dives into Basque culture, cowboy poetry, and silversmiths, a romantic gift for his wife.

programme.title: USA Climbing Season-End Highlights: Speed and Lead Results
programme.desc: Climbing Editor-in-Chief Maya Silver reports on the last USA Climbing event of the year, which took place in downtown Salt Lake City from August 22nd to the 24th. Highlights from the speed climbing and lead climbing events included local Natalia Grossman making a gold-winning comeback after a knee surgery six months ago and Sergey Lakhno getting gold in the men's lead competition, as one of only two competitors to top the route. Michaela Kirsch, Kai Lightner, and Nathaniel Coleman all did well, but Kirsch placed fourth and Kai and Nathaniel didn't make a place in the finals.

programme.title: 2026 UIAA World Cup | Lead Finals

programme.title: Mind Body Connection with Gabby Reece and Laird Hamilton
programme.desc: Sasha journeys to Malibu, CA, to meet up with professional athletes turned entrepreneurs Laird Hamilton and Gabby Reece. After an intense morning XPT training session for the body and mind, Sasha sits down to hear more about Lairds Superfood, a business born after Laird started adding different plant-based fats to his morning coffee. Laird and Gabbys emphasis on sustainability and social responsibility in all their product choices is an example every business should follow.

programme.title: Training and Meetings

programme.title: Sasha DiGiulian and Marianna Ordóñez Climb Madagascar’s ‘Bravo Les Filles'
programme.desc: Over a remote video recording, pro climbers Sasha DiGiulian and Marianna “Mango” Ordóñez talk about their climb of 'Bravo Les Filles' (5.13d/8b; 600 meters; 13 pitches) in Tsaranoro Valley, Madagascar, following in the footsteps of climbing icon Lynn Hill, the first ascensionist of the route. Run-and-gun B-roll, captured by the climbing partners, sets the scene. Sasha and Mango discuss the surprising risk associated with the state of the route and how they tackled the project anyway. They touch on Lynn's inspiration and their own intended inspiration, on the global female climbing community. Read the full story here: https://www.climbing.com/news/sasha-digiulian-and-marianna-ordonez-pick-up-where-lynn-hill-left-off-in-madagascar/

programme.title: A Climbers Paradise
programme.desc: Sasha travels to the remote island of Makatea in French Polynesia to learn about the island's unique history and see how establishing a world-class climbing destination could help create a new local economy. For years, phosphates mining took the rock away from this once pristine island. The remaining scars are a vivid reminder of the island's former destructive economy. Sasha and local climbers discuss how increased adventure tourism specific to climbing might help revitalize the local economy and deter a return to mining that is once again being considered.

programme.title: Essential Self-Rescue for Climbers: Ascending CLIMB 17 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Learn basic self-rescue skills and how to think critically in a climbing emergency. In this episode, guide and search-and-rescue pro, Karsten Delap teaches you how to ascend with different devices and use mechanical advantage to raise a load.

programme.title: Gear Review: Edelrid Ohmega
programme.desc: Text popups and b roll footage show off key elements of the Edelrid Ohmega, a new belay assistant for climbing partners with big weight differences.

programme.title: Climbing Guide Books vs. Apps
programme.desc: Climbing Contributor, Gavin Feek, discusses his article about climbing guide books and their future alongside newer climbing apps, as well as the rise of AI. He describes the ethical concerns related to new digital climbing guides compared to their older counterparts.

programme.title: Debunking Bio Plastics
programme.desc: Sasha travels to Maine where she meets up with local climber Erin OToole and Marine Research Scientist Abby Barrows who are doing their part in areas of sustainability and conservation. Sasha sees firsthand how businesses and individuals can work to make Maine and our world a better place.

programme.title: How to Transfer a Belay
programme.desc: Silas Rossi, IFMGA/AMGA Mountain Guide, walks through the steps to transfer a belay. First, ensure the climber is in a secure position and not hanging on the rope. Next, tie a clove hitch in the brake hand side of the rope and attach it to your belay loop with a locking carabiner. Next, transfer the belay device to the belay loop of the new belayer. Once you’ve checked it, untie the clove hitch and proceed with belaying.

programme.title: What to Look for When Buying Quickdraws
programme.desc: Professional climber, climbing guide, and Climbing contributor Genevive Walker covers what to look for when buying quickdraws. She covers quickdraw shape options (D-shaped and asymmetrical), solid gates v. wire gates, length, and alpine draws and anchor draws. She recommends you check your dogbone and carabiners for wear and tear, and know when it's time to retire them. Talking head show-and-tell with the different kids of draws.

programme.title: The Unexpected Ways this Dirtbag Fund Grant Recipient Used his Funding
programme.desc: Emilio Taiveaho, a climber from North Carolina and a recipient of the Dirtbag Fund grant, shares reflections from his experiences pre- and post-winning the Dirtbag Fund. While he didn't spend the funds exactly how he had anticipated, he was stoked to be part of the first round of fund recipients, and his stoke is still high.

programme.title: Behind the Scenes on "The Sound"

programme.title: The Valley Boy: The Story of Grant Cline
programme.desc: Climbing Contributor Gavin Feek reports on the late Gavin Cline, an 18-year-old who sadly passed away [Grant fell to his death in an accident at Royal Arches]. Grant was a prominent member of the Yosemite climbing community, living in employee housing within the park and working at the Lodge. Gavin nods to the fuller story in his article and shares imagery of Grant, his loved ones, and his living quarters in Yosemite National Park.

programme.title: Indigenous Ice Climbers: The Cholitas of Bolivia
programme.desc: Minidoc about the strides of the Cholitas Escaladoras, a group of female, Indigenous ice climbers in Bolivia which was founded in 2015. Cholitas leader and co-founder Cecilia Llusco shares the successes the women have had in increasing visibility for the Indigenous Aymara women of Bolivia, who have faced femicide and discrimination, by summiting large mountains "en pollera" (wearing traditional skirts and clothing). Cecilia's big dream is to summit Mount Everest. Follow Cecilia and a fellow Cholita as they climb Huayna Potosí, a 6,088-meter peak near El Alto, Bolivia. This peak inspired Cecilia's mission as a young girl.

programme.title: Choosing a Personal Anchor System
programme.desc: Silas Rossi, IFMGA/AMGA Mountain Guide and owner of Alpine Logic, discusses different personal anchors (also known as personal tethers or abbreviated as PAS). He recommends the Petzl Dual Connect Adjust, as well as the Petzl Connect Adjust as options, and also demonstrates the Metolius Personal Anchor System, and the Kong SLYDE as a more economical option. He also explains pros and cons of creating a personal anchor with a cordalette or a 4-foot runner or sling. Read the full story at www.climbing.com/gear/no-one-size-fits-all-personal-anchor

programme.title: Warren Miller's Chasing Shadows (2015)
programme.desc: This fall, Warren Miller Entertainment introduces its 66th snowsports film, Chasing Shadows. Watch JT Holmes, Seth Wescott, Caroline Gleich, Steven Nyman and more as they pursue turns on the mountains of our dreams: Chamonix, Alaska’s Chugach, Utah’s Wasatch and the mightiest range of them all: the Himalaya. These athletes are masters in their element, and with every cliff drop, perfect line and knee-deep powder turn, they motivate us. Warren Miller once said, “A pair of skis are the ultimate transportation to freedom,” and this year, we’re chasing storms, snow, lines and the freedom they grant us. Take a glimpse into the world of the U.S. freestyle team and the dynamics of snowsports that live on the fringe, like monoskiing, powsurfing and speed riding. Explore what it means to be inspired, and what it is about exotic locations and snow-covered summits that keep us searching for more. As skiers and snowboarders we chase a feeling, a memory, a storm, a turn — we’ve been chasing it our whole lives and we’ll keep chasing it a lifetime more. Winter starts with Warren Miller.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Children Of Winter (2008)
programme.desc: We’re called by untouched faces begging for tracks; by unbuilt jumps begging for a shovel, unclimbed mountains begging for someone to stand atop them and declare: Winter’s open for business. Meet Daron Rahlves, Pep Fujas, Wendy Fisher, Jamie Pierre, Seth Wescott, Andreas Hatveit, surfing legend Gerry Lopez, and many more, as they tell stories of ascents and descents, huge air and a few scares, from the mountains of Alaska, Colorado, Austria, Iceland, and beyond. Save for a few more feet of air and the touch of their turns, they’re just like us.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Climb to Glory: Legacy of the 10th Mountain Ski Troopers (2013)
programme.desc: Climb to Glory tells the story of the 10th Mountain Division Ski Troopers and how they transformed skiing as a whole and championed the U.S. Ski In­dustry after World War II. After participating in a major turning point in the War, these heroes came back from Italy as pioneering individuals and helped expand skiing from general resort develop­ment to a lifestyle sport . Narrated by Olympian and Colorado Ski & Snowboard Museum inductee Jeremy Bloom and inspired by Warren Miller Athlete Chris Anthony, "Climb to Glory" highlights their astounding impact to our country and the ski industry.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Dynasty (2009)

Join legendary WME athlete Chris Anthony as he treks into China’s interior on a search for the birthplace of skiing; follow mountaineering marvel Chris Davenport to Norway’s highest peaks; reunite with the pride of the Midwestern ski community, Luke and Adam Schrab; and catch a rare glimpse at historic clips from Warren Miller Entertainment’s vault of vintage footage.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Double Exposure (1985)
programme.desc: An adrenaline-charged ride into the world of extreme skiing, this film follows two legendary brother duos—the Egans and the DesLauriers—as they conquer towering peaks and treacherous descents. Known as ‘The Extreme Team,’ their daring pursuit of steep-slope skiing pushes the boundaries of courage, skill, and brotherhood.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Endless Winter (1995)
programme.desc: Warren Miller Entertainment is poised to kick off the 1995-96 ski season with a whirlwind tour of North America showcasing their newest film, “Endless Winter.” Miller’s cameras chased the world’s best skiers and snowboarders across four continents to create “Endless Winter.” From Alaska to Argentina and Jackson Hole to Japan, skiers and snowboarders enjoyed epic snow conditions the world over. Kurt Miller, son of the award-winning filmmaker and co-owner of Warren Miller Entertainment with partner Peter Speek, reported, “Our camera crews brought home more outstanding footage than ever before. ‘Endless Winter’ is sure to be a record-breaker!”

programme.title: Warren Miller's Escape To Ski (1988)
programme.desc: For many of us the only way to find peace and relax is to break free and Escape to Ski. Watch others like yourself escape including professionals like Mike Slattery, Kate Kuchera, Scot Schmidt, Diana golden and many others to some incredible ski destinations like Maui, Morocco, Chamonix, Switzerland, and Canada. Escape now and find your freedom through skiing.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Extreme Winter (1990)
programme.desc: Winter can be long and boring but grab a pair of skis or a snowboard and transform it and find out what it’s like to have an Extreme Winter. Ride along with skiers like Tamara McKinney, Jim”Moose” Barrows, Billy Kidd, Scotty Brooksbank, and Warren Miller himself as they travel across North America all the way down to Antarctica to show you just how extreme winter can really be.

programme.desc: Adaptive skiers Pete McAfee and Dom Davila head Mike Wiegele's heli-ski operation in Blue River, BC for the filming of Warren Millers Daymaker. Pete and Dom, both right-leg amputees, show there are no limits for adaptive snow sports athletes.

programme.title: Brotherhood of Skiing
programme.desc: Warren Miller's team is always on the hunt for the next generation of skiers and riders. This year a talented group of athletes, sponsored by the National Brotherhood of Skiers, traveled to Aspen, Colorado, to take part in the 49th annual NBS Summit.

programme.title: In Deep
programme.desc: An unusually strong start to the snow season in British Columbia grabbed the attention of the team at Warren Miller. The crew met up with three up-and-coming skiers: Simon Hillis, Madison Ostergren, and Marcus Goguen to see if they had what it takes - to take on these truly epic conditions. The Monashee mountains in British Columbia provided goods for this incredible snowcat adventure.

programme.title: AK Heights
programme.desc: With unmatched terrain and jaw-dropping lines, Haines, Alaska continues to be the ultimate proving ground for big mountain skiing and riding. Top athletes in winter sports and the filmmakers who capture them put this remote outpost back on the map.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Face of Winter (2018)
programme.desc: If winter puts a smile on your face, it’s something you had in common with the late, great Warren Miller. The warm, witty, mildly eccentric godfather of the ski-and-ride film was the man who got us started on this long, crazy ride. This fall, don’t miss Volkswagen presents Warren Miller’s Face of Winter, the 69th installment from Warren Miller Entertainment. Visit some of Warren’s favorite locations, from Engleberg to Chamonix, British Columbia to Alaska, Chile, Iceland, New Zealand, Washington and more. Watch world-class skiers like Jessie Diggins, along with the U.S. Nordic Ski Team as they train like champions, and catch big mountain athletes like Anna Segal, Dash Longe, Forrest Jillson, Amie Engerbretson, Seth Wescott, Jim Ryan, Marcus Caston and others as they carve down the faces of remote mountain ranges in pursuit of a life lived in high places.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Fifty (1999)
programme.desc: Warren Millers Golden Anniversary film, FIFTY commemorates a half-century of wry wintertime wit from the Grand Master of the genre. In addition to the usual dazzling display of beyond belief action, Warren Millers fiftieth release features a refreshing fusion of some of the greatest moments ever captured on film by Millers globe trotting, award winning camera crews. From the mesmerizing opening montage to the hilarious tail crawl, FIFTY takes the viewer on a rollicking ride through a dozen exotic locations and spectacular snow covered settings. Whether its the screaming descent of a 20,000 foot volcano in Equador or the pulse quickening portrait of scenic splendor in Austria, FIFTY is a tour de force for those who long to feel the freedom of fresh tracks and witness the steeps, deeps, and leaps of fellow snowriders from around the world.

programme.desc: In this installment, hidden-camera comedian Ed Bassmaster works airports, hotels, and road-trip run-ins. He sends in his cast of oddball characters — the deadpan Skippy, a rotating crew of weirdos, and off-kilter everymen — to bewilder real people who have no clue it's a bit, sparking awkward silences, baffled reactions, and his signature offbeat humor. Packed with quotable catchphrases and can't-look-away moments, it's the character-driven prank comedy that turned Ed Bassmaster into a viral sensation with millions of fans. programme.title: House on Haunted Hill
programme.desc: A millionaire offers ten thousand dollars to five people if they agree to stay overnight in a large, spooky, rented house. When you consider that the millionaire is Vincent Price, and the film is directed by Schlock master William Castle, you can bet the five guests are in for a long, bumpy night. This super shocker of the century was a smash hit upon its 1959 release. For architecture buffs, the home used for the exteriors of the haunted house was actually designed by Frank Lloyd Wright and built in 1924!

programme.title: Night of the Living Dead (In Color & Restored) (Edited Version)
programme.desc: This is one of the true cult classics and one of the scariest movies of all time. The dead are walking and hunger for human flesh. A group of panicked survivors are barricaded in a deserted farmhouse while the army of flesh eating zombies hovers outside their door. This over-the-top disk includes a restored original black and white version, and a color version that will thrill the horror film fan and horrify the film purist. We've added a 5.1 surround sound mix, and bonus features including a hilarious audio commentary by Mike Nelson of Mystery Science Theater 3000.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home. FBI agents collected fibers from her bedroom and discovered, through the use of laser light sources, a palm print on Polly's bed. After a massive two-month investigation, the FBI arrested Richard Allen Davis. Would the palm prints and fibers match?

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1982, a California highway patrol officer pulled a young woman over for speeding. He bullied her into sex and then killed her. He then used a decade of police experience to try to cover up his crime and convince investigators of his innocence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The calm of a Southern Ohio's quiet community was shattered in 1989, when a sniper gunned down an outdoorsman without reason. Hiding in the distance, behind a high powered rifle, a madman was hunting humans along Ohio's county roads.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A young mother and her two daughters were sexually assaulted and brutally murdered in Anchorage, Alaska. With only one piece of forensic DNA evidence, a wash rag carrying pubic lice with which the killer used to clean himself, could the FBI convict their prime suspect, the woman's nephew Kirby Anthoney, on all three counts of murder?

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Two couples found themselves on the same deserted island paradise, but only one couple left alive. Buck Walker and Stephanie Sterns arrived in Hawaii on the Sea Wind, which belonged to the missing couple, San Diego millionaires Mac and Muff Graham. This historic case was later depicted in And the Sea Will Tell.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On June 21, 1964, three civil rights workers who set out to educate southern blacks about receiving the right to vote disappeared in Mississippi. After they were found lynched in the rural deep South, the FBI gained the trust of an informant whose information led to the conviction of seven local Ku Klux Klan members. This case was later depicted in the film Mississippi Burning.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The reputed boss of the Genovese crime family, Vince Gigante wandered the streets of New York wearing only pajamas and a bathrobe, but the FBI was convinced he was anything but crazy.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: No suspect had emerged after the rapes and murders of ten women near Tampa, Florida in 1984. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers. When one of the killer's victims survived, the FBI was able to identify 31-year-old Bobby Joe Long as the suspect.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A loner and distrustful of authority, Claude Dallas lived off the land, poaching wildlife and selling the hides. When two game wardens confronted Dallas about his deeds, they were shot and killed. After a massive manhunt, Dallas was captured and convicted but escaped months later. On the FBI's Ten Most Wanted list, Dallas eluded agents for nearly year until the FBI tracked him down in California.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Those who poison must first put their victims at ease and earn their trust.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: The passage of time can convince people to talk and coupled with new technologies can help to solve old cases.

programme.title: McLintock
programme.desc: He likes his whiskey hard... His women soft... And his west all to himself! Inspired by Shakespeares The Taming of the Shrew (1594), John Wayne (The Searchers, Stagecoach), Maureen OHara (Miracle on 34th Street, The Parent Trap), and Patrick Wayne (The Searchers, The Alamo) star in this western comedy directed by Andrew V. McLaglen (Gunsmoke, The Wild Geese). George Washington McLintock (John Wayne) is the wealthiest man in his territory who utilizes his power and influence to maintain order between farmers, ranchers, Indians, corrupt government officials, and his own family! McLintock is McNificent!

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is in search of a missing miner and his daughter in this Lone Star Picture. Along the way, Drew rescues his pal Wabbi (Noah Beery Jr.) from card cheats who have framed him for murder. You'll find plenty of action and suspense in this vintage horse opera, originally distributed by the kings of the B western, Monogram Pictures!

programme.title: Lost Canyon
programme.desc: When Johnny Travers (Jay Kirby) is falsely accused of robbing a bank, it's up to Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) to clear his name and find the real villains. There's nothing better than watching Hoppy get rough with the rustlers, and it's all the better when you get to hear the Sportsmen Quartette sing (I got Spurs) Jingle, Jangle, Jingle.

programme.title: Raiders of Red Gap
programme.desc: Bob's Playin' A Mystery Hand... He's Marked For Death By Killer Bullets As Gunfire Echoes Over The Plains! After one of his ranch hands is killed when a gang attacks his ranch, Jim Roberts joins forces with his neighbor in an effort to fight off the Bennett Cattle Co., a company looking to rob them of their land. Things get increasingly dangerous as the company hires Butch Crane, a professional killer, to stop them. Directed by Sam Newfield (Racing Luck (1935), Go-Get-Em, Haines (1936)), Raiders of Red Gap stars Robert Livingston (The Three Mesquiteers (1936), Larceny on the Air (1937)) as Rocky (Lone Rider) Cameron and Al St. John (Billy the Kid Trapped (1942), Border Feud (1947)) as Fuzzy Q. Jones.

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: Randolph Scott plays James Barlow, an agent from Chicago hired to bring the notorious Reno brothers to justice. But wouldnt you know it? The Reno gang includes a beautiful young woman (Mala Powers), who catches Barlows eye. This western from director Tim Whelan (The Thief of Bagdad) features cinematography by two-time Oscar winner Ray Rennahan (Gone With The Wind), while the screenplay was by noted author Horace McCoy (They Shoot Horses, Dont They?). Theres also an all-star cast, including Forrest Tucker, J. Carrol Naish, Edgar Buchanan, Denver Pyle, and several other shaggy sidewinders!

programme.title: Colorado Kid
programme.desc: Cowboy star Bob Steele (Valley of Hunted Men, The Trail Blazers) headlines this Poverty Row western drama. As the Colorado Kid, he's falsely arrested for murder and has to clear himself. The colorful cast includes Ernie Adams, Frank LaRue, and Horace Murphy, with direction by Sam Newfield (The Terror of Tiny Town, The Mad Monster).

programme.title: Neath Canadian Skies
programme.desc: It's the mounties versus claim jumpers in this drama from Golden Gate Pictures. Based on an action-packed novel by James Oliver Curwood and directed by B. Reeves Maynard (Undersea Kingdom, The Phantom Empire), the film features an outstanding cast of Poverty Row regulars, including Russell Hayden, Inez Cooper, Cliff Nazarro, I. Stanford Jolley, and Kermit Maynard. For movie buffs: Cinematographer Marcel Le Picard began his career in the silent era and finished with exactly 200 credits!

programme.title: Red Ryder: Ride, Ryder, Ride!
programme.desc: Red Ryder encounters bandits trying to hold up the stagecoach carrying the owner of the Devil's Hole newspaper, Libby Brooks and her brother Gerry. Red successfully drives off the attackers but becomes embroiled in further conflict, leading to a duel that nearly claims his life.

programme.title: Fighting Fury
programme.desc: A THRILLING TALE OF REVENGE AND REDEMPTION! Based on the story Triple Cross for Danger by the widely lauded Western author Walter J. Coburn, Fighting Fury is a thrilling take on the Western revenge drama. Portraying both a father and his son, star of silent and sound cowboy adventure films, Jack Hoxie (Trouble Busters, Law and Lawless) exudes the classic American rustic charm that still defines the genre. The film spins the yarn of Clay Hill Jr. (Hoxie), a Spanish-American boy raised by a Mexican servant who vows bloody vengeance on three malicious ranchers after they murder his parents and turn his life upside down. Featuring fine supporting performances from genre heavies Helen Holmes, Buck Conners and Western mainstay Fred Kohler.

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: Ablaze with guns and guts and glory! Randolph Scott headlines as a star studded cast in this yarn about battling homesteaders. Director Edwin L. Marin (Tall in the Saddle) spins this dramatic post-Civil War tale that takes place in the legendary cow town of Abilene, Kansas, coaxing fine performances from the likes of Ann Dvorak, Edgar Buchanan, Thonda Fleming, and Lloyd Bridges. Saddle up and hang on!

programme.title: Shine on Harvest Moon
programme.desc: Jackson and his gang are cattle rustlers holed up in Jackson Hole Wyoming. Roy's partner Brower was once Jackson's partner and is now suspected of being in cahoots with him. Someone is tipping off Jackson as to the cattle's whereabouts and when Roy learns who it is he has a plan to trap Jackson and clear his partner. Starring Roy Rogers, Lynne Roberts, and Myrtle Wiseman as 'Lulu Belle. Directed by Joseph Kane.

programme.title: Days of Jesse James
programme.desc: Famed American western actor and singer Roy Rogers once again plays himself in this Jesse James tale that's a twist on the familiar formula. When he is summoned to bring Jesse to justice after the known villain is suspected of a bank robbery, Rogers soon discovers that Jesse has been framed and that the owner of the bank has robbed his own bank posing as Jesse. Fast-paced and fun, this classic Roy Rogers western directed by Joseph Kane (Dakota) features a whole host of original songs sung by the great Rogers himself.

programme.title: Colorado Sundown
programme.desc: Murder among ranchers is the subject of this Republic Pictures drama. Starring such names as Rex Allen, Slim Pickins, and Chester Clute, this feature was directed by William Whitney. For Trivia Buffs: At one time Whitney was known as the youngest director in Hollywood, having been hired by the newly formed Republic Pictures at the tender age of 21.

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: Fred Scott plays a lawman who goes undercover to expose a dangerous gang of criminals in this action-packed drama. He also has time to sing three songs: Cactus Pete, Gonna Ride, and Heres Romance. Screenwriter Fred Myton would go on to write such offbeat features as Nabonga, and Border Phantom.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: What happens when Abraham Lincoln himself comes to New Mexico to discuss a treaty with Native American chief Acoma (Ted de Corsia)? Can the hotbed of emotions be quieted by cavalry Captain Hunt (Lew Ayres)? Or will the Captains superiors insist on provoking with the native tribe? Find out what happens in this fictional tale packed with action from 1951!

programme.title: Enemy of the Law
programme.desc: Tex Ritter stars in this western drama about a man who goes undercover to befriend a convict believed to have stolen a shipment of government gold. Also starring Guy Wilkerson as Panhandle Perkins, this offering from Hollywoods Poverty Row features the usual fistfights and entertaining storyline that made these modestly budgeted features well worth watching. Songs include Teach Me To Forget and You Will Have to Pay both sung by Tex!

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Hurricane Horseman
programme.desc: Pancho Gomez kidnaps Don Roberto and his daughter, Tonita for ransom. Can an undercover lawman named Gun Smith save the pair, or will he be caught himself?! Smith gets a job in Gomez's camp supposedly to repair their guns. Instead he fixes the guns so they will misfire. When Gomez refuses to let him go, he sends his horse for the Sheriff! This campy western from 1931 stars Lane Chandler and is sure to keep you enthralled from beginning to end. Directed by Armand Schaefer; starring Marie Quillan and Walter Miller.

programme.title: Six Gun Trail
programme.desc: Legendary cowboy star Tim McCoy stars as Captain William Carson, who along with his sidekick Magpie does battle with jewel thieves. Its an actionfilled drama of the West, with plenty of blazing guns and heman adventure! There are a couple of songs, too, including Moon Over the Plains but they arent sung by Tim McCoy. He was too darned tough to sing! Also starring Nora Lane, Ben Corbet; directed by Sam Newfield.
