Seven years and one pandemic since their fruition, The ManBoys roster still remains largely intact with Chris Rasman, Rusty Ockenden, Matt Belzile, Jody Wachniak, Beau Bishop & Eric Jackson. Snowdance was filmed by Ben Webb, Connor Winton, Dave Craig, and Ryan Kenny.

programme.title: The Manboys Movie
programme.desc: The boys are back with new friends and a brand new snowboard film. The Manboys Movie will definitely top your expectations. Featuring bangers from Chris Rasman, Rusty Ockenden, Craig McMorris, Jody Wachniak, Matt Belzile, Anto Chamberland, and Mark Sollors.

programme.title: Air Time Podcast - Devun Walsh
programme.desc: Devun Walsh aka the GOAT. If only you could put into words the impact Devun has had on snowboarding. From his signature style, timeless tricks, mentorship, films, companies, attitude and his overall vision for our culture… and of course his ability to seek out and find new zones and features that till this day are the gold standard of professional backcountry riding. Truly one of the greats. Thanks for coming on boss. Enjoy!

programme.title: La Zone
programme.desc:
In the early 2000's, snowboard filmer David 'Vlad' Vladyka and a handful of riders discovered an off-the-radar area on the French-Swiss border that held massive potential for shooting freestyle snowboarding. The mountain pass featured rolling terrain punctuated by steep roll overs that are perfect for building jumps. The area was Le Col de Cou, and though it had a name, the riders called it 'La Zone', a purposefully vague nickname that would help them keep the area a secret.
Over the next decade, La Zone would become one of the most productive and standard setting locations for filming freestyle snowboarding in all of Europe. Shots from La Zone were featured in several Absinthe films, and many others.
Now 20 years later, Jones team rider Mat Schaer and Vlad still return to La Zone to film from time to time, but the pristine slopes they enjoyed in the past are much harder to find as Le Col de Cou has become a popular ski touring destination.
Featuring new and historic footage from La Zone, this new short film directed by Julien Rosens, and produced by Absinthe Films, highlights the history, beauty and inevitable evolution of this legendary shred spot.
Credits LA ZONE, a movie directed by Julien Roserens Produced by Absinthe Films Supported by Jonessnowboards, Region Dents du Midi, Doodah store Edited by Jules Guarneri Soundmix by Stephane Chapelle Graphics by René Zumstein Photo by Michael Cordey Music : Tugrul by Ochre, Rhea by Yehezkel Raz, Where It Beginns It Ends by Be Still The Earth, Strange Life de YGGL, Let Us Get Out by Redder

programme.title: FLIPSIDE Futureproof

programme.title: Volcom Presents: 9191

programme.title: Doodah Presents: Spacé - Glacier

programme.desc: On his 45th trip to Japan (since 1991), Terje rides powder in the Japanese Alps with the snowboarders Leo Cittadella, Rip Zinger, Curtis Ciszek, Oli Gittler and Ian Tobin.

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen - Happo Two
programme.desc: The snowboarders Rip Zinger and Terje Haakonsen ride powder in Japan. Years after his recovery from a debilitating head injury, they get Kevin Pearce back on snow. Join us for this episode of friendship, freshies, and freeriding.

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen - Happo Three
programme.desc: Snowboarder Terje Haakonsen explores the joys of Japanese mountain culture with his friends Kevin Pearce, Mikkel Bang, Rip Zinger, Oli Gittler, Curtis Ciszek, Leo Cittadella and Ian Tobin.

programme.title: Without a Paddle
programme.desc: ‘Without a Paddle’ is a canoe film about snowboarding. Four snowboarders retrace a portion of the 19th century explorer David Thompson’s journey down the Columbia River, during one of the coldest cold snaps in Revelstoke’s recorded history. Surreal landscapes, epic paddling, deep powder, and pain.

programme.title: Northbound and Around
programme.desc: Hungry for clips and greedy for turns, Johan Rosen, Garrett “Worm” Warnick and friends spent the season leaving no line unridden and no pillow unsmashed. Driven by the most unsatisfiable of desires, finding good snow, the crew spent the season running from warm temperatures and chasing down a dream. To get to the promised land, they found themselves traveling… Northbound and Around. Featuring: Garrett Warnick, Johan Rosen, Nils Arvidsson, Ryan Paterson, Keenan Filmer, Kareem El Rafie Nils Mindnich, Jess Kimura, Bode Merrill, Ben Bilocq, Brandon Davis, Nick Khattar, Kyle Mack Edited by: Johan Rosen

programme.title: Without a Pedal
programme.desc: Snowboarding Alaska the hard way. An epic winter bike trip down Canada’s Cassiar Highway turns into a test of survival, obsession, and how far you’ll go for the dream.

programme.title: CHANNEL ZeRO
programme.desc: Released in 2020, this Absinthe Films feature highlights the unifying power of snowboarding during a divisive moment in history, celebrating a global community that refuses to be separated by physical or mental barriers.

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen - Half Banked at Mt Baker
programme.desc: Terje and Leo Cittadella head to Mt. Baker, Washington to meet up with with Russell Winfield and Rip Zinger to compete in the 33rd Legendary Banked Slalom. During a windstorm, a tree falls on the house while everyone is asleep. Terje gets waxing tips from Olympic gold medalist Seth Westcott.

programme.title: Terje Haakonsen: Nippow Holiday
programme.desc: Snowboarder Terje Haakonsen invites the filmmaker and musician, Leo Cittadella, to join him and Rip Zinger on a powder trip to Hokkaido, Japan. Along the way, they meet up with Nicolas Müller and Mikkel Bang to film for the Absinthe Films feature "TurboDojo.”

programme.title: El Bosque del Silencio
programme.desc: UNA MUCHACHA CONOCIO A UN HOMBRE POR INTERNET Y SE ENAMORA DE EL UN DIA DECIDIO IR A VERLO EN PERSONA, AUNQUE SU FAMILIA SE LO PROHIBIO ELLA DE CUALQUIER MANERA SE FUE PERO CUANDO LO VIO NO PODIA CREER LO QUE PASO

programme.title: El Hormigón
programme.desc: El hormigón es un superhéroe que está harto de la mafia de su ciudad y decide combatirla con ayuda del Karate y la salsa.

programme.title: Error 113
programme.desc: Cuatro extraños se encuentran en el apartamento 113 invitados por Annie Annie, una aplicación de inteligencia artificial que ayuda a las personas con sus problemas cotidianos. Annie Annie les ha dicho que la aplicación es en realidad una persona real y que se van a encontrar cara a cara. Después de un tiempo, estos extraños comienzan a sentirse incómodos a medida que se dan cuenta de que Annie no va a poder hacerlo.

programme.title: Como El Gato y El Ratón
programme.desc: El barrio de La Estrella es uno de los más pobres de Bogotá. Allí habitan ciudadanos que han sido desplazados por la guerra y la violencia. Un día y tras años de espera, la luz eléctrica llega al barrio. La gente lo celebra y, pese a oponerse el edil, deciden usarla de manera ilegal. Todo se complicará cuando dos familias tengan un conflicto por unos cables cruzados.

programme.title: Call TV
programme.desc: Lucía, una actriz en decadencia, acepta presentar un programa nocturno de preguntas tontas. Sin darse cuenta de que se ha metido en un gran lío que le hará pasar la peor noche de su vida

programme.title: Allá y Entonces
programme.desc: Narra el encuentro de Temístocles con su padrino, a quien cree haber matado y ahora supone un fantasma que viene a desquiciarlo. Pasando del drama a la comedia y enredos absurdos, Temístocles enfrenta sus fantasmas hasta perder el control de su vida y llevar su economía a la bancarrota. Su esposa va a dar a luz. Al descubrir que su padrino vive, se abre la posibilidad de saldar su deuda y romper con el maleficio.

programme.title: Amar
programme.desc: Carlos quiere pero Susana no. Joel no quiere pero Patricia lo obliga. Gabriel lo espera pero Martha no se lo da. Amado lo busca con una gringa y lo pierde. Benito lo tiene toda la vida. Concha se lo lleva más allá del sistema solar. Todos lo quieren y todos lo dan pero unos no lo reciben y otros quieren más. Así es Amar.

programme.title: El Karma de Carmen
programme.desc: Carmen tiene 36 años y no logra adecuarse al mundo y a la sociedad en que vive. Tampoco tiene pareja y eso la preocupa. En una rifa de Navidad, Carmen se gana el premio mayor: una semana con todo pago para dos personas en Mar del Plata. Carmen no está dispuesta a irse sola. El viaje y su soledad es su disparador para iniciar el cambio.

programme.title: A Ellas Les Gustan Mayores
programme.desc: Ricardo Soto está casado con Miranda Robles, una mujer guapa con una afortunada posición social. Su esposo aprovechará esta situación para ponerle el cuerno con una jovencita mucho menor que él, sin recordar que el que ríe al último, ríe mejor

programme.title: Ámbar "El Color de la Familia Perfecta"
programme.desc: Paúl, actor y cantante, propietario de un bar musical, regresa de Canadá para luchar el régimen de visitas a fin de ver crecer a su hijo, Amanda, lo ha alejado por más de 7 años, luego de que ésta lo descubriese con otro hombre en su propia casa…

programme.title: Expediente 53
programme.desc: Esta es una historia de misterio y acción en la ciudad de Bryan Texas el comandante Gatel pide la ayuda del FBI ya que hay muchos desaparecidos, y asesinatos en la ciudad. Los agentes Gutiérrez, Bracho y Miravalle del FBI le comentan al comandante Gatel que ellos sospechan que puede ser obra de una secta satánica y que el líder es un demonio de nombre Abal que está en el cuerpo de una bella mujer de nombre Lilly.

programme.title: Buenas Noches, Dijo La Señorita Pájaro
programme.desc: Un adulterio, un secreto familiar, un asesino en serie. Una historia fabricada con estructura de muñecas rusas y con ritmo de montañas rusas. El espectador busca una barandilla a la que agarrarse, pero sólo encuentra cuchillos. La carrera artística de Sonia, una joven actriz de teatro, empieza a despegar al tiempo que intenta mantener a flote la relación sentimental que la une a Óscar, casado, a su vez, con la hija de un poderoso empresario. Por otro lado la policía investiga los crímenes de un asesino en serie que envía fotografías comprometidas a sus víctimas antes de acabar con ellas. Sonia acaba de recibir una de esas fotografías...Un asesino en serie del que tan solo vemos sus manos enfundadas en unos guantes de cuero, las pistas falsas, los falsos culpables, gestos y detalles que pasan prácticamente inadvertidos pero que acabaran siendo cruciales, haciendo partícipes a los espectadores del juego, el trauma infantil que sobrevuela constantemente la trama, la pareja de policías que siempre van un paso por detrás del asesino

programme.title: El Tirabeque
programme.desc: Sebas es redactor de un periódico digital que nadie lee, está en trámites de divorcio y tiene problemas con el alcohol. Toda su vida se desmorona hasta que le encargan un reportaje sobre los tirabeques. Lo que en un inicio parecía un trabajo tranquilo se convertirá en una investigación de consecuencias impredecibles.

programme.title: Codón Es Una Máquina
programme.desc: Dos amigos se reúnen para planear la creación de una película con un equipo de producción filmando el proceso, dos cuarentones con problemitas están muy decididos a hacer la famosa película de la que llevan años hablando. Se vienen tan arriba que hasta ya graban el making of... y hasta están haciendo un casting, aunque no tienen ni guión ni puñetera idea de lo que van a rodar. Y lo peor: no sospechan que están en las manos de un loco peligroso.

programme.title: Aute Retrato
programme.desc: Recopilación de los mejores momentos de Luis Eduardo Aute en sus 50 años de carrera musical y artística. Un recorrido por sus distintas facetas creativas y sus bandas sonoras. Toda la vida el artista desvelada por un grupo de testigos, colaboradores y amigos que, a través de sus testimonios, demuestran el impacto que han tenido sus icónicas canciones sobre la actualidad musical.

programme.title: 4 Metros
programme.desc: 4 METROS relata, en tono de comedia romántica, la historia de un hombre entrando en la crisis de los 40. Joaquín tiene un zumbido en los oídos y poco sabe de sí mismo. Se ha dejado llevar sin intervenir demasiado en sus deseos. No escucha su voz interior. Su vida afectiva y laboral no tienen rumbo. El zumbido quizá sea la expresión, no asumida ni entendida todavía, de un ruido metafórico de la vida gritándole por dónde ir. Su novia tiene 20 años menos, aparece la presión social y familiar sobre la paternidad, sentirse útil, la vocación, el trabajo y cómo ser feliz. Hasta que otra mujer irrumpe y todo parece acomodarse. Pero siempre el orden debe ser interno. Así, como si el destino tomara la palabra, su vida cambiará 4 metros abajo del agua, donde aparece un sendero para encontrar la identidad.

programme.title: El Peluquero Romántico
programme.desc: La vida del barbero de barrio Víctor transcurre bastante tranquila. Mantiene una estricta rutina diaria tanto en el trabajo como en casa, donde pasa las noches junto a su madre escuchando boleros o viendo películas de la Época de Oro del Cine Mexicano en la televisión. Su rutina se ve alterada cuando su madre muere repentinamente. Su coqueteo con una joven camarera y su reencuentro con una antigua novia no pueden llenar el vacío dejado por su madre. Sin embargo, eso cambia cuando un día un hombre que dice ser su padre entra repentinamente a la tienda. El encuentro lo llevará a un viaje inesperado y que le cambiará la vida a Río de Janeiro.

programme.title: Aquel Septiembre
programme.desc: En "Septiembre" la vida de Antonio se ve sacudida con el regreso de Carolina, su mejor amigo a quien no ve desde hace 6 años. Esta vez sus planes cambian, el amor comienza a juega con su corazón mientras Julián le hace descubrir los celos que nunca pensó encontraría. Carolina encuentra en Antonio a su mejor confidente y desahogo, sin sabiendo el daño que le hace al decirle todo lo que siente por Julián y hablando con él sobre su confusión por enamorarse de un amigo. Y es que pobre Antonio está enamorado de Carolina, su mejor amiga.

programme.title: El Tercer Deseo
programme.desc: Eugenio, un corredor de bienes raíces despierta en una esquina de la ciudad con una descomunal borrachera y descubre cerca una desportillada tetera de metal. La toma y manosea a ver si es de plata y, de pronto, se le aparece el espectro de un duende que le sugiere formule tres deseos. El genio desaparece sin dar oportunidad al tercer deseo. Mas tarde, descubre que los deseos le han sido concedidos pero de forma equivocada. La vida de Eugenio se complica, solo anhela reencontrar la tetera abandonada y pedir el tercer deseo.

programme.title: ¡Ni Te Me Acerques!
programme.desc: Él solo tenía que cuidar el hotel y teclear su novela, como Jack Nicholson en “El Resplandor”, pero de buen rollo. Y Llega la cuarentena y se queda le pilla en el Hotel Balneario de Ariño haciendo frente a la paranoia general, el acoso de las fuerzas del orden, las videollamadas de su novia, su madre y del conspiranoico Javi... Todos nos aburrimos mucho en el primer confinamiento. Juan no.

programme.title: El Retorno
programme.desc: Una extraña mujer mantiene expectante y desorientado al espectador cuando a diario habla con su hija y la presencia de su hija no aparece en ningún momento. Una historia no previsible que juega al despiste, por lo que, hay que esperar hasta el final para saber lo que está pasando la protagonista.

programme.title: Cena Para Tres
programme.desc: Diego regresa a México después de dictar cátedra de arquitectura en Madrid y se encuentra con su antiguo amor, Carmen. Planea una cena para dos para despedir el año. Carmen asume que esa noche Diego le pedirá matrimonio pero la llegada inesperada de Valentina (su novia española) y la revelación del pasado secreto de Carmen cambiarán el destino de los personajes.

programme.title: Dos Fridas
programme.desc: Dos Fridas está inspirada en la relación entre la pintora mexicana Frida Kahlo y su enfermera costarricense Judith Ferreto: Judith cuidó de Frida durante los últimos años de su vida. En sus recuerdos, Frida fue atendida por Judith en su casa Azul en México. Como espejo, a Judith la cuidaba una mujer en Costa Rica. En el mundo interior de Judith, los ensueños, los mitos, la imaginación y la realidad se entrelazan

programme.title: Atrapadas En La Duna
programme.desc: En la zona agrícola del Valle de Virú, muchas jovencitas han desaparecido cerca a la carretera. Renato es un chofer con problemas mentales que no supera sus traumas de niñez, un día conoce a Brenda, despertará en él, un amor enfermizo que pronto, lo va a poner al descubierto.

programme.title: Er Relajo Del Loro
programme.desc: Un loro que tras ser vendido a unos traficantes de animales cuando era pequeño, va pasando de dueño en dueño durante toda su vida y cambiando su nombre de acuerdo a su propietario, mirando frente a sus ojos la evolución de Venezuela durante 50 años (1950/2000).

programme.title: Cuernavaca
programme.desc: El mundo de Andy cambia totalmente cuando su madre tiene un accidente. Sin nadie que lo cuide, es llevado a Cuernavaca, a la casa de su desconocida abuela paterna. Mientras su madre se debate entre la vida y la muerte, el niño se enfrentará a la frialdad de su abuela, al mundo seductor y peligroso del hijo del jardinero y a la búsqueda de su padre

programme.title: Gritos del Monday
programme.desc: Un grupo de estudiantes de Ingeniería Ambiental realizan un trabajo en la Reserva Ecológica de los Saltos del Monday, conocido por su rica fauna y su rica historia. Para el trabajo, los alumnos deciden acampar en el lugar, en medio de la obscura noche son sorprendidos por un hecho que desencadenará a lo largo de sus días posteriores, en especial a una de las estudiantes.

programme.title: Abolición De La Propiedad
programme.desc: En un sótano oscuro, Norma escucha su voz y la de Everio en una vieja grabadora Ampex. Cada que él vuelve a bajar, la detiene. Han estado platicándose sus vidas, varias veces las conversaciones grabadas terminan coincidiendo con las charlas que ellos sostienen. Lo que le preocupa a Norma es que hasta ese día no conocía a Everio y lo último que escuchó fue que él la ahorcaba.

programme.title: Breaking Barriers
programme.desc: In a world where faith and mental health often intersect, "Breaking Barriers: Seeking Help for Mental Health" aims to shatter the stigma surrounding accessing resources for your mental health. This powerful documentary delves into the misconception that reaching out for professional help is a sign of weakness, emphasizing that true healing often requires a blend of faith, prayer, and professional support. Through heartfelt interviews with mental health professionals, spiritual leaders, and individuals who have faced mental health challenges, the documentary paints a vivid picture of hope and resilience. Viewers will hear personal stories of struggle and triumph, learn from those who have lost loved ones to suicide, and discover actionable solutions to combat the ongoing mental health crisis in our communities.

programme.title: Breaking Barriers
programme.desc: In a world where faith and mental health often intersect, "Breaking Barriers: Seeking Help for Mental Health" aims to shatter the stigma surrounding accessing resources for your mental health. This powerful documentary delves into the misconception that reaching out for professional help is a sign of weakness, emphasizing that true healing often requires a blend of faith, prayer, and professional support. Through heartfelt interviews with mental health professionals, spiritual leaders, and individuals who have faced mental health challenges, the documentary paints a vivid picture of hope and resilience. Viewers will hear personal stories of struggle and triumph, learn from those who have lost loved ones to suicide, and discover actionable solutions to combat the ongoing mental health crisis in our communities.

programme.title: The Watcher
programme.desc: The Watcher is an exciting psychological thriller that takes a unique look into the minds of both a serial killer and the man who must, reluctantly, pursue him. In an almost Hitchcockian way, the film quickly introduces us to the killer, David Allen Griffin, played by Keanu Reeves, who for many years, preyed on lonely young women in the Los Angeles area. The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

programme.title: Captive State
programme.desc: After 10 years of extraterrestrial occupation, residents of Chicago must decide whether to continue to live under alien rule or support the resistance. When young Gabriel Drummond joins the insurgency, he soon finds himself under careful scrutiny from a shadowy figure who's trying to crush the rebellion and its plans for freedom.

programme.title: The Fourth Kind
programme.desc: Since the 1960s, a disproportionate number of the population in and around Nome, Alaska, have gone missing. Despite FBI investigations, the disappearances remain a mystery. Dr. Abigail Tyler (Milla Jovovich), a psychologist, may be on the verge of blowing the unsolved cases wide open when, during the course of treating her patients, she finds evidence of alien abductions.

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

programme.title: Doomsday
programme.desc: When the first outbreak of the Reaper virus hit Scotland, Eden Sinclair was one of the last to escape containment and had to leave her mother behind. Twenty-five years later, Maj. Eden Sinclair (Rhona Mitra) leads a team back into the hot zone to find a counteragent to the virus, which has re-emerged in London. She and her comrades wage a desperate battle for survival against feral survivors, as they try to prevent it from ushering in a new dark age.

programme.title: Prince of Darkness
programme.desc: Poking around in a church cellar, a priest (Donald Pleasence) finds an otherworldly vial filled with slime. Frightened, he brings his discovery to a circle of top scholars and scientists, who eventually learn that the strange liquid is the essence of Satan. The slime then begins to seep out, turning some of the academics into zombified killers. As the possessed battle the survivors, student Kelly (Susan Blanchard) is infected by a large quantity of the liquid and becomes Satan personified.

programme.title: Vivarium
programme.desc: Hoping to find the perfect place to live, a couple travel to a suburban neighborhood in which all the houses look identical. But when they try to leave the labyrinth-like development, each road mysteriously takes them back to where they started.

programme.title: The Last Exorcism
programme.desc: After years of gulling the faithful, cleric Cotton Marcus feels remorse and decides to expose his chicanery through filming a documentary. With a crew in tow, Marcus arrives at the Louisiana farm of devout Louis Sweetzer, who believes that his daughter, Nell, is possessed. When the usual stunts fail, he realizes that he is face-to-face with real evil and must summon true faith to protect Nell, the others and himself from demonic power.

programme.title: Prey for the Devil
programme.desc: The Roman Catholic Church combats a global rise in demonic possessions by reopening schools to train priests to perform exorcisms. Although nuns are forbidden to perform this ritual, a professor recognizes Sister Ann's gifts and agrees to train her. Thrust onto the spiritual frontline, she soon finds herself in a battle for the soul of a young girl who's possessed by the same demon that tormented her own mother years earlier.

programme.title: Shadow of the Vampire
programme.desc: F. W. Murnau (John Malkovich) is struggling to create his silent classic "Nosferatu" on location in Eastern Europe. The director is obsessed with making this the most authentic vampire movie ever. To that end, Murnau has employed a real vampire, Max Schreck (Willem Dafoe), explaining to the crew that he is the ultimate of that new breed, the "method actor" -- trained by Stanislavsky himself. Schreck will appear only in character and only at night.

As Alice's behavior becomes more and more concerning, Jessica intervenes only to realize that Chauncey is much more than the stuffed toy bear she believed him to be.

programme.title: Obambo
programme.desc: Present day March 15 2021, it is night Zabron arrives at the haunted house that is believed to have Obambo ghost. Short while Tama arrives as well. Zabron draw a knife ready to fight the ghost Obambo but Tama stops him. Tama tells Zabron that he must know the history first before fighting Obambo because it is believed that is the most powerful ghost than any ghost that Zabron has fought before. 2003, it is night, Zunda and his family; his wife Mona, younger sister Anna and younger brother Leonard are getting things in the house that is believed to have Obambo ghost. Zunda tells Leonard to hurry up because he has a lot to do tomorrow at his work. The family members are at dinner table eating. Suddenly Obambo hand take Leonard food. Leonard panics and drop the spoon. Other members look at him surprisingly. Leonard get the spoon under the table and sees Obambo’s feet. Leonard panics again and asks everyone if they have seen it to which everyone is surprised. Zunda tells Leonard to go to his room and take his foolishness there. Leonard tells his brother that they are not alone in the house and leaves. Anna laughs at Leonard. On the way to the his room, Leonard heard unsettling noises and see red flashes and smoke coming from one of the room. He stops turn around and investigate the matter before a door open in the other direction. Leonard turns and he can see a person resembles his brother stand beside the door. Leonard calls him but no answer. His brother Zunda comes and asks him who is talking to and Leonard says that he saw his brother standing on the door. Zunda tells Leonard not to stand near the room where noises are heard as the house owner asks Zunda not to open that room. Zunda gets angry and tell him to go to his room and sleep. His wife Mona and asks him why they should not open the room, Zunda replies that the house owner asked him to do that as there are his belongings there. It is mid night. Anna gets to bed. Obambo is seen in the shadow getting near her bed and put something on the flowers. Her bedsheet is pulled off. She gets up worried and take the bedsheet and cover her up. After few seconds the bedsheet is pulled again and she wakes and sit on the bed. Anna starts to look up and sees Obambo in the ceiling. She screams. The family members hears the scream and get in Anna’s room quickly. She is terrified.

programme.title: Dice
programme.desc: Dice tells the story of AJ, a young, nerdy and smart stockbroker who moved to Lagos from London at the age of 10. He has been working at Abubakar Investments for several years and has become very successful at closing sales deals and making 'little' commission from them. AJ is perceived to have a dual personality; one he exhibits at work as a young naÃ¯ve and nerdy individual and the other outside work as an extrovert. At work, his colleagues Emeka and Bala often throw shade at him and bully him because they find him extremely boring and simple. They also find him slow because of his inability to stand up for himself and demand his rightful 3% Commission. Unknown to them AJ has a good life outside of work as he often hangs out at the club with his best friend Segun, both are serial ladies and men. Emeka & Bala are aware that Mr. Abubakar constantly cheats him off his commission, but are unaware that he has taken matters into his own hands by using clients' funds to engage in side hustles beneficial to him. This side hustling however gets him in trouble when he loses a client's money and has to borrow money from a gangster which he fails to pay back on time. His external deals also lead to the company being investigated by EFFD as several holes have been spotted in the company's financials. Having had bad luck with ladies in the past, AJ finally finds love in the weirdest place when he meets Amaka and finds himself having to fight for the woman of his dreams who he also puts in danger.

programme.title: Once Upon a Family

programme.title: Tour du Faso
programme.desc: It’s Culture Clash in a sporty way! 1987 the Tour du Faso first took place in Burkina Faso. Up until now it is Africa’s biggest cycling race. Within ten stages, cyclists from Africa and Europa are crossing the sandy desert in an existing race. Amid the clash of European perfectionism and African realities we follow European hobby adventurers and African local heroes in their passionate fight for making their dreams come true. Yet, our film does not focus on the question of who will win – instead, it pays particular attention on the value of the protagonists’ experiences. The race has still retained its original and very African character as a “flawed” – but much more sympathetic – copy of the Tour de France, its European model. Some parts of the course are mere sand tracks, the advertising “caravan” consists of a single car and the cyclists are camping in the savanna during the race. TOUR DU FASO takes the audience on a time travel back to pre-commercialised decades. Following the Tour du Faso, we will get to know more about cycling, Africa and the extraordinary fighting spirit of the underdogs. Here it is still the taking part that counts...

programme.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber
programme.desc: Few people love anything more than Jon Gruden loves football. Suzy Kolber digs into the singular obsession that made him a Super Bowl winner, a wildly popular Monday Night Football analyst, and a social media sensation nobody saw coming. Jon reflects on the philosophy that drove every reinvention—including how he's navigated life since his coaching career came to a sudden end—and whether the sideline is still calling.

programme.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber
programme.desc: For four decades, sports broadcasting pioneers Suzy Kolber and Lisa Salters have told everyone else's story. The championship runs. The comebacks. The night Damar Hamlin's heart stopped, and millions hung on their every word. Through all of it, their own stories - flourishing in a male-dominated business, juggling single motherhood with a demanding career - stayed off the mic. Until now.

programme.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber
programme.desc: Digit Murphy built women's hockey from the bench and the boardroom - coaching, fighting and lobbying long before the lights came on. Hilary Knight became the face of women's hockey, setting records, winning Olympic gold twice, and carrying a sport on her back. Suzy Kolber sits down with both trailblazers to examine what it costs to love a sport that didn't always love you back.

programme.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber
programme.desc: Former Canadian quarterback Sam Rapoport creates NFL paths for women while developing global flag football; Mexican quarterback Diana Flores elevates the sport internationally following a featured commercial; broadcaster Suzy Kolber interviews both leaders on taking flag football to the LA twenty twenty-eight Olympics.

programme.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber
programme.desc: Steve Young redefined the quarterback position, setting records as both passer and rusher during his Hall of Fame career; behind the scenes, he battled crippling anxiety that was tougher than any opponent; when football was over, he built a $10 billion business from scratch; Suzy Kolber reconnects with her former broadcast partner to find out what it takes to be a dual threat — on the field and in life.

programme.desc: With a record number of Americans trading city life for homes in the suburbs, relationships between neighbors are being put to the test. Each half-hour episode of "Neighborhood Wars" takes viewers into the homes and backyards of neighbors across the country with some of the most unexpected and emotionally charged events caught on camera. Featuring footage from cell phones, drones, home security cameras and more, the series showcases the kindness and conflict between real-life neighbors throughout the US.

programme.title: The "L Word"
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.title: The Long Haul
programme.desc: From life's lows like coping with difficult medical diagnoses, to highs like the thrill of moving into a new home or the joys of pregnancy and babies, we watch as the couples experience the many facets of marriage.

Cold Case Files? produced by the team behind Investigative ReportsTM, digs deep into the past, following detectives as they strive to breathe new life into "cold" unsolved crimes. Armed with the latest DNA technology and with dogged determination, investigators seek new leads in hopes of bringing the guilty to justice decades after the crimes have been committed. programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: I Married a Stranger
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.title: Anzac Battlefields: The Western Front
programme.desc: The ANZAC's feel the brunt of Germany's Operation Michael, the biggest offensive of World War I.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: General Nenarokov arrives from army HQ with reports of a secret chemical-weapons test site. Allies back an ultimatum on reciprocal chemical warfare but need proof the Wehrmacht will use toxins. Aerial reconnaissance must find the facility and a weak point in the German encirclement.

programme.title: Architects of Darkness
programme.desc: The drug addicted dilettante who created the Luftwaffe. Goering was at Hitler's side from the ill-fated Beer Hall putsch of 1923 until the estrangement between the two in April 1945 when Hitler ordered Goering's arrest.

programme.title: Afghanistan 1979-1989
programme.desc: This project aims to understand the causes of the Afghan war (1979-1989) and its accurate coverage. It started on Dec 12, 1979, when the Politburo members (Leonid Brezhnev, Yuri Andropov, Andrey Gromyko, Dmitry Ustinov) decided to send troops. It was the Soviet Union's first operation outside the Warsaw Pact, becoming their longest and forgotten war.

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: Rockets and guided missiles are the essential component of any military arsenal. By definition, rockets are unguided and follow the laws of physics and trajectory; whereas missiles are guided, either remotely or internally. There are many different types of missiles, including anti-tank and anti-aircraft missiles, surface to air missiles, and ballistic missiles.

programme.title: Impossible Peace
programme.desc: These are the best of times for the US. Prohibition doesn't stop anyone from having a good time, the country is on wheels or listening to the radio, welcoming the talkies or investing in the stock market with reckless optimism. It's that brief spell they call the Jazz Age, the age of Charles Lindbergh and Babe Ruth.

programme.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Transport Aircraft
programme.desc: Providing exact numbers, specifications, and plenty of facts, Military Aircraft of the 20th Century provides an encyclopedic look at aircrafts used by any military force in the 20th century. This entry focuses on transport aircraft, such as the Junkers JU-52, Douglas DC-3, PBY Catalina, Short Sunderland, and more.

programme.title: Wings of Destruction
programme.desc: The first Marine jet squadron came in November 1947 when VMF-122 fielded the FH Phantom, and later VMF-311 would be the first Marine jet squadron to be used in combat providing close air support. Today, Marine aviation is organized to support the Marine Air-Ground Task Force, as the aviation combat element, providing assault support, electronic warfare, control of aircraft and missiles, and more.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: As Hitler focussed on Russia, the situation in the Pacific developed to epic proportions when the Japanese air force attacked the American Naval Fleet at Pearl Harbour on the 7th of December. This immediately brought the USA into the Theatre of War.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: With Britain no longer facing Hitler alone, the first GIs arrived in the UK. As Singapore fell, the Allies looked on in horror as Japan also had control of Java, Burma and New Guinea, as they edged ever closer towards Australia.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: As Hitler focussed on Russia, the situation in the Pacific developed to epic proportions when the Japanese air force attacked the American Naval Fleet at Pearl Harbour on the 7th of December. This immediately brought the USA into the Theatre of War.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Landing Craft - Establishing Beachead. Silent film.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: This episode takes you through the tense hours of the largest seaborne invasion in history: Operation Neptune, often referred to as D-Day. The operation began the liberation of France and laid the foundations of the Allied victory on the Western Front.

programme.title: Patton's Finest Hour: The Battle Of The Bulge
programme.desc: On the battle of the Ardennes. British tanks advance; infantry row across a small stream in Holland; machine guns are manned; prisoners are marched to the rear; German citizens greet British troops; German prisoners push a wounded comrade in a cart; civilians are evacuated from Bastogne.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific looks at the campaign in the Solomon Islands directed at the Japanese stronghold on Bougainville. Allied troops eventually secure the beach and slowly fight their way across the island. The Japanese launch a counter-attack, but they are defeated in the Battle of Empress Augusta Bay. After brutal fighting, the island is secured.

programme.title: Marie Antoinette: The Trial of a Queen
programme.desc: On the night of August 2, 1793, Marie Antoinette is transferred to the Conciergerie. Her husband has been sent to the guillotine, her children have been taken away, all the other European monarchies have abandoned her and France is calling for her head. She was judged as a queen, her tragic death made her immortal. Thanks to secret documents freshly decoded this film grasps her last days.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths: The Odyssey
programme.desc: The Suitors, informed by Melantho - one of Penelope's servants - learned that the queen had fooled them. They locked her up in the gynaeceum. Meanwhile, Odysseus meets Athena who tells him that he is indeed in Ithaca.

programme.title: For Athens
programme.desc: This immersion into Ancient Greece, filmed in the original language, follows in the footsteps of Themistocles and his fearsome adversary Xerxes. Through two spectacular military engagements, one on land, the other naval: the battles of Marathon (490 BC) and Salamis (480 BC).

programme.title: Ships That Changed the World
programme.desc: The arrival of menacing German U-Boats in international waters rewrote the rulebook on maritime conflict, and so Britain began rapidly converting its merchant vessels into battleships. Sea battles such as those at Cornell and Jutland saw the two empire's differing approaches put to the test - pitting Germany's sub-surface sneak attacks and strong defenses against Britain's brute force.

programme.title: 1000 AD: Anglo-Saxons vs Vikings
programme.desc: What was it really like to live just before the end of the first millennium? 1000 AD recreates life circa 999 AD, showing the everyday lives, loves and passions of the Anglo-Saxon people. A soap opera-style drama runs alongside interviews with leading historians who paint a revealing picture of the political and social structure of pre-Norman Britain.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: It's said that every photograph steals a piece of a soul. What happens when the subject is dead? Lisa becomes obsessed with a photo of her boyfriend's brother, killed in Vietnam. As her fixation deepens, she experiences waking visions of the soldier and believes the picture has a life of its own. When her daughters report supernatural encounters, Lisa realizes the spirit is taking control.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some believe knowledge comes from reason, others from intuition. When Selena moves into an old Michigan house, she senses danger. The attic makes her dizzy, the kitchen feels watched, and photos reveal ghostly faces. With proof of a haunting, she and her sister seek a psychic's help. He confirms the worst-the house is a place of suffering, trapping both the living and the dead.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: The Bible tells of a man possessed by a legion of demons. In Stamford, Connecticut, 12-year-old David has nightmares of a demonic old man flying toward his home. His terror grows daily. His mother is unsure how to respond-until David is physically attacked by an unseen force. Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren discover demons within him. They must act before he is lost to darkness.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some Native American myths tell of supernatural creatures guarding the dead. Early explorers spoke of werewolves and the Wendigo. When Randy discovers a Native American skeleton beneath his home, he recites an incantation, hoping to make contact. Soon, a cold, growling monster appears, attacking his loved ones. The spirits don't want the house-they want him, and they won't let go.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Modern science suggests we are all connected by energy. This may explain why Romie feels drawn to an abandoned house in Tucson, Arizona. After moving in, nightmares bleed into reality, and she sees a shadowy spirit. A clairvoyant urges her to communicate with it, but fear holds her back. As the entity targets only her, Romie begins to question her sanity-is the house haunted, or is she cursed?

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some believe knowledge comes from reason, others from intuition. When Selena moves into an old Michigan house, she senses danger. programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some believe ghosts are human spirits seeking peace, while others say they are inhuman entities that feed on fear. Jan's lonely son Cody seems happy with his imaginary friend-until his behavior turns violent. When Cody reveals his friend lives in a red box in a cemetery, Jan seeks help from a Native American shaman. Through ancient rituals, she battles a force far more sinister than a lost soul.

programme.title: Where is Hitler? A Hot Trail During the Cold War
programme.desc: Did the Fuhrer escape with a submarine to Argentina, was he living in Washington D.C. or is there proof that he committed suicide? FBI, British intelligence and German authorities followed every rumour, hint and trace. Previously undisclosed files, interrogation tapes, rare footage and photographs have been compiled in an attempt to ascertain the circumstances surrounding Adolf Hitler's death.

programme.title: Mystical Hidden Scenery: Jusanji Pond, Cheongsong EP.3 <11>
programme.desc: Completed in 1720, Jusanji Pond is fed by clear waters from Byeolbawi Rock and surrounded by lush forests of Juwangsan Mountain, creating a serene, otherworldly atmosphere.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret Garden: Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace EP.2 <2>
programme.desc: Nakseonjae combines noble residence style with palace architecture, featuring unique decorative patterns that showcase late Joseon craftsmanship. Enjoy a break at the exclusive Rear Garden of Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Painting with Lacquer: The Process of Color Lacquer Art <82>
programme.desc: On a lacquered surface, colored patterns are drawn by hand, layer after layer. As each coat is applied and dried, time, patience, and vision build a work of beauty. Listen as brushstrokes blend with the passage of time.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Tradition Shaped by Many Hands: Gat Making Master <92>
programme.desc: Finely split bamboo forms the brim, while horsehair is woven into the crown. The Brim Maker, Crown Maker, and Gat Assembler bring their skills together to complete one elegant gat. Experience the harmony of three traditional crafts.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Crafting Roof Tiles: Roof Tile Making Master <95>
programme.desc: Clay is kneaded, shaped in molds, and hardened by sunlight and fire to become roof tiles for a hanok. The artisan balances strength with graceful curves in every piece. Hear the steady rhythm of earth taking shape.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Forging My Protector: Crafting the Ornamental Blade <83>
programme.desc: Shaping a blade begins with fire and hammer. In the forging of this small sword lies the essence of strength, rhythm, and tradition. Hear the iron sing as each strike reveals the artisan’s devotion.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Iron and Flame: Forging a Traditional Cauldron <89>
programme.desc: Creating a cast iron cauldron demands fierce heat and skilled hands. As molten metal meets the mold, everyday tradition takes shape. Hear the depth of Korean casting craft in each heavy echo.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Hand Skills of Joseon Artisans: Hat Making Master <77>
programme.desc: The tanggeon, a horsehair hat once worn under the gat, reflected dignity in the daily lives of Joseon men. Densely woven by skilled hands, it reveals the calm elegance and restraint found in traditional craftsmanship.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Exquisite Details of Joseon: Traditional Headwear <61>
programme.desc: With threads finer than hair, artisans weave traditional headgear that once reflected dignity and etiquette. Manggeon and Tanggeon, more than mere accessories, embody the refined aesthetic of Joseon craftsmanship.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret of Hanji that Lasts a Thousand Years: Stripping Mulberry Bark <54>
programme.desc: Traditional Hanji possesses excellent value, enduring for a thousand years without changing. Let’s appreciate the process of stripping the bark from mulberry trees, the main raw material in the creation of traditional Hanji.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Carrying on Korea’s Archery Tradition: Bow and Arrow Making Master <93>
programme.desc: Bamboo, horn, sinew, and wood come together to form a traditional bow and arrow. Each material is carefully shaped through countless steps, preserving Korea’s long archery tradition. Listen to the rhythm of carving and polishing.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Essence of Korean Traditional Dance: Salpuri Dance <34>
programme.desc: Since ancient times, people have held shamanistic rituals to dispel bad luck for the year. The Salpuri dance is an improvised dance performed by shamans during these rituals to ward off negative energy.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Legacy of Traditional Metal Type: Metal Type Master <19>
programme.desc: Metal type refers to various sizes of type made by melting metal and pouring it into molds for letterpress printing. Learn about the history and production process of metal type.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Full of Sensations: Royal Confectionery Tea Table <2>
programme.desc: Let’s make a tea table full of sensations! Experience various delicacies filled with dedication and handmade taste, such as mugwort rice cake balls (Ssukguridan) and twisted flour dough flower rice cakes.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Beauty of Patience: Ottchil Master <45>
programme.desc: A Ottchil Master is an artisan skilled in decorating objects and furniture surfaces beautifully with ottchil (natural varnish/lacquer) and shells. Appreciate the works filled with the dedication and patience of the Lacquerware Master.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Artistic Peak of Knotting: Knot Master <50>
programme.desc: Knot Masters are artisans who use strings to make various types of knots and tassels. Appreciate the works of Knot Masters who have reached the height of art in Dahoe knot making.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Way of the Scholar: Nakjukjangdo <46>
programme.desc: Jangdo is a small knife carried on the body for daily use, self-defense, or as an ornament. Nakjukjangdo is a traditional knife made using the Nakjuk technique. Appreciate Nakjukjangdo, used while walking the path of scholars.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: A Bowl Made by the Sea: Tongyeong Neomul Bibimbap <35>
programme.desc: There are various regional versions of traditional bibimbap, but Tongyeong's version is accompanied by tofu soup. Experience the special bibimbap of Tongyeong.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Sound of Swamp: Upo Wetlands <26>
programme.desc: How much time has passed in Upo Wetlands? It is a story of lives that have settled and live like masters in the place provided by the river.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Elegant Beauty of Hanok: A Day in an Old House <10>
programme.desc: Feel the charm of traditional Hanok through a day in an old house, from the sound of sweeping the wide yard before sunrise, the scene of a mother cooking, to the crackling sound of burning firewood.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Scenery with Royal Tombs: Gwangneung <9>
programme.desc: Gwangneung Forest is a dense forest 30 times the size of Yeouido in Seoul, known for its ecological stability and species diversity. Experience the sounds and scenery of Gwangneung.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Peaceful Mudflats: The Vast Mudflats at Sunset, Suncheon Bay <8>
programme.desc: Located on the southern coast, Suncheon Bay features stunning reed fields and Salicornia (glasswort) colonies. It is home to diverse tidal flat creatures and rare birds like the black-faced spoonbill.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Mystical Hidden Scenery: Jusanji Pond, Cheongsong EP.2 <10>
programme.desc: Completed in 1720, Jusanji Pond is fed by clear waters from Byeolbawi Rock and surrounded by lush forests of Juwangsan Mountain, creating a serene, otherworldly atmosphere.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Autumn Forest of the Royal Tombs: With King Sejo's Regret, Gwangneung <17>
programme.desc: The resting place of King Sejo and Queen Jeonghui, Gwangneung Forest in Namyangju covers an expansive area of 11 square kilometers, boasting ecological stability and species diversity. Enjoy a walk through its scenic forest paths.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - La viuda negra
programme.desc: Una terrible confusión pone en riesgo la libertad de un hombre tras el terrible asesinato de un importante empresario canadiense, pero el destino tiene sorpresas para todos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Secretos de las mucamas de Trump
programme.desc: Declaraciones de mujeres que trabajaron para la familia Trump y secretos que salen a la luz después de las fuertes palabras del presidente contra miles de personas.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Ganarle a la muerte
programme.desc: La desgracia de un hombre que, con fuerza y voluntad, cambió su vida tratando de ayudar a sus seres amados. Cuando apenas emprendía el viaje para vivir el sueño americano, la tragedia se cruza en su camino.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Supremacistas: Las redes del odio

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Asesinadas
programme.desc: La historia de cinco mujeres que han sufrido de la violencia física. Un desenlace común tras una vida llena de tortura, la muerte es inevitable. Los feminicidios es alarmante, el porcentaje aumenta.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Desafiar el olvido

programme.desc: Un programa especial que muestra la vida de cuatro jugadores de fútbol americano en Brownsville, Texas; quienes se enfrentan a una dura realidad de violencia, pobreza y drogas, pero siempre con ilusión de una vida mejor.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Un crimen casi perfecto
programme.desc: Una hermosa mujer y de buen corazón, es asesinada por su esposo, un hombre manipulador y frío que dejó abandonada a su propia hija en los brazos de su madre fallecida.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Narcosubmarinos: Viaje al fondo del mal
programme.desc: Por décadas, el narcotráfico ha navegado sigilosamente por los mares más peligrosos durante años, para poder transportar su mercancía, poniendo en peligro la vida de sus tripulantes a cambio de dinero.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Radiografía de una masacre

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 67
programme.desc: Joaquín le asegura a Pascual que Tomás está vendiendo drogas en el colegio. Celina sufre al saber que Augusto no está interesado en ella. Mía, Roberta y sus compañeros del colegio disfrutan del viaje en Cozumel.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 68
programme.desc: Alma y Franco se encuentran en un restaurante y pasan juntos el año nuevo. Miguel salva a Mía cuando intentaba brincar de un muelle. José roba unos papeles y Teo se echa la culpa. Nico acepta la condición de su mamá para poder seguir en el colegio.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 69
programme.desc: Un amigo de Diego le da un CD a Roberta para que se lo entregue. Peter le pregunta a Mía si sabe que su papá anda con Valeria. El papá de Tomás sabe de qué se trata la fundación del director y quiere formar parte de ella.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 70
programme.desc: Tomás les cuenta a sus amigos que Joaquín lo obliga a vender droga. Mía y Celina descubren que Vico les mintió para que se enojaran. Joaquín planea que Tomás venda droga afuera del colegio. Mía le pide a Alma que investigue todo sobre Valeria.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 71
programme.desc: Tomás le dice al director que él no es quien vende las drogas, se escapa de la escuela y comienzan a buscarlo. Franco piensa que Alma le manda mensajes de amor. Pascual regaña a la maestra de baile por culpa de Roberta.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 72
programme.desc: Miguel distrae al prefecto para poder llevar a cabo su plan de encontrar las drogas y ayudar a Tomás. El director contrata perros de seguridad para encontrar drogas en la escuela. Roberta descubre que Alma y Mía se traen algo entre manos.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 73
programme.desc: Roberta no deja de pensar en Diego. Mía y Lupita ayudan a arreglarse a Celina para la gran cita con Augusto. Alma y Mía confirman que Valeria y Franco se fueron juntos de viaje. Mía descubre a Miguel coqueteando con otra chava.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 74
programme.desc: Mía llora desconsolada porque sabe que Miguel desprecia su manera de ser. Roberta visita a Lupita y se queda a dormir en su casa. Nico deja plantada a Karen por quedarse en casa de Lupita. Celina tiene su primera cita con Augusto.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 75
programme.desc: Galia cuestiona a Pilar sobre el consumo de drogas de Joaquín. Roberta recibe un mensaje de Facundo. Durante el ensayo, Celina les muestra las canciones que escribió Mía. Alma teme que su exesposo le quite a su hija. El padre de Roberta llega a buscarla.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 76
programme.desc: Alma le cuenta a Franco que el papá de Roberta se la quiere llevar a España. Mía tiene una fuerte discusión con Vico, quien la golpea. Roberta se sorprende al ver a su papá y se entera que se tiene que ir con él. Mía le reclama a Julieta por su canción.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 77
programme.desc: Julieta cuestiona a Miguel sobre lo que realmente siente por Mía. Roberta se niega a irse con su padre y tiene un plan para lograrlo. Mía insiste en que Alicia salga con su papá. Diego le pide a Roberta que ensayen por la tarde, pero se va con Facundo.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 78
programme.desc: Diego descubre que Roberta también está en la banda de Facundo y le pone un ultimátum. Mía se entera que Franco terminó la relación con Valeria. Diego le pide a Roberta que siga haciéndose pasar como su novia ante sus padres. Miguel es amonestado.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 79
programme.desc: Lulú renuncia después de haber tenido problemas con las alumnas. Roberta llega a un acuerdo con Diego para estar en las dos bandas. Franco logra que el director no expulse a Miguel. Esteban recibe un anónimo y piensa que lo envía Mía.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 80
programme.desc: Lulú se disculpa con sus alumnas por no ser honesta con ellas. Celina le pide a Mía que asista al ensayo de la banda en su lugar. Vico quiere que Joaquín deje a Pilar. Diego le dice a Facundo que adora a Roberta y le pide que la saque de su banda.

programme.title: Pasión Capítulo 6
programme.desc: Doña Francisca accede a llevar la carta de Camila. Santiago logra caminar de nuevo. Antillano roba otro barco y se lo cuenta a Foreman. Llega la carta de Camila y Rita la lee y la rompe. Timoteo le dice a Camila que se casen y ella pide ayuda a Lisabeta.

programme.title: Pasión Capítulo 7
programme.desc: Francisca le dice a Camila que le ayudará a escapar. Timoteo se da cuenta que Camila se fue y corre a Lisabeta y Francisca de la casa. Camila logra escapar de la casa pero cuando está por zarpar el barco, Timoteo la encuentra y se la lleva.

programme.title: Pasión Capítulo 8
programme.desc: Santiago llega al puerto con Vasco, pero no averiguan nada de Camila. Timoteo pone a Camila entre venderla a un burdel o casarse con él. Timoteo muestra el testamento a Lisabeta y Francisca donde aclara su herencia, pero después lo rompe.

programme.title: Pasión Capítulo 9
programme.desc: Semanas después Don Timoteo y Camila se casan. Epifanio le cuenta a Mercedes de la boda y ella le escribe a Ricardo. Alberto le pregunta a Manuela quién es el amante de Úrsula. Ricardo va a ver a Mercedes y le cuenta que Timoteo se casó con una Camila.

programme.title: Pasión Capítulo 10
programme.desc: Ricardo visita a Timoteo para asegurarse de que la herencia de Lisabeta haya quedado intacta y conocer a su esposa. Justo le pregunta directo a Ofelia si Santiago es hijo de Don Jorge. Don Jorge le dice a Úrsula que le buscará esposo. Timoteo fallece.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 17
programme.desc: Crisanta confronta a Dominga y le pregunta si Esmeralda es aquella niña que nació muerta. Adrián le confiesa a su padre que está enamorado de Graciela. José Armando le cuenta a su madre sobre los planes de devolverle la vista a Esmeralda.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 18
programme.desc: Graciela, muy agobiada, visita a Adrián en el hospital. Fátima se preocupa por la cercanía entre Adrián y Graciela. Rodolfo se niega a aceptar que José Armando se case con alguien más que no sea Graciela.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 19
programme.desc: Dominga presiona a Crisanta para que diga la verdad sobre el origen de Esmeralda y así poderla librar de Lucio. Rodolfo amenaza con desaparecer a Esmeralda si no se mantiene alejada de su hijo.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 20
programme.desc: Lucio asegura que Esmeralda le pertenece por haberle salvado la vida tiempo atrás. Blanca le cuenta a José Armando que Rodolfo los vigila de cerca a él y Esmeralda. José Armando se empeña en ayudar a Esmeralda a recuperar la vista.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 21
programme.desc: José Armando no permite que Fátima lo acompañe a la ciudad y ésta se va con Esmeralda. El Dr. Lucio enfurece cuando sabe que Esmeralda fue a la ciudad. Adrián no está dispuesto a renunciar a su amor por Graciela. Esmeralda tiene posibilidades de ver.

programme.title: Mañana Es Para Siempre Capítulo 133
programme.desc: Erika lleva a cabo los preparativos de su boda con Eduardo. Eduardo le cuenta a Fernanda que Artemio quiere deshacerse de los Elizalde. Bárbara se molesta al saber que Gonzalo ha decidido que el hijo de Aníbal sea su nuevo heredero.

programme.title: Mañana Es Para Siempre Capítulo 134
programme.desc: Steve consigue un acta de nacimiento falsa para que Eduardo se case con Erika. Eduardo le cuenta a Steve los planes de destrucción que Bárbara tiene en contra de Fernanda. Santiago sospecha que Fernanda está enamorada de Eduardo.

programme.title: Mañana Es Para Siempre Capítulo 135
programme.desc: Eduardo y Fernanda idean un plan para poder rescatar a Liliana. Chelsy sospecha que Eduardo está interesado en Fernanda. Fernanda enfrenta a Bárbara para saber si fue la amante de Damián.

programme.title: Mañana Es Para Siempre Capítulo 136
programme.desc: Damián lleva cabo sus planes para secuestrar a Aurora. Chelsy lleva a cabo sus planes para demostrarle a Erika que Eduardo le está siendo infiel. Eduardo le confiesa al padre Bosco el inmenso amor que siente por Fernanda.

programme.title: Mañana Es Para Siempre Capítulo 137
programme.desc: Erika le pide a Steve que la ayude a evitar que Eduardo cancele su boda. Priscila comienza a sentir un gran interés por Vladimir. Fernanda sospecha que Bárbara tiene un fuerte interés en Aurora.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa tiene que ceder para ayudar al Chema a escapar de prisión. Leonor tiene secretos insospechados, y planea usar a Ximena de carnada para atrapar a líderes del narcotráfico.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Roberto reclama que los Casillas lo usan para lavar dinero del narco y quiere salirse, pero ya es muy tarde. Leonor y Nevárez visitan al Chema en prisión y lo vinculan con Elsa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se encuentra cara a cara con Danilo Ferro y comienza a usar su identidad. Leonor registra el negocio de Matilde y hace que la arresten por todo el material importante que encuentra.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Bigotes le dispara a Nevárez frente a su hija. Agonizando, Pedro ruega a Victoria que deje México, porque ya el país es muy peligroso. Matilde conoce a Elsa, y ambas son manipuladas por el Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa cree tener el camino libre para ser gobernadora, pero Victoria anuncia su candidatura. Bigotes está herido, escapa de los hombres de Chema e intenta darle toda la información a Leonor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba sugiere a Matilde que visite al padre Lázaro en busca de ayuda espiritual, pero ella confiesa que Aurelio está vivo. Tijeras rechaza volver a la cárcel para ayudar a escapar a Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria recibe una carta seductora y se ilusiona, sin saber que detrás está Aurelio, quien le dona 5 millones de pesos a nombre de Danilo. Matilde promete a Guernica delatar a Chacorta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema le pide a Andrews que vigile a Elsa porque ella es pieza clave para su huida de la cárcel. Leonor sigue a Ximena y descubre nuevas pistas que la sorprenden.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le pide a Lay que consiga pasaportes españoles para él, Mónica y Heriberto porque necesitan huir. Mónica tiene miedo de perder a su bebé y pide que la lleven a un hospital.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema manda a Tijeras y Tostado a cumplir su amenaza contra el hijo de Chacorta. Víctor recibe un disparo en cada pierna. Doña Alba le reclama a Aurelio por el dolor que sufre la familia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victor culpa a su padre y su tío de la desgracia que está viviendo, y le dice a Chacorta que ellos solo siembran muerte y destrucción en la familia. Mónica está desconsolada tras perder al bebé.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La guerra entre bandas del narcotráfico apenas comienza. Aurelio promete venganza: sugiere a Chacorta que trasladen el negocio a España y vigilen a Chema, quien podría escapar de prisión.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Pantaleón es secuestrado por Tostado y Tijeras, quienes lo torturan. Aurelio retoma sus negocios con el general Montoya, cambia de planes y viaja a Colombia para comenzar su venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Chacorta que mató al Tostado, y aunque vengó a Víctor, aún no ha terminado. Anuncia nuevos negocios con Venezuela y dice que comenzará a llamarse Danilo Ferro.

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: Because of a time warp, a supermarket worker finds himself fighting in medieval England with a chainsaw and a '73 Oldsmobile.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Sinister
programme.desc: True-crime writer Ellison Oswald is in a slump; he hasn't had a bestseller in more than 10 years and is becoming increasingly desperate for a hit. So, when he discovers the existence of a snuff film showing the deaths of a family, he vows to solve the mystery. He moves his own family into the victims' home and gets to work. However, when old film footage and other clues hint at the presence of a supernatural force, Ellison learns that living in the house may be fatal.

programme.title: Prey for the Devil
programme.desc: The Roman Catholic Church combats a global rise in demonic possessions by reopening schools to train priests to perform exorcisms. Although nuns are forbidden to perform this ritual, a professor recognizes Sister Ann's gifts and agrees to train her. Thrust onto the spiritual frontline, she soon finds herself in a battle for the soul of a young girl who's possessed by the same demon that tormented her own mother years earlier.

programme.title: Into the Deep
programme.desc: A woman's whirlwind romance with a handsome stranger soon turns into a web of deceit, mistrust and violence aboard his yacht.

programme.title: La La Land
programme.desc: Sebastian (Ryan Gosling) and Mia (Emma Stone) are drawn together by their common desire to do what they love. But as success mounts they are faced with decisions that begin to fray the fragile fabric of their love affair, and the dreams they worked so hard to maintain in each other threaten to rip them apart.

programme.title: Killers

Plus, legendary Latin King of Comedy Paul Rodriguez opens up about his sister’s tragic diabetic death. Hear his heartache and his desire to improve his own personal health. Then, if you’re one of the 42 million Americans struggling with constipation, proctologist Dr. David Rosenfeld shares his top foods that can help you poop! Plus, a sweet trick for a bug-free BBQ!

programme.title: Celeb Haircuts, Face-Kinis & More

programme.title: Rules of Fighting
programme.desc: Dr. Phil talks to couples who say their arguments have brought them to the edge of divorce. Casey and Shari have marathon fights that last up to seven days. Cameras in their home reveal vicious name-calling and threats of divorce. Using two way mirrors and hidden earpieces, Dr. Phil coaches them through their next argument. Plus, an 8-year-old writes in for Dr. Phil's help getting her parents to call a truce. Can Dr. Phil help them end their war of words? The number one predictor of divorce is the way you fight, so find out how to get your point across without putting your marriage in jeopardy.

programme.title: The "L Word"
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.title: The Long Haul
programme.desc: From life's lows like coping with difficult medical diagnoses, to highs like the thrill of moving into a new home or the joys of pregnancy and babies, we watch as the couples experience the many facets of marriage.
