programme.desc: The conquest of Tunisia was a triumph for the United Nations, who on land, sea and air, worked as one. This film, together with another made by American Allies, shows how victory was shaped and achieved. Africa Freed tells chiefly of the part played by British arms as recorded by our cameramen who marched alongside. It is a tribute to those fighting with allies in American and France.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: This episode takes you through the tense hours of the largest seaborne invasion in history: Operation Neptune, often referred to as D-Day. The operation began the liberation of France and laid the foundations of the Allied victory on the Western Front.

programme.title: Living in the Shadow of WWII
programme.desc: Total war extends the battlefields - in the Second World War, for the first time, civilian casualties far outnumbered those of military personnel. And a significant proportion of those casualties were victims of the bombing campaigns waged by both sides. What was the effect of living through 'the Blitz', what precautions were taken, what forms of shelter were constructed?

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: June 6, 1944... Operation Overlord was a colossal undertaking. 150,000 Allied Forces landed on five beaches in Normandy, France. It was the first phase in the liberation of Western Europe. When GIs from the First U.S. Army landed, the Allies believed the Germans would withdraw to the Seine. The American Forces would then advance to Brittany, the banks of the Loire, and Paris, but they were wrong!

programme.title: Guy Martin: D-Day Landing
programme.desc: To mark the 75th anniversary of D-Day, Guy Martin restores a Dakota plane, undergoes brutal training with the Red Devils parachute display team, and parachutes into the Normandy countryside.

programme.title: World of Warships Clash of Titans
programme.desc: On December 7, 1941, Japan attacked Pearl Harbor, aiming to destroy the U.S. fleet and control the Pacific. The U.S. retaliated at the Battle of Midway in 1942, sinking four Japanese carriers. Realizing air power's importance, the U.S. built 95 aircraft carriers in three years, key to victories in Tarawa, Guadalcanal, and Okinawa. The USS Midway, a large carrier, was a symbol of Pacific dominance.

programme.title: Iron Curtain - Life Under Soviet Occupation
programme.desc: By Stalin's 70th birthday in 1949, Soviet domination of Eastern Europe is complete. Cities bear his name, collectivization uproots families, the Church is persecuted, and youth indoctrinated. Jews face new purges, culminating in Prague's show trials. With fear gripping 80 million people, Stalin's death in 1953 finally sparks a wave of hope for change.

programme.title: Architects of Darkness
programme.desc: He was a hardcore Nazi commander and became one of Hitler's cold-blooded killers. His hatred, malice and cruelty were quickly recognised by the Nazi High Command and put to work. Hitler called him 'The Man With The Iron Heart, as he helped design the Holocaust, and was personally responsible for the imprisonment, torture and death of millions.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: As 1942 drew to a close, the Allies were really beginning to make headway. The British made a crucial breakthrough in North Africa, and the Americans pushed the Japanese out of Burma and New Guinea. In Russia the Germans found themselves surrounded.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: The only option for the German Sixth Army at Stalingrad was surrender, while all across Russia the Red Army consolidated their advantage. Also, as German cities encountered the kind of bombing that Britain faced back in 1940, courtesy of the RAF.

programme.title: My Grandparents' War
programme.desc: Kristin Scott Thomas's grandfather William served as a Commanding officer in the Royal Navy throughout WW2. He survived some of the most devastating battles from Dunkirk to D-Day but never spoke about his experiences. For the first time, Kristin uncovers how he saved thousands at Dunkirk and endured the horrors of the Russian Artic convoys. Kristin's journey is packed with revelation and emotion.

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: The tomb of the last queen of Egypt has never been found, despite experts searching for centuries. While many historians believe it is located near a temple to Isis, East of ancient Alexandria, new discoveries indicate that it might be near Taposiris Magna. Through field excavations, 3D modeling and reenactments, this documentary series will retrace the life of Cleopatra.

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: Through new research and 3D imagery, revisit the discovery of boy Pharaoh Tutankhamen and its continuing impact today, 100 years after.

programme.title: Sinking Nazi Battleships: Bismarck & Tirpitz
programme.desc: When the Nazi Battleship Bismarck was launched it was destined to be one of the greatest battleships that ever took to sea. After it sunk the thought to be unsinkable HMS Hood, Winston Churchill uttered just three words - Sink the Bismarck.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: His first wife was Metis. His second, who was known as his wife on Olympus, was the jealous Hera. But there was also Themis, the goddess of Justice, with whom he produced the Hours, the Fates and the Mnemosyne - meaning 'memory' - who gave birth to nine Muses. In order to achieve his aims, Zeus metamorphosed. He was an expert at changing shape and form.

programme.title: The Alchemists
programme.desc: 'La France des Mysteries' invites you to discover the main sites which, in our country, have played a major role in the history of alchemy. From Bourges, which was the capital of alchemy, to the Château du Plessis Bourré which still attracts specialists trying to decipher the symbols engraved in its walls, we will try to unravel the mysteries of a fascinating discipline.

programme.title: The Romanovs
programme.desc: The Crowing of Michael Fyodorovich Romanov as Tsar of Russia, setting in motion the origins of the Romanov Dynasty, he exceeded expectations by restoring peace to a previously perilous relationship with both Sweden and Poland.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: The Goddess of War Athena was the wisest, most level headed and rational deity. She was born out of Zeus' skull, wearing a helmet and holding a spear. She was the protector of heroes, the State, and mankind, to whom she passed on many inventions.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: On the shores of West Bay Lake, Wisconsin, a mansion known as Summerwind stands between the living and the dead. Ginger falls in love with the house despite warnings and moves in with her family. As she restores it, a supernatural force pushes her husband toward madness. With their family unraveling, Ginger and her children fear the house will consume them all.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some believe ghosts are human spirits seeking peace, while others say they are inhuman entities that feed on fear. Jan's lonely son Cody seems happy with his imaginary friend-until his behavior turns violent. When Cody reveals his friend lives in a red box in a cemetery, Jan seeks help from a Native American shaman. Through ancient rituals, she battles a force far more sinister than a lost soul.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In Taiwan, many believe the spiritual and material worlds are intertwined. When an American family moves into a lavish mansion in the Yangmingshan Mountains, they witness disturbing supernatural events. Skeptical at first, they refuse to believe in ghosts-until their youngest daughter becomes possessed. A Taoist priest reveals the house was designed to empower the dead and torment the living.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Some places are charged with psychic energy, still traveled by spirits that haven't passed on. Edd and Beth's new home seems ideal, but soon they see a transparent man, a misty old woman, and a growing dark cloud. As supernatural forces intensify, a paranormal investigator confirms their fears. Their home is a portal, filled with enough negative energy to erupt into something terrifying.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Deb and Tony are excited to start their life together in Atchison, Kansas. With their first child on the way, they settle into a charming home, hopeful for the future. After their son is born, his toys move on their own. Deb believes he has a ghostly playmate-until Tony suffers whispers, ghostly footsteps, and bloody wounds. A psychic warns that a darker force is using the spirit to wreak havoc.

programme.title: A Haunting

Paranormal experts Ed and Lorraine Warren confirm the worst: a demonic presence is feeding on their fear.

programme.title: Blooming from Paper: Traditional Jihwa <58>
programme.desc: Cut, folded, and twisted into bloom, these paper flowers hold layers of sincerity and hope. Once adorning palaces and sacred spaces, jihwa blossoms again in the hands of devoted artisans. Let the soft rustle of paper whisper the timeless breath of tradition.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Sound of Bamboo Forest: Chaesangjang Master <56>
programme.desc: Chaesangjang is artisans who dye thinly sliced bamboo bark in colorful hues and weave them into various geometric patterns to make baskets and other items. Let’s appreciate the process of weaving dyed bamboo strips by a master of Chaesangjang.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Dyeing in Royal Red: Red Dyeing Master <70>
programme.desc: The Great Red Color, once a royal hue, is drawn from blossoms through repeated extraction and careful dyeing. Each layer of color deepens through the artisan’s steady hands, preserving a legacy of elegance and tradition.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Painting Enlightenment: Zen Painting <74>
programme.desc: A single brushstroke carries the breath of meditation and the clarity of awakening. Zen painting transcends words, capturing insight and stillness through the silent movement of ink.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: A Master’s Touch: Beating and Stitching Fabric <85>
programme.desc: From selecting fabric to quiet stitching, every step in traditional quilting reflects careful devotion. Through rhythmic beating and fine needlework, practical craft meets gentle beauty.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Making Flower Shoes: The Art of Hand-Stitching <81>
programme.desc: A single pair of flower shoes holds hours of stitching and dedication. Threading the needle again and again, artisans create footwear that is both delicate and elegant. Sense the quiet patterns of tradition in every step.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Subtle Fragrance: Tea Making <12>
programme.desc: In the early morning on the slopes of Jirisan, grandmothers pick wild tea leaves among the pine trees. Experience the subtle fragrance of traditional tea making.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: A Hat Full of Jeju: Cocculus Hat <71>
programme.desc: Woven from Jeju’s native vines, the cocculus hat reflects the islanders’ harmony with nature. Once used to shield from sun and rain, it carries the quiet wisdom of a life rooted in the land.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Hometown of Custom Brassware: Brassware Master <28>
programme.desc: A brassware master is an artisan with the skill of making various utensils from brass. We look into the work of a brassware master skilled in the technique of casting brassware.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Art of Steel: Ornamental Knife Making Master <67>
programme.desc: Small in size, yet rich in meaning—ornamental knives once symbolized both elegance and status. Through intricate forging and decorative detail, these steel blades carry the strength and refinement of tradition.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Striking the Jing: Brassware Master <68>
programme.desc: With thousands of hammer strikes, the jing emerges—not just as an instrument, but as a deep, resonant voice of tradition. Made from molten copper and tin, it is shaped and tuned through breath and rhythm passed down for generations.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Breathing Soul into Wood: Engraving Master <48>
programme.desc: Master Engravers are artisans who create woodcarvings, including works like the ‘Mugujeonggwang Daedaranigyeong’ from the Silla period and the ‘Tripitaka Koreana’ from the Joseon dynasty. Explore the awe-inspiring work of these artisans.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Coloring the Crimson: Dyeing in Royal Red <86>
programme.desc: Royal red, extracted from safflower petals, was once reserved for royalty. The repeated soaking and coloring bring out its deep hue. Witness how this noble color is born through layers of tradition.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Unwavering Focus: The Horsehair Headband Making Master <91>
programme.desc: Made by meticulously weaving fine strands of horsehair, the manggeon was a refined headpiece worn by men in the Joseon era. Each knot reflects the artisan’s steady hand and quiet discipline. Experience the silent intensity behind this delicate craft.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Quilting with Devotion: Quilting Master <69>
programme.desc: Hand-stitched layer by layer, traditional nubi quilting is a labor of patience, care, and artistry. The countless straight, repeated stitches not only provide warmth and durability but also reveal a quiet beauty passed down through generations.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Patience in Preserving Tradition: Onggi Master <13>
programme.desc: Onggi, which every Korean household used to have at least four or five, if not dozens, were essential in traditional Korean kitchens. Feel the patience in preserving the tradition of Onggi masters.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Griddle of Joseon: Metal Casting Master <73>
programme.desc: From molten metal to cast iron cookware, traditional casting techniques shaped the daily tools of the Joseon era. The griddle, born from fire and precision, reflects the balance of practicality and artistry.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Rising with the Wind: Kite Making Master <62>
programme.desc: Paper and bamboo come together in the hands of a skilled artisan to create a traditional kite. Every cut and brushstroke carries care, as the kite soars with hopes into the sky.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret of Hanji that Lasts a Thousand Years: Stripping Mulberry Bark <54>
programme.desc: Traditional Hanji possesses excellent value, enduring for a thousand years without changing. Let’s appreciate the process of stripping the bark from mulberry trees, the main raw material in the creation of traditional Hanji.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Taste of Tradition: Making Makgeolli <18>
programme.desc: Makgeolli Brewing,' is a part of our everyday culture and a National Intangible Cultural Heritage. Experience the Makgeolli from Jeoncheon Deoksan Brewery, which adheres to traditional techniques.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Shaping Devotion: Making Rice Cake <25>
programme.desc: Rice cake, a food shared during holidays! Introducing the taste and making process of various traditional rice cakes steamed with chestnuts, jujubes, pine nuts, and red bean paste.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Creating a Four-Legged Table: Wooden Furniture Master <49>
programme.desc: Carpenters are artisans who make windows, woodenware, and wooden furniture. They continue the traditional woodworking techniques, creating works like the Sabangtakja (four-sided table). Appreciate the works of Carpenters.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret Garden: Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace EP.4 <4>
programme.desc: Nakseonjae combines noble residence style with palace architecture, featuring unique decorative patterns that showcase late Joseon craftsmanship. Enjoy a break at the exclusive Rear Garden of Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Peaceful Mudflats: The Life of the Mudskipper, Shinan Mudflats <6>
programme.desc: Constituting 85% of Korea's UNESCO-designated tidal flats, Shinan Mudflats are the largest and most unique, formed among numerous islands. Explore the charming life of the mudskipper in this ecologically valuable area.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Tortura en México
programme.desc: Fueron interrogados, y pronto, las preguntas se convirtieron en golpes. El drama de quienes han sufrido la tortura en carne propia, y también, un ex militar justifica sus acciones.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Frutos del odio
programme.desc: Intimidación e insultos racistas, amenazas y ataques físicos. Letreros racistas pintados en las paredes, pareciera no haber lugar seguro. Una nueva realidad se está viviendo en muchos vecindarios.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Doble vida
programme.desc: De día es un estudiante universitario, de noche bailarín exótico. Para unos era su guía espiritual, para otros era un peligro para su comunidad.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - En la boca del lobo
programme.desc: En medio de las tensiones raciales de los últimos meses, Ilia Calderón se adentra en el mundo del grupo supremacista blanco Ku Klux Klan y entrevista a uno de sus líderes. El encuentro está lleno de amenazas e insultos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Juan Gabriel íntimo
programme.desc: Hablan quienes lo conocieron desde niño y quienes fueron testigos de su genio musical. Los rituales antes de enfrentar a su público y el testimonio de quienes permanecieron cerca de él, a un año de su muerte.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - La amenaza de la amapola
programme.desc: En los campos de la Sierra de Guerrero, México, florecen la amapola y la violencia. Familias campesinas se ganan la vida con los cultivos ilegales, mientras que los carteles de la droga buscan controlar el mercado.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Traicionados por la justicia
programme.desc: Alrededor de cincuenta jóvenes de un mismo vecindario recibieron acusaciones de homicidios que los marcaron para siempre. Algunos pasaron décadas en prisión, otros están aún intentando limpiar sus nombres.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Alas del narco
programme.desc: El drama de las misteriosas desapariciones de pilotos y los riesgos a los que se exponen en las selvas andinas.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Amores que matan
programme.desc: Una mujer contrata a unos sicarios para asesinar a su marido, pero él descubre la verdad y logra salvar su vida. Miguel Ignacio Mendoza el grupo de música urbana “Chino y Nacho”, cuenta un poco de su historia de vida.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - ¿Comida cruel?
programme.desc: Una pareja acepta el reto de cambiar sus hábitos alimenticios, dejar de comer carne y llevar una dieta balanceada. Y la historia de Yumalay Díaz, un niño de 4 años que, con su participación en un reality, quiere cambiar su vida y la de sus papás.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Burlando la muerte
programme.desc: Personas que por diferentes razones del destino han estado al borde de la muerte, pero han recibido una segunda oportunidad para continuar con sus vidas. Desde accidentes con puentes desplomados, ataques por celos, sobrevivientes de terremotos y más.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Chicos malos
programme.desc: Una nueva generación de artistas del género urbano domina las listas de éxito a nivel mundial. Las letras de sus canciones están plagadas de violencia, crimen, sexo y drogas que se han convertido en una multimillonaria industria.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Muerte río arriba
programme.desc: La vida tranquila de un pueblo fue afectada por ataques inesperados. Una lancha con 16 pasajeros sufrió el peor destino que pudieran imaginar. Wilmer cuenta la pesadilla que vivió cuando agentes de la DEA confunden la embarcación en la que iba.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 121
programme.desc: Carlo le dice a Roberta que está interesado en su mamá y no en ella. El Sr. Mendiola despide a Esteban y presenta a Gastón como el nuevo prefecto. José le confiesa a Teo que fue ella quien le escribía los mails y no Roberta.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 122
programme.desc: Mía abandona la banda y a Miguel le da gusto, pero Diego le dice que sería un error. Vico convence a Mía de no dejar el grupo. La Logia pone a prueba a Teo. El Oso logra que Marcelino se vaya con él. La banda va a una entrevista con la disquera.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 123
programme.desc: Los chavos de la banda necesitan ser invitados al programa Otro Rollo para darse a conocer. Celina y José planean reencontrar a la maestra Hilda con su amor del pasado, para salvarse del examen. Franco le da otra oportunidad a Carlo para trabajar.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 124
programme.desc: Tomás y Giovanni tratan de encubrir a Diego con Alicia. Madariaga se molesta con Gandía por contratar a una profesora por el hecho de ser recomendada. Rosa quiere llevarse a Lupita del colegio. Todos se enteran de que José se burló de Teo.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 125
programme.desc: Celina cae en la trampa de Gandía y delata a Roberta. Mabel encubre a los chavos y le dice a Gandía que ella autorizó su salida. Celina decide irse del colegio. Roberta le pide perdón a Teo. José culpa a Lupita de escribir los anónimos sobre Teo.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 126
programme.desc: Mía les informa a las chicas quién es la nueva coreógrafa. Mía, Giovanni, Miguel, Lupita, Diego y Roberta deciden que su banda se llame RBD y secuestran a Adal Ramones para que los deje cantar en el programa de Otro Rollo. Roberta conoce a Lenny Kravitz.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 127
programme.desc: Vico trata de que Pilar no vea la televisión, pero sólo pelean por culpa de Joaquín. RBD canta en el programa Otro Rollo y es todo un éxito. Nico, Tomás y José impiden que los alumnos vean el programa. Carlo acompaña a Alma a la morgue.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 128
programme.desc: Celina y Vico le cuentan a Mía lo que hicieron para que nadie los viera en televisión. Renata, la nueva profesora, tiene un altercado con Madariaga por el horario de sus clases. La cita de Hilda y su antiguo enamorado sale mal por una confusión.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 129
programme.desc: El Sr. Calderón le dice a la policía que fue encerrado con Hilda. Alma pide ayuda en televisión para encontrar a Marcelino. Lupita le dice a Madariaga que Roberta y José cometieron un error al pensar que el Sr. Calderón es el enamorado de Hilda.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 130
programme.desc: Franco le ofrece su ayuda a Alma. Roberta besa a Diego. Paola le exige a Diego dejar su banda para que no esté cerca de Roberta. Nico le pide a Lupita que piense en su futuro y no deje el colegio. Marcelino llama a Roberta para despedirse.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 131
programme.desc: Diego decide dejar la banda, pero Nico le dice que tiene un contrato firmado. Rosa lleva a Dulce al colegio para chantajear a Lupita. Nico y Mía culpan a Roberta de que Diego quiera dejar la banda. Roberta le dice a Diego que Paola tiene un secreto.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 132
programme.desc: Mía inicia una campaña para ayudar a la conservación del Bosque de Chapultepec. Mayra felicita a Lupita por decidir quedarse en el colegio. Mía recibe un regalo de Gastón. Marcelino le escribe a Roberta para decirle que se va con su hermano.

programme.title: Natacha
programme.desc: Natacha, una dulce e inocente muchacha provinciana, se muda a la ciudad para trabajar como sirvienta en la casa de una familia adinerada. Pero se enamora del hijo mayor de la familia y debe luchar contra los celos y envidias que ese amor provoca.

programme.title: Cambiando el destino

programme.title: Andante
programme.desc: Una joven se enamora de un pianista de música clásica y tiene problemas con sus amigos de la alta sociedad. Poco después, la chica muere y el pianista se obsesiona con ella, a tal punto que la ve en otras mujeres.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria investiga la desaparición de Elsa, y Lucila le asegura que le contará toda la verdad sobre la relación de su jefa y el Chema. Aurelio le pide a Lay averiguar el paradero de Rutila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema le dice a Rutila que Ernesto los traicionó a ella y a Aurelio, y le muestra una foto como prueba. Luego pide que Lay le diga a los Casillas que él tiene el tesoro que están buscando.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio teme por la seguridad de Victoria, y le sugiere que traslade a Ernesto a otro lugar. Mientras tanto, doña Alba le aconseja a Ximena que aproveche el caos y se vaya con Luzma y Santiago.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Danilo toma a Mónica como rehén, y ella le confiesa que está embarazada para ganar tiempo. En cuanto él se distrae, ella lo mata. Con rabia, Aurelio amenaza al Chema por teléfono.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema hace que Rutila grabe un video como prueba de vida para Aurelio, ya que quiere hacer negocios. Andrew obtiene material donde el general Garnica aparece con drogas, con el que pretende chantajearlo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor le dice a Ignacio que descubrió su escondite de armas, y quiere saber si él pertenece al Escuadrón de la Muerte. El Chema y Aurelio se encuentran cara a cara en Villa Catalina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Heriberto y Leonor se enfrentan por última vez. Él descubre la emboscada, pero no puede escapar de su suerte. Moribundo, asegura que ella se ha convertido en lo que tanto combatió, una asesina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de Heriberto, Aurelio declara la guerra para vengarlo: tiene ganas de matar a medio mundo. Todos se preparan para lo peor. Victoria le pone más protección a Leonor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio envía a Chacorta para ajustar cuentas con Leonor e Ignacio por la muerte de Heriberto: la orden es asesinarlos a todos. Ximena está desconsolada, y culpa a su exesposo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ignacio intenta interrogar al Manotas, pero la rabia se lo impide, y lo mata. Comienza a vengarse de todos los que participaron en la muerte de su padre. Victoria gana las elecciones.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa insiste en reunirse con el Chema, pero ya no tiene mucho que ofrecerle, y él le envenena la comida. Ernesto confiesa a su nuevo patrón que Aurelio está vivo, y le busca pruebas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila escapa con Ernesto con la esperanza de vivir juntos, y Aurelio se desespera porque sus hombres no logran encontrarla. Chacorta presiona a Víctor para que le dé información.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ernesto presenta a Rutila su nuevo jefe, que resulta ser el enemigo número uno de su padre. Aurelio le ordena a Lilo encontrar a su hija, y sospechan que su fuga está vinculada con el Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila tiene miedo, y le dice a Ernesto que la tiene que sacar de la casa de Chema lo más rápido posible. La orden es tratarla como una reina, pues aseguran que no saldrá viva de ahí.

programme.title: What We Do For Love
programme.desc: When Sophie secures a job at the famous mediation and wellness firm, she dives headfirst into her new role. But, she finds herself at odds with the company's chief Life Coach Jason Sharpe who is the son of the firm's President.

programme.title: Write Place, Write Time
programme.desc: Paige just wants to be a writer but her mom wants her to follow in her footsteps in a big conglomerate company. After discovering that Atlas Publishing will be sold, she opts to write under a pseudonym, so nobody knows the actual threat.

programme.title: Rebecca
programme.desc: The immersive new dating series, 5 Guys a Week, centers on a new leading woman each episode, and follows her as she dates 5 men, at the same time, over the course of a week. The twist? They all move into her home.

programme.title: Vote One For Love
programme.desc: When up-and-coming political strategist Candace is sent back to her hometown to help the local mayoral candidate, she never expected to find her best friend's brother running for office. And she certainly never expected to fall for him.

programme.title: What We Do For Love
programme.desc: When Sophie secures a job at the famous mediation and wellness firm, she dives headfirst into her new role. But, she finds herself at odds with the company's chief Life Coach Jason Sharpe who is the son of the firm's President.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. programme.title: A Mother Murders Her 3 Children: The Fathers Speak
programme.desc: In a small Oklahoma community, a mother shot and killed her three children before turning the gun on herself. Two of the children’s fathers speak out about what they believe drove their ex to commit the most unthinkable crime.

programme.title: George Santos: Lies, Scandal, and the Road to Prison
programme.desc: Fallen former congressman George Santos reveals the web of lies that launches his career and the ambition, pressure, and self-justification that cost him everything.

programme.title: Part 2: From Scandal to Second Chance: George Santos' Life After Clemency
programme.desc: From prison walls to presidential mercy, George Santos seeks redemption and faces a future shaped by scandal, second chances, and the nation's unforgiving spotlight.

programme.title: Paroled at 50: The Sex Offender Loophole
programme.desc: When Jennifer learns her rapist is being released 26 years early, she discovers a hidden parole shortcut for so‑called “elderly” inmates that could send dangerous sex offenders back into communities across the country.

programme.title: Sex Offenders: Are Communities Really Safe?
programme.desc: Dr. Phil speaks with guests who share personal experiences to explain why they claim that the sex offender registry isn’t protecting the communities it aims to keep safe.

programme.title: Pure Blue Fish
programme.desc: Imagine eating the most delicious, ocean-fresh yellowtail, bluefish, or redfish — that came from the desert, not the ocean. In this episode, Dr. Phil meets the brains behind Pure Blue Fish — an innovative aquaculture company raising sushi-grade ocean fish hours from the nearest ocean. It's as sustainable as it is delicious.

programme.title: Mom Sedates Children on Flight
programme.desc: Mom of four under fire for sedating kids on long flights! Shelby Hadden tackles pelvic pain and shares about her short film Tightly Wound. Jen Hansard shares some simple, green alternatives for your takeout favorites! We put a new personal thermostat to the test! At what point do you feel comfortable doing private things in front of your partner? Can drinking baking soda help you lose weight? Does drinking through a straw help avoid cavities? Why everyone is eating cauliflower bread!

programme.title: Twin Sisters Get Twin Facelifts
programme.desc: We go “inside the O.R.” for an amazing update as two identical twin sisters get the “twinning” facelifts they’ve always wanted! The RefrigerDATEr’s back to help another single bachelorette find a man – by looking through the contents of his refrigerator! Is viral “60 second rule” to a clearer face legit? Is the mental workload of running a house harming moms’ health?

programme.title: Too Rich Too Young
programme.desc: Kids are constantly bombarded by media images that make wealth and glamour the rule of cool. Today’s first guest had to take out a second mortgage to keep up with her daughter’s extravagant tastes. Can Dr. Phil convince her to say no to her children without feeling guilty? Plus—an 11-year-old whines to her parents for the latest designer fashions. They’re concerned that her values are skewed by mounting peer pressure to be hip. And another teenager is upset that her mother doesn’t understand her attempts to emulate the rich reality TV stars she idolizes. Can Dr. Phil help these parents re-program their kids’ value systems?

programme.title: Runaway Dramas
programme.desc: Imagine your pregnant teen daughter running away to be with the baby's father -- an older man whom she met online. For Heidi, this became reality when her 15-year-old daughter, Brittney, went missing for five weeks. Dr. Phil put private investigator and former FBI Agent Harold Copus on the case to find the missing teen. See the confrontation when Harold finally locates her and her 34-year-old boyfriend. Then, find out why Brittney was even more upset when she found out what was in store for her. It's been two months; has Brittney's relationship with her mother improved? Next, Kim, 15, has run away six times in the last year, most recently making it halfway across the country to be with her married boyfriend. Why didn't her parents look for her, and why does she say she'll do anything to get away from them? Can this family learn to get things back on track? Think your child is being targeted by a sexual predator? Don’t miss Dr. Phil’s warning signs!

programme.title: Rude Relatives
programme.desc: Do you know someone who turns your stomach or makes you cringe the minute he or she walks into the room? Dr. Phil talks to guests who say their relative's rude behavior keeps them on edge.

programme.title: The Anatomy Of Abuse
programme.desc: What would you do if your spouse belittled you and threatened your life? For women who have ever endured verbal, physical or emotional abuse in a relationship, Dr. Phil helps break the silence.

programme.title: Slacker Wives And Mooching Moms
programme.desc: These women admit they fall short in the mom and wife categories and are freeloading off their loved ones. Their families say they are fed up with having to do it all and/or pay for it all!

programme.title: Neighborhood Wars Top 10: United We Stand
programme.desc: With a record number of Americans trading city life for homes in the suburbs, relationships between neighbors are being put to the test. Each half-hour episode of "Neighborhood Wars" takes viewers into the homes and backyards of neighbors across the country with some of the most unexpected and emotionally charged events caught on camera. Featuring footage from cell phones, drones, home security cameras and more, the series showcases the kindness and conflict between real-life neighbors throughout the US.

programme.title: Who's Pregnant?
programme.desc: In ARRANGED, three couples from different cultural backgrounds have one thing in common-- the belief in arranged marriages. From a Romani gypsy couple in New York City, to a southern couple from the Bible belt, to a couple raised by traditional Eastern Indian parents living in Los Angeles-- these brides and grooms don't just marry each other, their unions include their entire family. Viewers will see each couple's relationship from the lead-up to their weddings to the several months after the reality of married life sinks in.

programme.title: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Clovis, California to investigate a run down Sanitarium. Joining the team will be a fellow TAPS member from Northern California, Amy Bruni who has investigated here before. Reports of shadows appear to come right at you only to disappear. During renovations, 911 calls would mysteriously manifest from the home only to not have any phones to speak of in the whole building.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS goes to the Maritime Museum of San Diego to investigate the oldest active ship in the world, the Star of India, and her slipmate, the steam ferryboat Berkeley. The Star of India was built back in 1863 on the Isle of Man, originally christened as the Euterpe. On her first voyage, to India, the iron windjammer suffered a collision and her crew mutinied. The second trip didn't go even that well - she was trapped in a cyclone and her first captain died at sea.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the Portsmouth Harbor Lighthouse and Fort Constitution on Coast Guard Property. Caption Joshua card, an old lighthouse keeper, haunts the walkway to the lighthouse wearing a pea coat and hat. Near the powder magazine there has been sightings of a green mist where 14 people died in a massive forth of July explosion. The scene is historic and it's rumored that their spirits still haunt the fort.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A family living in a Revolutionary War era house in Pennsylvania fears for their child and urgently calls on the TAPS team for help. Jason and Grant have some extreme K2 hits and their own first hand experience with a shaking bed to confirm the many frightening claims. They leave the Hannum family with tools to help them deal with the entities that share their home

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team braves the wintery waters of the Atlantic to investigate Star Island off of the coast of Portsmouth, NH. Founded as a fishing village in the 1600's the island is ripe with activity and home to a suicide pact gone wrong. Jason and Grant collect some shocking EVP's and are joined by Kristyn Gartland who takes on the challenge of investigating one of the most dangerous claims.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is the first team to investigate The Mount in Lenox, MA, the astounding estate of famous author Edith Wharton. Claims of a jealous spirit, a crouching apparition, disembodied screams, and countless reports of footsteps are just some of the many reports haunting the century-old site. The TAPS team is challenged to cover all of the ground and to find out if Edith Wharton herself remains on the estate she once considered her retreat.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team travels south to Ybor City, Florida to the historic Cuban Club. Once the center of Cuban social life, the commemorated building is now the center of paranormal activity. While investigating Grant makes contact with an entity in the theatre and Britt Griffith joins the team in gathering enough evidence to confirm the club is still active with ghosts.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS revisits Belcourt Castle in Newport, Rhode Island to investigate claims surrounding a deceased friend. It's been ten years since TAPS investigated the 19th century castle and they are back with more sophisticated equipment to tackle old and new claims that persist in the manor. While investigating Jason and Grant catch a thermal hit that defies explanation and Kris and Amy catch an EVP that could be the ghost of former castle owner Mr. Tinney himself.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS gets on board the Titanic Exhibit at the Georgia Aquarium in Atlanta to investigate paranormal claims that have traveled around the world with the artifacts. A TAPS family member group reached out to the team to determine if it's really paranormal activity, or just the tragic tale of the sinking ship that haunts the exhibit. A unique challenge for the team, Kris questions how to approach the case and Jason and Grant encounter some physical contact with an invisible force.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS calls in the GHI team to investigate the Spalding Inn, a historic property in Whitefield, New Hampshire owned by Jason and Grant. For over 80 years, numerous guests have reported seeing mysterious black masses, hearing strange voices, and being touched by something not visible. During their investigation, GHI team members Robb and Dustin chase a mysterious force through the kitchen, while Barry and Joe confront an elusive entity in the carriage house.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team travels to New Jersey to investigate the infamous Essex County Hospital. The century-old site is reportedly haunted by some of the estimated 10,000 souls that died there. Numerous witnesses have reported seeing the apparition of a nurse, hearing voices calling for help, and even being physically grabbed. While investigating the miles of tunnels that run underneath the hospital, Jason and Grant capture a thermal image which defies explanation.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team answers a call from a family in Blackstone, Massachusetts being plagued by a demonic entity. The Ladouceurs had always experienced strange events in their beloved home, but once major renovations began the benign activity turned violent. During the investigation, the team experiences a series of bizarre encounters including Jason being physically attacked.

programme.title: Vanished in Virginia
programme.desc: However shocking the crime, media headlines eventually fade, but for heartbroken friends and family, the memories and their longing for justice never do. Cold Case Files? produced by the team behind Investigative ReportsTM, digs deep into the past, following detectives as they strive to breathe new life into "cold" unsolved crimes. Armed with the latest DNA technology and with dogged determination, investigators seek new leads in hopes of bringing the guilty to justice decades after the crimes have been committed. programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grains are back in style, yet Italians have been using them for centuries. Lidia shares some of her favorite grain based recipes in this episode including: Risotto with Mushrooms; Barley, Kale & Butternut Squash Risotto; and Polenta Torta with Gorgonzola and Savory Cabbage.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: This episode features a "Best of Chicken" with some of Lidia's favorite dishes from the oven to the stovetop. Recipes include a succulent Roasted Chicken; a simple and earthy Seared Chicken Breast with Mushrooms; and finally a dish with a little kick - Paprika Drumsticks with Peppers.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Steak is a favorite in many American households, and this episode is a tribute to the nice juicy dish and showcase not only one of Lidia's preferred preparations but two other recipes that work well for a special steak house evening at home. Featured recipes include Seared Steak with Mushroom Sauce and Braised Escarole; Baked Potatoes with Pancetta and Oregano; and an Almond Cake with Chocolate Chips.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love their seasons, and they know how to make delicious soups, salads and pastas with fall and winter vegetables. In this episode, Lidia shares some winter garden menu ideas including a spicy Escarole and White Bean Soup, a unique and delicious Spaghetti with Fennel and Bitter Greens and a Cabbage Salad made with warm bacon dressing.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fried potatoes with sausage and eggs; breakfast risotto featuring bacon, egg and cheese; ricotta pancakes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: If there were another name for Lidia's family, it would be the gnocchi family. They love making them together AND eating them. Lidia starts with a Butternut Squash Gnocchi that is as soft as a feather and served with a velvety sage and butter sauce. Next, she prepares a Marinated Bread of Chicken Seared with Shiitake Mushrooms, Rosemary and Sage. Her sautéed earthy Brussels Sprouts are made with pepperoncino, garlic and walnuts. They are nutty AND spicy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's episode is all about corn. Lidia often played in corn fields, helped with the harvests, and even slept on mattresses made from husks. Recipes for today include a refreshing Corn and Zucchini Minestra, a sweet and savory Polenta Cacio e Pere, and a combination of vegetables that can be served as a side dish or even the highlight of the dinner table- Grilled Corn, Apricots, and Portobellos.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Shrimp and melon salad with basil mint pesto; peaches in white wine; mezze rigatoni with raw tomato sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Simple recipes are a must for weeknight dinners, and Lidia always looks for those that that deliver a burst of flavor. In this episode, she will share some of her favorite quick weeknight dinner ideas. She starts with a Sausage Crostini, made of sweet Italian sausage topped with Taleggio cheese. She then prepares a Penne Rigate in Vodka Sauce; an iconic creamy Italian American pasta dish and then Arugula Salad with Porcini Mushroom & Shavings of Cheese.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia prepares a colourful summer panzanella with roasted zucchini and onions, and a warm shrimp and squash ribbon salad.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Citrus and fennel salad; crispy smashed garlic rosemary potatoes; roast pork shoulder.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today Lidia shares some new show-stopping dishes for the perfect family style brunch that include Crostata with Kale Butternut Squash and Ricotta - made of a flaky dough filled with a creamy colorful mix of ricotta, kale, butternut squash and golden raisins. Carrot and Orange Salad is the next item on the menu-a bright dish that adds color to any meal. Lidia's Potato and Egg Frico - a crispy Asiago cheese crust made with potatoes and eggs is always a winner at the brunch table.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American classics have always been favorites at the family table and in this episode, there is reason to celebrate. Today's recipes include the most iconic Italian American dish, Spaghetti and Meatballs; a Broccoli Rabe with Garlic; and a holiday must - Zeppole.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fresh pasta with pear and pecorino is a restaurant favorite at Felidia, and Lidia shows how to take that flavor combination and use it in a risotto. She also demonstrates Short Ribs Braised in Barolo with Orzo.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Shaved fennel, red onion and prosciutto cotto salad; cherry jam tart with wild cherries from the Emilia Romagna region of Italy; prosciutto, scallion and egg sandwich.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves eggs, and in this episode, she shares four super simple recipes that feature this amazing ingredient that Lidia recalls fondly from her own grandmother's courtyard in Istria. Oregano Eggs and Anchovy Frittata are delicious appetizers or main courses. The Rustic Salad is a great meal idea with lots of complex textures and flavors. programme.title: The "L Word"
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

Zhenya must destroy an enemy ammo-and-fuel depot; a sabotage team led by Captain Aleksandr Makeev will join.

programme.title: Nazi Death Marches: 1944-1945
programme.desc: Through exclusive film archives and written journals, we will reveal a lesser known chapter of the end of the Third Reich, a story of brutality and murder. In the final months of World War II, 700,000 prisoners were evacuated from concentration camps and traveled throughout Europe. 250,000 to 300,000 died from exhaustion or were massacred by the guards or even civilians in Austria and Germany.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: Hitler, Göring, and Himmler shared a strange obsession with animals, using them as propaganda tools, symbols of ideology, and even weapons of war. Far beyond affection, their fascination fueled pseudo-scientific projects and genetic manipulation. Through archives, expert insight, and re-enactments, this documentary uncovers how the Nazis exploited nature to serve their brutal vision.

programme.title: D-Day: 100 Days for Freedom
programme.desc: June 6, 1944-150,000 Allied soldiers land on Normandy's shores in Operation Overlord, one of history's largest military campaigns. Through rare colorized archives and personal testimonies, this episode relives the chaos, courage, and tragedy of D-Day, as the Allies fight to secure a foothold in occupied France.

programme.title: The Vietnam War: The Invisible Enemy
programme.desc: The second part of the story of the Vietnam War from the perspective of both sides, including rare war time footage from North Vietnamese sources.

programme.title: The Attackers
programme.desc: Major Scheglov analyzes the intelligence report about an enemy column. The pilots discuss a dueling German, but tensions rise. Schugayev faces scrutiny for his report's accuracy. Preparing to escort the Major, the pilots discover sand in the engine. Suspicion falls on the locals. Scheglov holds the mechanic accountable.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: On 30 January 1933, Hitler became chancellor and the Nazis quickly seized state power. Foreign diplomats in Berlin, turned into spies and whistleblowers, witnessed both Nazi infiltration of high society and the exclusion of Jews. Drawing on rare archives, this documentary reveals their warnings about the rise of National Socialism-and how the world ignored them.

programme.title: World War II: The Real Mighty Eighth
programme.desc: Once again, the USAAF 1st Motion Picture Unit witnesses, first hand, a deadly mission against the tyranny of Nazi Germany. B17 and B24 Bombers of the Mighty Eighth are assaulted by deadly anti-aircraft guns and savaged by Herman Goring's Luftwaffe. Fighting their way to the target, mile by mile, to drop their bombs, the surviving crews can only then dare to hope they might make it home again...

programme.title: Napoleon Bonaparte: The Russian Campaign
programme.desc: Part 2 details the hardships and deprivations suffered by Napoleon's Grande Armee as they await the surrender of the Tsar, which never comes. And with problems in France and his popularity waning, Napoleon begins the long, death-filled retreat from Russia with his exhausted, starving troops.

programme.title: The Romanovs
programme.desc: Few Tsars loom larger in the perception of the masses than Peter the Great.. Although he had tremendous foresight in his attempts to modernize Russia, Peter neglected to name an heir before his death in 1725.

programme.title: For Athens
programme.desc: This immersion into Ancient Greece, filmed in the original language, follows in the footsteps of Themistocles and his fearsome adversary Xerxes. Through two spectacular military engagements, one on land, the other naval: the battles of Marathon (490 BC) and Salamis (480 BC).

programme.title: The Napoleonic Wars - The War of the Sixth Coalition
programme.desc: As Moscow burns in the wake of Napoleon's advance, the Russian army regroups and begins its determined pursuit of the invaders. With winter looming, they launch a relentless counteroffensive, setting the stage for a campaign that will push far beyond Russia's borders.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths: The Iliad
programme.desc: Saved by Apollo, Hector goes back on the attack and leads the Trojans as far as the Greeks' ships. Patroclus, a childhood friend of Achilles, rushes to him and implores him to re-join the battle.

programme.title: Inside The Tower of London: Crimes, Conspiracies, Confessions
programme.desc: Some of the more famous prisoners, such as the only American imprisoned, who was convicted of spying but rather than taking the infamous walk to the block ended up becoming the toast of London society; the tortured life of Roger Casement and how he fell from grace; and the network of spies and informers whose lives centered on the Tower.

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: In Saqqara, Zahi Hawass and his team uncover a trove of sarcophagi from the New Kingdom and Late Period. With over forty shafts dug, they anticipate rich discoveries. As they scan and possibly open the coffins, unexpected secrets emerge, revealing glimpses into Ancient Egypt's past. Forensic techniques transport them back over three millennia, breathing life into long-buried individuals.

programme.title: Ancient Megacities
programme.desc: In the 9th century BC, Phoenicians built Carthage, a grand city at Mediterranean trade crossroads, set to be their empire's capital. After the Third Punic War, Carthage fell to Rome. Hadrian's task: ensure year-round water supply. Today, Byrsa hill showcases intertwined Punic and Roman relics, symbolizing Carthage's enduring legacy linking two civilizations.

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: The ancient Black Pyramid, dating back 1,800 years, appears ruinous yet harbors intricate underground tunnels. Egyptologist Lark Lenher delves into these passageways, revealing impressive artifacts. Structural issues from its construction raise intrigue. With laser data, experts aim to unravel its unique mysteries, shedding light on this remarkable monument.

programme.title: Endangered Civilizations
programme.desc: Between the Sahara and the equatorial rainforest of West Africa, the huge cliff of Bandiagara stretches across a desolate plateau. This vast wall of rock is home to one of the world's most unique civilizations - the Dogon. Their animist beliefs are founded on a refined tradition based on a beautiful legend : the Ark of the First Ancestor.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths: The Odyssey
programme.desc: A year has passed. It is time for Odysseus and his men to leave the witch Circe's island and return to Ithaca. To do so, they must first go to meet the prophet Tiresias in the Underworld. Only he can tell them what to do to appease Poseidon's wrath.

programme.title: The Napoleonic Wars - The War of the Sixth Coalition
programme.desc: The Russian army joins forces with European allies in a series of clashes across Central Europe. At Dresden and Kulm, the tide begins to turn against Napoleon. Fierce battles test the resolve of the coalition as momentum shifts toward the defenders of the old order.

programme.title: Europe - History Seen From Above
programme.desc: Italy, cradle of Latin culture, still bears the mark of Rome's engineering genius. From roads and bridges to aqueducts, a vast web once linked the capital to its empire, proving Rome was built as much by land development as by war. For nearly 1,000 years, this infrastructure shaped Italy's identity. With expert insight and stunning aerial views, the episode reveals the scale of Roman achievement.

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: Builder of the third pyramid of Giza, Menkaure erected a smaller, more modest pyramid than those of his two predecessors. But this discreet gem is perhaps the most revealing of them all. A bicolor, unfinished monument, a chamber entirely made of granite, a sarcophagus buried in the sea... This episode recounts the incredible story of a king and its pyramid.

programme.title: Spring of Changdeokgung Palace: The Back Garden of Nakseonjae <16>
programme.desc: Built during King Taejong’s reign, Changdeokgung Palace was originally constructed as a secondary palace but served as the main palace for a longer period. Its rear garden, the only palace rear garden in Korea, showcases beautiful springtime scenery.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Traces of Dedication and Patience: Silk Weaving <5>
programme.desc: Korea's silk weaving technology was so advanced that Koreans sent silk goods to the Tang Dynasty (China) as early as the Silla period. Silk weaving requires dedication and patience.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Korea’s Representative Food Culture: Making Kimchi <32>
programme.desc: Kimchi, a representative food of Korea! Did you know that our kimchi-making culture is listed by UNESCO? Learn the tradition of making kimchi.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Sound of Swamp: Upo Wetlands <26>
programme.desc: How much time has passed in Upo Wetlands? It is a story of lives that have settled and live like masters in the place provided by the river.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Creating a Four-Legged Table: Wooden Furniture Master <49>
programme.desc: Carpenters are artisans who make windows, woodenware, and wooden furniture. They continue the traditional woodworking techniques, creating works like the Sabangtakja (four-sided table). Appreciate the works of Carpenters.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Welcome Spring: Royal Confectionery Spring Table <1>
programme.desc: Capturing the perfect snack that matches spring best, the sounds of making royal confectionery. Experience the taste and style filled with the scent of spring.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Overcoming Time of Patience: Selecting Hairs <52>
programme.desc: In the traditional brush-making process, the process of selecting hairs, known as 'Jeongmo work,' is essential for creating a quality brush. Let's appreciate the artisan enduring the time of patience through thousands of repetitions.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret Garden: Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace EP.4 <4>
programme.desc: Nakseonjae combines noble residence style with palace architecture, featuring unique decorative patterns that showcase late Joseon craftsmanship. Enjoy a break at the exclusive Rear Garden of Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Peaceful Mudflats: The Life of the Mudskipper, Shinan Mudflats <6>
programme.desc: Constituting 85% of Korea's UNESCO-designated tidal flats, Shinan Mudflats are the largest and most unique, formed among numerous islands. Explore the charming life of the mudskipper in this ecologically valuable area.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Spring of Changdeokgung Palace: The Back Garden of Nakseonjae <16>
programme.desc: Built during King Taejong’s reign, Changdeokgung Palace was originally constructed as a secondary palace but served as the main palace for a longer period. Its rear garden, the only palace rear garden in Korea, showcases beautiful springtime scenery.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Griddle of Joseon: Metal Casting Master <73>
programme.desc: From molten metal to cast iron cookware, traditional casting techniques shaped the daily tools of the Joseon era. The griddle, born from fire and precision, reflects the balance of practicality and artistry.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Patience in Preserving Tradition: Onggi Master <13>
programme.desc: Onggi, which every Korean household used to have at least four or five, if not dozens, were essential in traditional Korean kitchens. Feel the patience in preserving the tradition of Onggi masters.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Art of Steel: Ornamental Knife Making Master <67>
programme.desc: Small in size, yet rich in meaning—ornamental knives once symbolized both elegance and status. Through intricate forging and decorative detail, these steel blades carry the strength and refinement of tradition.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Unwavering Focus: The Horsehair Headband Making Master <91>
programme.desc: Made by meticulously weaving fine strands of horsehair, the manggeon was a refined headpiece worn by men in the Joseon era. Each knot reflects the artisan’s steady hand and quiet discipline. Experience the silent intensity behind this delicate craft.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Coloring the Crimson: Dyeing in Royal Red <86>
programme.desc: Royal red, extracted from safflower petals, was once reserved for royalty. The repeated soaking and coloring bring out its deep hue. Witness how this noble color is born through layers of tradition.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Quilting with Devotion: Quilting Master <69>
programme.desc: Hand-stitched layer by layer, traditional nubi quilting is a labor of patience, care, and artistry. The countless straight, repeated stitches not only provide warmth and durability but also reveal a quiet beauty passed down through generations.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Breathing Soul into Wood: Engraving Master <48>
programme.desc: Master Engravers are artisans who create woodcarvings, including works like the ‘Mugujeonggwang Daedaranigyeong’ from the Silla period and the ‘Tripitaka Koreana’ from the Joseon dynasty. Explore the awe-inspiring work of these artisans.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Rising with the Wind: Kite Making Master <62>
programme.desc: Paper and bamboo come together in the hands of a skilled artisan to create a traditional kite. Every cut and brushstroke carries care, as the kite soars with hopes into the sky.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: A Hat Full of Jeju: Cocculus Hat <71>
programme.desc: Woven from Jeju’s native vines, the cocculus hat reflects the islanders’ harmony with nature. Once used to shield from sun and rain, it carries the quiet wisdom of a life rooted in the land.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Hometown of Custom Brassware: Brassware Master <28>
programme.desc: A brassware master is an artisan with the skill of making various utensils from brass. We look into the work of a brassware master skilled in the technique of casting brassware.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Striking the Jing: Brassware Master <68>
programme.desc: With thousands of hammer strikes, the jing emerges—not just as an instrument, but as a deep, resonant voice of tradition. Made from molten copper and tin, it is shaped and tuned through breath and rhythm passed down for generations.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Artisans Who Carve Masterpieces: Sobanjang <47>
programme.desc: Soban (small tray table) is a small table for placing dishes of food, playing an important role in Korean dining culture. Appreciate the traditional soban filled with the artisan spirit of the Sobanjang.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Masterpieces Created by Time: Ink (Meok) <51>
programme.desc: Ink (Meok) has been one of the Four Treasures of the Study (ink, paper, brush, inkstone) and a companion of scholars since ancient times. Welcome to the world of ink, masterpieces created by time(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Essence of Korean Traditional Dance: Salpuri Dance <34>
programme.desc: Since ancient times, people have held shamanistic rituals to dispel bad luck for the year. The Salpuri dance is an improvised dance performed by shamans during these rituals to ward off negative energy.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Spring of Changdeokgung Palace: The Back Garden of Nakseonjae <16>
programme.desc: Built during King Taejong’s reign, Changdeokgung Palace was originally constructed as a secondary palace but served as the main palace for a longer period. Its rear garden, the only palace rear garden in Korea, showcases beautiful springtime scenery.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Atorados
programme.desc: Atrapados entre el pasado y un futuro que simplemente no puede llegar, un muro se interpone entre la realidad y sus sueños. Miles de migrantes centroamericanos, quedan atorados en su recorrido por México para alcanzar el sueño americano.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Caminando al borde
programme.desc: Miles de migrantes que han sido recibidos entre hostilidad y protestas en la frontera sur deberán enfrentar una nueva realidad, pero la esperanza los acompaña. El camino para llegar a Estados Unidos es muy peligroso.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Magnates de Dios
programme.desc: Se han convertido en emporios religiosos multinacionales donde van de la mano el dinero y la fe, un negocio multimillonario, pastores y predicadores evangélicos que llevan vidas opulentas. Tienen problemas con la autoridad por diversas denuncias.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Buscando en el desierto
programme.desc: Familias que pierden a sus seres queridos en la inmensidad del desierto sin poder hacer nada para saber de ellos, pero la esperanza no muere y arriesgarán todo para recuperarlos. Migrantes que intentan cruzar la frontera hacia los Estados Unidos, mueren.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Amores migrantes
programme.desc: Ni el tiempo, ni el espacio, ni las fronteras son obstáculos para estar con la persona amada, hombres y mujeres que han hecho grandes sacrificios para estar unidos. Incluso arriesgan su libertad por estar junto a sus seres queridos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - La viuda negra
programme.desc: Una terrible confusión pone en riesgo la libertad de un hombre tras el terrible asesinato de un importante empresario canadiense, pero el destino tiene sorpresas para todos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Secretos de las mucamas de Trump
programme.desc: Declaraciones de mujeres que trabajaron para la familia Trump y secretos que salen a la luz después de las fuertes palabras del presidente contra miles de personas.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Ganarle a la muerte
programme.desc: La desgracia de un hombre que, con fuerza y voluntad, cambió su vida tratando de ayudar a sus seres amados. Cuando apenas emprendía el viaje para vivir el sueño americano, la tragedia se cruza en su camino.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Supremacistas: Las redes del odio
programme.desc: El cambio de vida de los inmigrantes que residen en El Paso, Texas. Sus miedos luego de las masacres del 3 de agosto de 2019, cuando un pistolero mató a 22 personas y les declaró la guerra a los hispanos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Asesinadas
programme.desc: La historia de cinco mujeres que han sufrido de la violencia física. Un desenlace común tras una vida llena de tortura, la muerte es inevitable. Los feminicidios es alarmante, el porcentaje aumenta.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Desafiar el olvido
programme.desc: Algunos fueron perseguidos y separados de sus familias, otros llevados a campos de concentración y exterminados, hoy, algunos de los sobrevivientes narran el horror del holocausto judío.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - La vida en juego: fútbol y violencia en la frontera
programme.desc: Un programa especial que muestra la vida de cuatro jugadores de fútbol americano en Brownsville, Texas; quienes se enfrentan a una dura realidad de violencia, pobreza y drogas, pero siempre con ilusión de una vida mejor.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Un crimen casi perfecto
programme.desc: Una hermosa mujer y de buen corazón, es asesinada por su esposo, un hombre manipulador y frío que dejó abandonada a su propia hija en los brazos de su madre fallecida.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: María Eugenia quiere que su esposo Armando pague el rescate que piden por su hijo secuestrado, pero su esposo no está dispuesto a arriesgar el capital que tienen porque no hay garantías. Tina se hizo unas fotos con Ángel, pero este nunca se las entregó. Ahora ella descubre que las fotografías fueron utilizadas como carnada para cazar a depredadores sexuales.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Emmanuel tiene 18 hijos de diferentes mujeres y distintas nacionalidades, algunas de ellas le exigen que se haga una vasectomía para que pare de traer al mundo niños que no puede mantener.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Quiere que le autoricen su regreso a Cuba, pero la madre prefiere que el sistema se haga cargo de su hija. Un niño da una serenata y le lanzan un objeto que le rompe la cabeza.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Obligan a su novia a abortar, ella se suicida. Fabiola participa en unos encuentros que organiza Alejandro, por su culpa termina casi violada y contagiada con hepatitis.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La cantante ve lo que parece una agresión a un homosexual y detiene su actuación, el público golpea al supuesto agresor. Su esposo solo se excita si hormigas bravas lo pican en los genitales.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Christian pide que Cecilia le dé una compensación porque se masturbó en su taxi y subió el video a la red. Está asustado porque su esposa es viuda de tres hombres que murieron sospechosamente.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Hija de migrantes intenta quitarse de encima ese estigma y elimina su lengua natal, el español. En otro caso, Favo y Tormento son raperos y se enfrentan por la letra de una canción.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La hija de Karen, menor de edad, es fanática de los tatuajes, pero sufre serios daños al hacerse uno en el brazo. Melisa le inyecta a su abuelo su propia sangre porque él quiere rejuvenecer.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Camilo se ha quedado casi ciego y las conexiones nerviosas entre los ojos y el cerebro le provocan unos dolores insoportables, por los cuales tiene que tomar unos analgésicos tan fuertes que le han provocado adicción. Su esposa Carolina lo abandonó y no quiere regresar si no se saca los ojos. En otro caso, Vanessa le regaló su casa a Yenni supuestamente bajo los efectos de una brujería que le invalidaba su voluntad. Ahora quiere anular esa transferencia, pero Yenni alega que la casa ya es suya.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Señalan a Juan de participar en el secuestro y muerte de una parte de la familia de Abel. Debby subasta el agua de unos baños que se dio y su amigo Josué le exige la mitad del dinero ganado.

programme.desc: Danilo toma a Mónica como rehén, y ella le confiesa que está embarazada para ganar tiempo. En cuanto él se distrae, ella lo mata. Con rabia, Aurelio amenaza al Chema por teléfono.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema hace que Rutila grabe un video como prueba de vida para Aurelio, ya que quiere hacer negocios. Andrew obtiene material donde el general Garnica aparece con drogas, con el que pretende chantajearlo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor le dice a Ignacio que descubrió su escondite de armas, y quiere saber si él pertenece al Escuadrón de la Muerte. El Chema y Aurelio se encuentran cara a cara en Villa Catalina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio negocia con el Chema la libertad de Rutila, pero antes deben repartirse los territorios para evitar una guerra. Andrew presiona a Lay: quiere saber sobre sus vínculos con los Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila seduce al Chema, y logra que él le dé su número de teléfono; finalmente, él la entrega a Aurelio. Leonor le confiesa a Victoria que Ignacio trabaja para el Escuadrón de la Muerte.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa entrega a Victoria y Leonor la grabación que incrimina al general Garnica. Leonor la sigue y la encuentra en Villa Catalina. Aurelio, despechado, manda a matar a Santiago.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Despechado, Aurelio envía a sus hombres a asesinar a Santiago, pero el atentado se complica cuando Ximena resulta baleada. El Chema averigua que Lay se fue a Colombia, y ordena que la maten.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena acusa a Aurelio de haber mandado a matar a Santiago, y él le ruega no decirle nada a sus hijas. Rutila la ve morir y le dice a su padre que lo hará pagar por esa muerte.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La tormentosa relación de Mónica y Aurelio se quiebra: él le confiesa que sus hombres mataron accidentalmente a Ximena, y que nunca dejó de amarla. Victoria ordena allanar el rancho de Danilo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria se horroriza cuando descubre que Danilo Ferro es en realidad Aurelio Casillas. Chacorta alerta a su hermano de abandonar el funeral de Ximena, porque los de la Marina vienen por ellos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila llama a su padre, le dice que se acostó con su peor enemigo y le da pistas de dónde está. Ahora los Casillas quieren acabar con el Chema, pero solo logran atraer a la DEA.
