programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: After Norwegian researchers discover an alien ship buried in the ice, paleontologist Kate Lloyd (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) joins the team at the isolated Arctic outpost to investigate. She finds an organism that appears to have perished in the crash eons ago but, in fact, is about to awake. Freed from its icy prison, the insidious life-form goes on the attack. Paranoia spreads like wildfire among the crew as they fight to survive against a creature that assumes the shapes of its victims.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: Marauders
programme.desc: FBI agents (Christopher Meloni, Dave Bautista) uncover a conspiracy while trying to nail a group of deadly bank robbers.

programme.title: Detective Knight: Rogue
programme.desc: Mask-wearing robbers critically wound Detective James Knight's partner during a shootout. As Knight pursues the bandits from Los Angeles to New York, his dark past collides with his present case, threatening to tear his world apart.

programme.title: Detective Knight: Redemption
programme.desc: In custody in New York, Detective James Knight finds himself in the middle of a jailbreak led by The Christmas Bomber, a brutal fanatic whose Santa Claus disciples are terrorizing the city.

programme.title: Detective Knight: Independence
programme.desc: Detective James Knight's last-minute assignment to the Independence Day shift turns into a race against time to stop an unbalanced EMT worker who's posing as a cop.

programme.title: Red
programme.desc: After surviving an assault from a squad of hit men, retired CIA agent Frank Moses (Bruce Willis) reassembles his old team for an all-out war. Frank reunites with old Joe (Morgan Freeman), crazy Marvin (John Malkovich) and wily Victoria (Helen Mirren) to uncover a massive conspiracy that threatens their lives. Only their expert training will allow them to survive a near-impossible mission -- breaking into CIA headquarters.

programme.title: Red 2
programme.desc: Former CIA black-ops agent Frank Moses (Bruce Willis) and his old partner, Marvin Boggs (John Malkovich), are caught in the grip of retirement -- but that soon changes when a powerful Cold War weapon known as Nightshade resurfaces decades after its disappearance. With assassins hot on their trail, Frank and his team set out to find the one scientist (Anthony Hopkins) who can unravel the mystery of Nightshade and help them save themselves -- and the world.

programme.title: Marauders

Mike Enslin is a successful author who enjoys worldwide acclaim debunking supernatural phenomena -- before he checks into the Dolphin Hotel, that is. Ignoring the warnings of the hotel manager, he learns the meaning of real terror when he spends the night in a reputedly haunted room.

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: To celebrate his 30th birthday, Tyler and his six friends try an escape room challenge. The special mission for escaping a room in one hour starts, and the members immediately notice that the challenge is deadly and difficult.

programme.title: Escape Plan
programme.desc: Tough and chiseled Ray Breslin (Sylvester Stallone) knows how to infiltrate a prison -- and bust out of one. His latest job leads to a double-cross, leaving him stuck in a high-tech facility with the worst that society has to offer. Luckily for Ray, he meets Emil Rottmayer (Arnold Schwarzenegger), an inmate who secretly helps him hatch a plot to win his freedom. Only sadistic warden Hobbes (Jim Caviezel) stands in the way of the two men successfully making it out alive.

programme.title: Escape Plan 2: Hades
programme.desc: Ray Breslin manages an elite team of security specialists trained in the art of breaking people out of the world's most impenetrable prisons. When his trusted operative, Shu Ren, is kidnapped and disappears inside the most elaborate prison ever built, Ray assembles an elite team to assist in the rescue.

programme.title: Escape Plan: The Extractors
programme.desc: Ray Breslin and his team of security experts fight to rescue Breslin's girlfriend and a tech mogul's daughter from a formidable prison known as Devil's Station.

programme.desc: Five old friends receive invitations to their 20 - year high school reunion, hoping to connect and reminisce. Little do they know, they've all been keeping a secret about events that unfolded over twenty years ago. Will secrets stay buried? Or with the weight of their guilt finally tear them apart?

programme.title: Lines of Allegiance
programme.desc: After running a criminal enterprise for years, Professa feels it's time for a change. When he's set up by someone in his crew, he's arrested and sent out of Macon, GA per the judge's order. But when tragedy forces him to return, he finds the people he once cared for have their own intentions for themselves.

programme.title: Protégé
programme.desc: Alonso's wife leaves him because of financial strain in their marriage. The financial strain stems from the suffering of the taxi company Alonso's deceased father left him. He is willing to do whatever it takes to keep the taxi company going that his father left him and seek revenge against anyone he thinks is getting in his way.

programme.title: Fair Play
programme.desc: Sisters, Freedom and Sasha, learn that when it comes to love, everything has a price...that's just FAIR PLAY.

programme.title: The Betrayal 2: Revenge
programme.desc: The love of family, or the love of money? How far will you go to test the waters? Be careful who you fall for, because you might get burned.

programme.title: One Night in Tokyo
programme.desc: After his trip is abruptly cut short, Sam finds himself stranded in Tokyo for one night. Teaming up with a reluctant local, Ayaka, the two navigate the city together, confronting language barriers, personal struggles, and unexpected betrayal that reshapes their views on love and connection.

programme.title: Bad Cupid
programme.desc: Love is held hostage as an unhinged Cupid takes a heartbroken guy and his romantic rival on a comic kidnapping. Bad Cupid is full of twists with a surprise ending you'll never see coming.

programme.title: Grow House
programme.desc: Two stoners who are overwhelmed with debt decide to break into the medical marijuana business. However, they need to learn how to grow it since they're already experts at smoking it.

programme.title: Lightning Jack
programme.desc: After being taken hostage in a botched bank robbery, the mute Ben Doyle (Cuba Gooding Jr.) has inadvertently become Sancho Panza to the quixotic Lightning Jack Kane (Paul Hogan), who fancies himself a legendary Wild West outlaw. While Jack teaches Ben how to shoot, ride a horse and perform a successful heist, he's also being pursued by a posse of vigilantes. Finally seeing the writing on the wall, Lightning Jack wants to make one last score and retire, but a rival gang isn't making it easy.

programme.title: Bad Roomies
programme.desc: Two longtime friends replace their missing roommate with a beautiful stranger. After a disastrous drunken decision one night, the tension explodes into a hilarious, cutthroat battle as roommate turns against roommate.

programme.title: Love & Taxes
programme.desc: A comic tale of seven years of tax avoidance. Following the possibly real-life exploits of Josh Kornbluth, this comedy blends solo performance and scripted scenes to bring the subjective reality of the storyteller hilariously to life.

programme.title: One Night in Tokyo
programme.desc: After his trip is abruptly cut short, Sam finds himself stranded in Tokyo for one night. Teaming up with a reluctant local, Ayaka, the two navigate the city together, confronting language barriers, personal struggles, and unexpected betrayal that reshapes their views on love and connection.

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a comet causes a radiation storm on Earth, machines come to life and turn against their makers. Holed up in a North Carolina truck stop, a group of survivors must fend for themselves against a mass of homicidal trucks. A diner cook, Bill Robinson (Emilio Estevez), emerges as the unlikely leader of the pack, attempting to find an escape plan for himself and the survivors, who include his boss, Bubba Hendershot (Pat Hingle), and a newlywed couple.

programme.title: Salvation
programme.desc: A foster child bonds with a snake-handling Pentecostal community but uncovers sinister truths. She must choose between reporting pastor's crimes or preserving her newfound support system, risking personal safety for a sense of belonging.

programme.title: P2
programme.desc: Angela (Rachel Nichols) is working late on Christmas Eve. When she finally decides to leave, she goes down to the parking garage to get her car, but it won't start. Thomas (Wes Bentley), the garage's security guard, offers to help. He also invites Angela to dinner, but she refuses. Thomas, crazed, knocks her out. She wakes up in Thomas' office, chained to a chair and in different clothes. Now Angela must fight for her life in order the escape from the garage.

programme.title: Cell
programme.desc: In a Boston airport, a character named Clay, played by Cusack, observes an electronic signal that causes cellphone users to commit acts of violence. Clay and a train driver, played by Jackson, travel through the city to locate Clay's family while avoiding the violent individuals.
A naïve young man assumes a dead man's identity in order to join an underworld game of Russian roulette. Costarring Mickey Rourke, Jason Statham, and Michael Shannon.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: After his father, an assassin, is brutally murdered, Nick Gant vows revenge on Division, the covert government agency that dabbles in psychic warfare and experimental drugs. Hiding in Hong Kong's underworld, Nick assembles a band of rogue psychics dedicated to destroying Division. Together with Cassie, a teenage clairvoyant, Nick goes in search of a missing girl and a stolen suitcase that could be the key to accomplishing their mutual goal.

programme.title: A Husband for Christmas
programme.desc: Brooke and Roger, two graphic designers in a soon-to-be-merged company, help one another by agreeing to a loveless marriage of convenience. In the process, Brooke gets to upstage her sister who just announced her engagement to Brooke's ex-boyfriend.

programme.title: Snowbound for Christmas
programme.desc: A marketing executive is invited by her charming and handsome boss to pitch a major project to prospective clients at a posh resort and the two get snowed in together before any of the other guests can arrive. Now, with the hotel to themselves, a fairytale snowscape outside and sparks flying inside they find that being alone together is all the Christmas magic they need.

programme.title: Christmas for Sale
programme.desc: Real estate mogul Terri McKenzie finds herself with a case of mistaken identity when billionaire George Camden needs help with his divorce proceedings. When she falls in too deep, can the truth save her company and her heart?

programme.title: Woman Thou Art Loosed
programme.desc: Woman Thou Art Loosed follows the life of Michelle Jordan (Kimberly Elise) who is raised in a home of dysfunction and abuse. The years of mistreatment from her mother's (Loretta Devine) boyfriend results in Michelle's entanglement in the world of drugs, prostitution and imprisonment. It is behind bars that Michelle finally receives the help she needs. It is the counseling Bishop T.D. Jakes (as himself) that empowers Michelle to start on the road to healing.

programme.title: Moonlight
programme.desc: In three defining chapters, Chiron, a young Black man growing up in Miami, is guided to manhood by the kindness, support, and love of his community.

programme.title: All Dirt Roads Taste of Salt
programme.desc: A richly layered ode to the generations of people and places that shape us in a lyrical, decades-spanning exploration across a woman's life in Mississippi. The haunting feature debut from award-winning artist Raven Jackson.

programme.title: Momma Said Come Home for Christmas
programme.desc: When a family matriarch calls all her children home for Christmas, a vacation full of surprises unfolds as lovers bond and family members collide.

programme.title: Jesse James
programme.desc: Jesse James and his brother Frank race to secure the family's buried gold as members of the James-Younger gang attempt to steal it.

programme.title: Best Man Dead Man
programme.desc: A bachelor party in the middle of nowhere quickly turns into a night of murder and mystery when the best man ends up with a knife in his head. Everyone is a suspect; only an eccentric private eye in town can solve the mystery.

programme.title: Buckskin 2
programme.desc: After the events of the first film, Eli Porter is asked to return to the cursed Buckskin woods in the hopes of finding a young lady who is wanted by rival tribes and business men alike in the west.

programme.title: Joe Baby

programme.title: The Herbert Macaulay Affair
programme.desc: The Herbert Macaulay Affair is a story that follows Young Herbert who returns from England and begins the opposition to the colonial government In 1898, Herbert is done with his scholarship training and becomes the first Engineer and Surveyor in the colony. Upon his return he is employed by the Colonial Government in Lagos He faces a lot of discrimination and watches it being done to fellow Lagosians. Annoyed by the constant marginalization, Herbert quits his job with the colonial government and starts a long opposition to them. He meets a beautiful woman Caroline Pratt who he falls madly in love with and unfortunately loses her to death during childbirth. Herbert is devastated and when he emerges from that darkness he delves more into fighting for independence. Our film catalogues a series of historical events which ends with him going to England to represent the Oba at the Privy council despite the colonial government doing everything to stop him. Car chases, Intrigues, schemes, nationalism and family are all part of this intense 90 minutes movie William Benson plays the Title character Herbert Macaulay. A veteran actor of many theatrical performances. He is well-beloved by a lot of Nigerians mostly because of his role as General Ape in the critically-acclaimed primetime drama Ajoche. He has garnered a cult following and delivers an Oscar-worthy performance in our film The Herbert Macaulay Affair

programme.title: Gacal
programme.desc: Lonely and heartbroken, Assad is left at home while his charming brother, Nuur, heads out on a long-awaited date with a woman he has been pursuing. Little does Assad know that this day will turn his life upside down. Just as Nuur steps out, a sudden knock on the door startles Assad. Opening it, he is met with a powerful punch to the face. Standing before him is Barkhad, the husband of the woman Nuur is currently on a date with. Barkhad, in a case of mistaken identity, believes Assad is his wife's illicit lover.Fueled by anger and a desire to seek revenge on Nuur, Barkhad decides to take matters into his own hands. He restrains Assad as he waits, knife in hand, for Nuur to return. As the day unfolds, a twist of fate intertwines the lives of Assad, Barkhad, and Nuur. Forced to spend time together, Assad and Barkhad gradually find common ground and an unexpected bond. Sharing their stories and vulnerabilities, they start to question their judgments and perceptions of one another.

programme.title: Veve
programme.desc: VEVE follows the lives of multiple characters trying to find themselves in a world of political intrigue, revenge, love and longings for success complemented by the background of the thriving yet unregulated veve business. Amos, an ambitious politician, is running for another term as Maua MP whilst facing his opponent Wadu in the extension of his veve empire. His wife Esther discovers the true nature of his affairs and seeks solace in Kenzo, a conflicted young man out to seek vengeance for his father’s death. Sammy, Amos’ right hand man, has to choose between being loyal to his work and being a caring father to his 12-year-old son Kago. Maua´s Veve Farmers want to farm a union to force Amos to pay decent prices for their veve. Clint, a hedonistic wannabe documentary filmmaker meddles to far, blind of the dangers he is putting himself and others into. All are in search of purpose not knowing, that their destinies are entwined in more ways than they imagine.

programme.title: Pure Blue Fish
programme.desc: Imagine eating the most delicious, ocean-fresh yellowtail, bluefish, or redfish — that came from the desert, not the ocean. In this episode, Dr. Phil meets the brains behind Pure Blue Fish — an innovative aquaculture company raising sushi-grade ocean fish hours from the nearest ocean. It's as sustainable as it is delicious.

programme.title: Jersey Shore Star's 6 Pack Surgery
programme.desc: Jersey Shore star undergoes 6-pack surgery! Housewives on drug-spiked cheese? The benefits of cow cuddling? DIY facial! Are women happier with younger men? Autistic man’s amazing weight loss. New fitness trend: crawling emotional support alligator. The fruit you need to eat!

programme.title: Is Breast Implant Illness Real?
programme.desc: Find out why so many women are removing their breast implants. Could breast implant illness be to blame? Are you your own worst enemy? Do you get in your own way? Psychologist Dr. Judy Ho breaks down how to “Stop Self-Sabotage!” Could your favorite Boba drink put you at risk for intestinal blockage? Who says self-care has to be expensive? Find out how to self-care on a budget!

programme.title: Sexy Too Soon
programme.desc: At an age when most girls are passing notes in class and playing tag on the playground, the girls in today’s show are concerned with sex appeal and lingerie! You’ll meet two “preteens” who, in Dr. Phil’s opinion, are dressing too sexy for their age. In addition, Dr. Phil visits a 12-year-old’s website that features her doing a variety of daily tasks…in a bikini! Her mom thinks it’s a good way for her to earn money for college and build self-esteem. Dr. Phil examines what’s “appropriate” and what’s not, and what do to when your daughter dresses way too “hot.”

programme.title: Parenting Gone Bad
programme.desc: Continuing with the Parenting 101 series, Dr. Phil talks with parents who may be taking discipline too far! One husband says his wife’s screaming and swearing at their kids is destroying their family. Will sparks fly when Dr. Phil addresses her verbal abuse? Then, meet one mother who uses a spatula to discipline her 6-year-old daughter! Her husband is furious and wants it to stop. Has she crossed the line between discipline and abuse? Plus, a bullying father finds out why his tough love approach may be harming his child.

programme.title: My Annoying Family
programme.desc: Dr. Phil shares advice for dealing with rude, crude and obnoxious behavior from your family members.

programme.title: Moms Biggest Mistakes
programme.desc: If your job description includes long hours, little sleep, and endless requests to open your pocketbook, you must be a mom! Dr. Phil has advice for avoiding some common parenting pitfalls.

programme.title: Domestic Dictators
programme.desc: Are you married to a domestic dictator? Kelly says her controlling husband Grant pushes her to the limit every day, but he says Kelly just isn’t measuring up to his standards. Today, we follow up with one of Dr. Phil’s most talked about couples.

programme.title: New Parenting Styles
programme.desc: Are you a parent who is over- or under-involved in your child's life? Dr. Phil talks with a self-proclaimed Helicopter Mom, a Free-Range mother and two experts to help you find a happy balance while raising your kids. First up, you won't believe what happened to Lori when she let her 10-year-old son walk to soccer practice by himself. Next, meet two moms with opposite parenting approaches: Kristen lets her kids walk to friends' houses on their own and make their own mistakes, while Beckie says she can't imagine letting her kids walk around the neighborhood or even to the school playground unattended. Find out what Dr. Phil thinks. Then, Linda Murray, editor-in-chief of BabyCenter.com and Dr. Michele Borba, a parenting educator and author, share the pros and cons of different parenting styles. And, Dr. Phil checks in with Teresa, who became known as America's Most Over-Protective Mom. Find out if she and her daughter, Ashlee, who's now 18, are getting along better.

programme.title: A Father Accused of a Deadly Family Attack
programme.desc: Dr. Phil speaks with a mother whose ex-husband is accused of a deadly family attack that resulted in the death of their 11 month old daughter, her shot multiple times, and their other young daughter suffering from life threatening stab wounds.

programme.title: Forever or Never
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.title: Couples' Cam: Where Do We Go From Here?
programme.desc: From life's lows like coping with difficult medical diagnoses, to highs like the thrill of moving into a new home or the joys of pregnancy and babies, we watch as the couples experience the many facets of marriage.

programme.title: She Never Came Home
programme.desc: However shocking the crime, media headlines eventually fade, but for heartbroken friends and family, the memories and their longing for justice never do. Cold Case Files? produced by the team behind Investigative ReportsTM, digs deep into the past, following detectives as they strive to breathe new life into "cold" unsolved crimes. Armed with the latest DNA technology and with dogged determination, investigators seek new leads in hopes of bringing the guilty to justice decades after the crimes have been committed. Whether it's a man who was initially a prime suspect in his son's death, watching as the police begin to suspect his wife or the gruesome shooting of an elderly couple whose bodies were found in the woods, each episode features a different cold case.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia has enjoyed clamming with the locals in Le Marche as well as in Long Island, and in this episode she shares two of her most popular dishes: Pappa al Pomodoro with Clams is based on the Tuscan classic-tomato and bread soup. Clam and Scallion Risotto, is a delicious variation of the beloved Linguine with Clams.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Zucchini sautéed with garlic, anchovies and capers; fried zucchini; orecchiette with clams and zucchini; sweet-and-sour zucchini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares some of her flagship restaurant's favorite recipes that can be made at home. They include "gnudi" (Spinach and Ricotta Dumplings); and a flavorful Whole Roasted Branzino. She'll also be talking "restaurant secrets" with some of her chefs in this episode.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Shrimp and melon salad with basil mint pesto; peaches in white wine; mezze rigatoni with raw tomato sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fish is a staple on Lidia's table and today, Lidia shares a simple menu for a party based around fish. In the summertime, she likes to turn on the grill and make Shrimp Spiedini with Zucchini with Tomato Salsa. She serves them with Seared Salmon Paillards with Arugula Salad; and finally, Cody Hogan from Lidia's Kansas City joins Lidia in the kitchen and they make Monkfish Meatballs served in tomato sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Soups are a delicious and comforting way to warm up especially in the winter months. On the menu today is Spicy Italian Soup, Calabria's version of vegetable soup; The Perfect Simple Salad, a simple and light side that works for any kind of soup; and an easy-to-make Butternut Squash Soup, garnished with crispy crumbled bacon.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Crostini with fresh tomatoes and ricotta; warm crostini with smothered kale and melty fontina; monkfish brodetto with cannellini; garlic bread three ways.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia grew up around goats, who loved to play and run, but also produced the most delicious milk which would then be used to make ricotta. Here she makes light and pillowy "Naked" Spinach and Ricotta Dumplings. She then prepares an easy, sweet Open Cookie Cannoli. Finally, her Ricotta Meatloaf is topped with tomato sauce to give it some Italian flair.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia tosses arborio rice with olives, roasted peppers, artichokes, and provolone to create a satisfying and vibrant "Antipasto" Rice Salad. She also pulls together a Sauteed Chicken dressed in a Bright Lemon Caper Sauce over Spinach.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There are few things better than a great piece of meat braised in Barolo wine. When accompanied by some braised vegetables, you've got yourself a great meal. In this episode, Lidia prepares a crispy golden Italian Style Quiche followed by a fork tender Beef Braised in Barolo. Her side dish is a Braised Broccoli Rabe with garlic and extra virgin olive oil. This is a meal any family will love.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Four cheese baked macaroni with asparagus and peas; cider vinegar spritz; spicy vinegar ribs and potatoes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today, Lidia creates the ultimate heartwarming dinner table filled with dishes that deliver flavor, comfort and love in every bite. She starts with a soothing Rice and Lentil Soup topped with cheese and olive oil; Roasted Olives with Orange and Rosemary are an exciting accompaniment to any meal and Ricotta Meatloaf, a family favorite packed with cheese and topped with fresh tomato sauce and even more cheese, is the star of the show.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When talking about a juicy steak, grilling often comes to mind but for Lidia, it's all about the sear. In today's episode, Lidia begins with a crispy Montasio Cheese Frico stuffed with potatoes and onions. She then makes a Seared Steak with a perfectly balanced sauce of rosemary, shallots and mixed mushrooms. Her side dish is a Braised Escarole with olive oil, pepperoncino and garlic -simple and delicious.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Bergamot and ricotta parfait with nougatine and toasted almonds; almond tart; chocolate anise biscotti.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Shaved fennel, red onion and prosciutto cotto salad; cherry jam tart with wild cherries from the Emilia Romagna region of Italy; prosciutto, scallion and egg sandwich.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The fig tree at Lidia's current home reminds her of her time growing up in Istria, where they would grow fruit trees. This brings back memories of eating the sweet fruits grown on the trees and playing amongst them. Recipes in this episode include a Roasted Pork Loin with Dried Cherry Sauce and an elegant Fennel and Asian Pear Salad that bursts with flavor.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia reminisces about her Grandma's cantina (cellar) and how she spent every summer helping her grandmother prepare the food from the bounty of the harvest for the fall and winter months. Lidia's cantina has evolved into a pantry, and in this episode she will prepare pantry friendly dishes.

programme.title: Eating In With Lidia
programme.desc: Chef Lidia Bastianich shows how to mix and balance seasonal flavors from your own garden in order to create new recipes based on what's available.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Who doesn't love comfort food? In this episode, Lidia shares some of her most requested and delicious comfort food recipes: Pasta and Bean Soup; Decadent ham in Marsala Sauce; and her italian version of one of America's favorites: Hamburger and Homemade Ketchup.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When it's cold outside, Lidia's kitchen kicks into high gear. The oven is on and the stovetop is always lit. On today's menu, she'll prepare her Turkey Meatloaf with Mushroom Sauce -a real family favorite that is smothered in mushroom sauce. Vin Brulee is a mulled wine infused with warm spices; it's the perfect choice to warm up on a cold night.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Brodetto is a savory, soup fish preparation that can be found up and down the coast of Italy. Lidia makes her Brodetto with onion, scallion, clams and mussels and lots of parsley and pepperoncino. Lidia's Walnut Cake is delicate and nutty with just enough espresso to make it truly Italian.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia talks about the harvest of wheat and the hard work involved with making flour and eventually bread and pasta. She fondly reflects on her moments with Grandma Rosa during her trips to the mill. Lidia turns leftover bread into croutons with her Caesar Salad with Baby Kale and Focaccia Croutons. She then prepares a flavor-packed Fusilli with Spinach and Herbed Ricotta, as well as Lagane Pasta with Chickpeas.

programme.title: Move In or Move On
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.title: Couples' Cam: Taking On New Roles
programme.desc: From life's lows like coping with difficult medical diagnoses, to highs like the thrill of moving into a new home or the joys of pregnancy and babies, we watch as the couples experience the many facets of marriage.

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: 1943 marks the turning point in the war, as the Allies open new fronts. programme.title: The Death Train

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: Ewald von Kleist has broken through to the Terek river, slap in front of the vital oil fields of Grozny and Baku. Only freezing temperatures in the Caucasus prevent von Kleist's 1st Panzer Army from breaking through to Ozoni Kizi and Tbilisi. The Soviets launch a desperate counter-attack that holds the Germans back.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: The Fall of Saigon occurred on April 30, 1975 when the South Vietnamese government announced its unconditional surrender to North Vietnam. As a line of tanks smashed through the gates of the presidential palace, Vietcong troops rounded up government soldiers, and raised their red and blue flags. The United States Embassy remained under control of the U.S. Marines.

programme.title: Late War Fighters of the Luftwaffe
programme.desc: Hitler was losing the war in 1944. In the East, Russians rolled forward relentlessly, threatening the existence of Hitler's Third Reich. Hitler knew that if he were to survive, he needed a miracle. New technologies, or miracle weapons, could turn the tide of war. Against all odds, German engineers not only designed but produced in good numbers some of the best aircraft of the war, the ME262.

programme.title: Annihilation: The Destruction of European Jews
programme.desc: In the Warsaw ghetto, Emanuel Ringelblum and the other members of the documentary group Oyneg Shabbos collected whatever they could to recount life in the ghetto. When they learn of the death at Chelmno of Jews from neighboring towns and from the Lodz ghetto at the end of 1941, they realized that the Nazis and their local auxiliaries had embarked on an operation of annihilation.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: This issue of The Big Picture depicts the many aspects of our soldiers' daily living in the Korean war zone during the winter period 1952-53. Our Signal Corps combat cameramen give Big Picture viewers a vivid and comprehensive account of activities during this period of operations. This issue shows the people of America what the soldier has gone through during this particular winter period.

programme.title: WWI The War To End All Wars - Part 1: The Valley of Death
programme.desc: June 1914, Europe was in the midst of an idealic summer. The nations of Europe were joined together by webs of trade and capital. Their royal houses linked by bonds of family and marriage. Global trade was at an all time high. The prospect of all an all out European war was unthinkable, pundits said. No one saw the catastrophe coming, until it came. World War I - The War to End All Wars.

programme.title: Blood Money - Inside the Soviet Economy
programme.desc: In 1941, as Nazi Germany invaded, the USSR faced collapse. Stalin ordered entire factories moved east by train-steelworks, tank plants, munitions lines. Millions of workers became an army of labor, rebuilding industry and forging weapons far from the front.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: The Polish Jews of the Warsaw Ghetto rose up against their oppressors and although facing the horrors of the Nazi Concentration Camps, German army units were needed to deal with the situation. The French Resistance was also formed.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty

Ports like Liverpool and Portsmouth echo this legacy, forging Britain's enduring identity as an island nation defined by maritime power.

programme.title: Peaceful Mudflats: The Life of the Mudskipper, Shinan Mudflats <6>
programme.desc: Constituting 85% of Korea's UNESCO-designated tidal flats, Shinan Mudflats are the largest and most unique, formed among numerous islands. Explore the charming life of the mudskipper in this ecologically valuable area.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret Garden: Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace EP.4 <4>
programme.desc: Nakseonjae combines noble residence style with palace architecture, featuring unique decorative patterns that showcase late Joseon craftsmanship. Enjoy a break at the exclusive Rear Garden of Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: A Hat Full of Jeju: Cocculus Hat <71>
programme.desc: Woven from Jeju’s native vines, the cocculus hat reflects the islanders’ harmony with nature. Once used to shield from sun and rain, it carries the quiet wisdom of a life rooted in the land.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Hometown of Custom Brassware: Brassware Master <28>
programme.desc: A brassware master is an artisan with the skill of making various utensils from brass. We look into the work of a brassware master skilled in the technique of casting brassware.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Art of Steel: Ornamental Knife Making Master <67>
programme.desc: Small in size, yet rich in meaning—ornamental knives once symbolized both elegance and status. Through intricate forging and decorative detail, these steel blades carry the strength and refinement of tradition.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Legacy of Joseon Ceramics: Porcelain Master <23>
programme.desc: The Baeksan family is a traditional prestigious family that has continued Korean ceramics for over 300 years since the era of King Yeongjo of Joseon Dynasty, greatly supported by the efforts of son Kim Kyung-sik, and grandson Kim Ji-Hoon.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Embodying Wishes in Paper: Jihwa Master <43>
programme.desc: Jihwa has been used not only in the royal court but also in family celebrations, Buddhist ceremonies, and shamanic rituals since ancient times. A Jihwa master is an artisan who cuts and decorates paper to create adornments for ceremonies.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Soaring Squid: Jeolla Province Ritual Food Master <72>
programme.desc: In southern Korea, a dried squid transforms into a phoenix on the ritual table. This delicate food art, rooted in care and reverence, embodies the spirit and blessing of traditional ceremonies.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Traditional Winter Tea Table: Royal Confectionery Winter Table <4>
programme.desc: Sit in the warm ondol room with thick rice cakes (Duteopddeok) and sweet Gaeseong Yakgwa, and enjoy a warm cup of Sujeonggwa. Feel the warmth of winter.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Flowering Devotion: Shoe Making Master <65>
programme.desc: Traditional Korean shoes, delicately stitched petal by petal, are more than footwear—they embody beauty, craftsmanship, and heartfelt wishes. Each step in their making reflects generations of devotion passed down through time.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Carving for the Sacred: Metal Engraving Master <59>
programme.desc: Metal carving, a tradition rooted in the Bronze Age, lives on in the intricate patterns engraved onto sarira reliquaries. Each hammer strike reflects the artisan’s devotion, preserving the sacred through centuries of skill.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Carving Blessings into Rice Cake Mold: Wood Carving Master <63>
programme.desc: Delicate patterns carved into small wooden molds are more than decorations—they carry heartfelt wishes for good fortune. The sound of carving reveals the timeless devotion behind traditional confections.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Drops of Crimson Tears: Brewing Red Liquor <76>
programme.desc: Grains, yeast, and the patience of time come together to create deep crimson liquor. Distilled in the traditional way, Jindo Hongju carries the warmth of the land and the devotion of its maker.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Scenery with Royal Tombs: Gwangneung <9>
programme.desc: Gwangneung Forest is a dense forest 30 times the size of Yeouido in Seoul, known for its ecological stability and species diversity. Experience the sounds and scenery of Gwangneung.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret of Hanji that Lasts a Thousand Years: Stripping Mulberry Bark <54>
programme.desc: Traditional Hanji possesses excellent value, enduring for a thousand years without changing. Let’s appreciate the process of stripping the bark from mulberry trees, the main raw material in the creation of traditional Hanji.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Palace in the Rain: Gyeongbokgung <29>
programme.desc: Inviting you to Gyeongbokgung Palace on a rainy day. The raindrops falling on the gray slate of the palace flow down the slate, creating beautiful sounds.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Listening to the Mountain Temple: Haenam Daeheungsa <8>
programme.desc: Daeheungsa is located in Duryunsan Provincial Park, a famous mountain in Haenam, with traces of famous monks. Feel the serene scenery and sounds of the temple.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Legacy of Sound: Daegeum Master <42>
programme.desc: Daegeum, which is one of Korea's representative traditional instruments is a wind instrument with holes drilled into bamboo to produce sound. Let’s follow the work process of these artisans who keep the tradition alive.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Subtle Fragrance: Tea Making <12>
programme.desc: In the early morning on the slopes of Jirisan, grandmothers pick wild tea leaves among the pine trees. Experience the subtle fragrance of traditional tea making.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret Garden: Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace EP.1 <1>
programme.desc: Nakseonjae combines noble residence style with palace architecture, featuring unique decorative patterns that showcase late Joseon craftsmanship. Enjoy a break at the exclusive Rear Garden of Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Autumn Forest of the Royal Tombs: With Queen Inhyeon's Tears, SeoOReung <19>
programme.desc: Named for its five royal tombs, Seoreung in Goyang is the second-largest royal tomb cluster of the Joseon Dynasty. Explore its vast, well-preserved natural forest paths, known as "Shinrim" (Divine Forest).(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Autumn Forest of the Royal Tombs: Connecting Mother and Son, Taereung and Gangneung <18>
programme.desc: Located in Seoul, Taereung is the resting place of Queen Munjeong, while Gangneung is for her son, King Myeongjong, and his wife, Queen Insun. The two tombs, belonging to mother and son, are connected by a serene forest path.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Radiografía de una masacre
programme.desc: Una familia destruida tras un inesperado ataque con armas de fuego, habla sobre todo el sufrimiento que tuvieron que pasar al perder a sus seres queridos en manos de organizaciones delictivas. Una de las masacres más sangrientas y terribles de México.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - El hijo de El Chapo captura y liberación de un intocable
programme.desc: El ejército mexicano despliega un operativo en Culiacán, Sinaloa para detener a un familiar de Joaquín Guzmán Loera 'El Chapo'. El objetivo es capturado, durante un día Culiacán queda atrapado en un enfrentamiento entre el ejército y los narcos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Fentanilo la nueva apuesta del narco
programme.desc: México es país productor y de tránsito de Fentanilo, un opioide sintético el cual es cada vez más consumido en Estados Unidos. Esta droga causa muchas muertes entre jóvenes. Un kilo de fentanilo genera las mismas ganancias que una tonelada de cocaína.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - El experimento
programme.desc: El bebé de Maritza Ramírez es secuestrado el día programado para nacer. En su fiesta de 16 años, los síntomas de la enfermedad de Helen reaparecen. Lumpkin, un pueblo olvidado es la ubicación de una cárcel de inmigrantes.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Acoso sin cuartel
programme.desc: La muerte de la soldado Vanessa Guillén ha provocado un movimiento nacional para hablar sobre un tema incómodo, la violencia sexual contra las mujeres en las fuerzas armadas, por años los abusos contra ellas han sido una epidemia sin control.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - El menos pensado
programme.desc: Juan Morales cansado de estar confinado en una silla de ruedas decidió desafiar su límites y se convirtió en el distribuidor de drogas de su escuela. Envuelto en violencia callejera, Juan logró salir adelante para volverse un psicólogo.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Crímenes sin resolver
programme.desc: El tiempo parece moverse en cámara lenta para familiares, amigos y conocidos de personas que han sido víctimas de diferentes crímenes que, desgraciadamente, muchas veces no logran ser resueltos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Inundados en plástico
programme.desc: Poco a poco el ser humano termina con el planeta que habita, hoy, el plástico es uno de los mayores enemigos, no se degrada, no desaparece y ahora llena los mares, amenazando su flora y fauna sin control.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Desaparecidos de la frontera
programme.desc: Ante la incompetencia de las autoridades, familiares se han convertido en investigadores privados aficionados dispuestos a enfrentar riesgos, ellos dicen vivir una carrera contra el tiempo para evitar que sus seres queridos desaparezcan para siempre.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - El gran golpe
programme.desc: Una banda de asaltantes con armas de juguete se llevó casi veinte millones de dólares de las cajillas de seguridad de un banco, lo sorpendente es que no hubo heridos ni disparos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Atracción fatal
programme.desc: Un hombre habla sobre el infierno que vivió con la desaparición de su esposa, pues no solo sufría por ella al no saber donde estaba, también tuvo que lidiar con el hecho de que se convirtió en el principal sospechoso.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Frontera: las rutas de la crisis

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Edición especial: Cinco secretos, gran sacrificio
programme.desc: Entre lágrimas, un pequeño niño le confiesa a su madre adoptiva que quiere volver con su familia biológica. Estrellas latinas del Cirque du Soleil hablan sobre el cambio drástico en sus vidas tras la pandemia, pues se vieron obligadas a dejar los shows.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - La oscura luz del mundo

programme.desc: Celina desea ser monja porque Augusto terminó con ella. Paola busca a Diego y le pide que regresen. Damiana organiza una cena para que Celina conozca a Francisco. Diego perdona a Paola, pero no regresa con ella. Roberta besa a Simón por venganza.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 147
programme.desc: Nico termina su noviazgo con Karen. Para herir a Roberta, Paola le dice que se reconcilió con Diego. Teo es aceptado en la Logia. Mía le reclama a Roberta que haya usurpado su identidad. En lugar de Teo, Miguel planea asistir a la ceremonia de iniciación.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 148
programme.desc: Lupita habla con Pilar y le dice que se la pasa bien con Tomás, pero con sólo escuchar el nombre de Nico, todo se le olvida. El padre de Diego le regala un auto, lo cual le molesta, porque sólo trata de comprar su cariño. Teo es capturado por La Logia.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 149
programme.desc: Valeria le propone a Franco vivir juntos, pero él se niega porque Mía es su prioridad y debe estar libre para ella. El padre de Karen le prohíbe a Nico que vaya al café y que se olvide de la banda por terminar la relación con Karen.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 150
programme.desc: La banda se entera que Gastón estuvo en el café y los vio tocar. Galia habla con Pilar y le dice que cada una deberá enfrentar sus errores. Mía pelea con Miguel por culpa de Luz Viviana, ella amenaza con contarle a su papá que está en la banda.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 151
programme.desc: Giovanni logra escapar de La Logia, Miguel y los demás chicos informan al director que Giovanni y Teo no están en el colegio. Tomás y Lupita están discutiendo y escuchan un golpe, es Giovanni quien cae de la azotea.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 152
programme.desc: Afortunadamente Teo no está muerto, Enrique y los chicos lo reaniman mientras esperan a los paramédicos. Carlo le dice a Alma que alguien debe poner a Roberta en su lugar. El director Pascual no cree en la existencia de La Logia.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 153
programme.desc: José visita a Teo en el hospital y le dice que lo ama. Alma toma la decisión de irse debido al comportamiento de Roberta. Giovanni confiesa que sabe dónde están los archivos de La Logia y los nombres de los integrantes.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 154
programme.desc: La habitación de la azotea arde en llamas, Pascual y Galia corren para controlar el fuego. El director Pascual y el Lic. Mendiola no saben qué hacer con los alumnos que forman La Logia.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 155
programme.desc: Pascual y el Lic. Mendiola llegan a un acuerdo para que nadie se entere sobre La Logia. Roberta trata de hablar con su madre, pero Alma sigue muy dolida. Giovanni es expulsado del colegio. Pilar le confiesa a Pascual que es parte de La Logia.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 156
programme.desc: Enrique le hace saber a todo el colegio, que la escuela opera bajo una Logia y León sugiere clausurar el colegio. Carlo le propone una nueva oportunidad de trabajo en Estados Unidos a Alma. Giovanni discute con su papá por haberse unido a la Logia.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 157
programme.desc: Miguel ya no quiere trabajar para Franco, pero él le pide que vaya con Mía a un viaje. Mía le pide a Alma que hable con su papá para que la deje cantar en el grupo. Alma le confiesa a Franco que las niñas falsificaron las firmas en el contrato del grupo.

programme.title: Pecado
programme.desc: Virginia es una mujer ambiciosa que junto con Andrés, su amante de edad avanzada, buscan recuperar un botín de oro robado que Andrés escondió diez años atrás, en un río en Guatemala.

programme.title: Las Golfas
programme.desc: Diana es una trabajadora sexual que es despedida del cabaret donde trabaja, conoce a Luis quien entra en el negocio de las drogas. Emiliano es el líder del negocio de las drogas y también trata de conquistar a Diana.

programme.title: El día de las madres
programme.desc: Tres madres sufren al ver a sus hijos crecer, enfrentarse a los retos de la vida, enamorarse, cumplir sus sueños y luchar por salir adelante. A pesar de las adversidades, los muchachos celebran el 10 de mayo con la mujer más importante de sus vidas.

programme.title: Adiós Lagunilla, adiós
programme.desc: El Múltiple y el Pistón se dedican a toda clase de negocios para ganar dinero, deciden ir a probar suerte a Estado Unidos, los suegros del Múltiple deciden ir a buscarlos y a su regreso a México se encuentran con desagradables sorpresas.

programme.title: San Simón de los Magueyes
programme.desc: Cuando se rompe la estatua del santo patrono antes de su festival, un sacerdote contrata a un mimo de una compañía ambulante para que se haga pasar por la estatua durante el horario de la iglesia.

programme.title: Doña Macabra
programme.desc: Othón y su esposa Lucila buscan un tesoro en una vieja casona, donde habitan Armida, su loco hermano y su amiga Demetria, quienes se dedican a la brujería. Cuando Armida descubre las intenciones de Othón, hará de todo para asustarlos.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 22
programme.desc: José Armando encara al Dr. Lucio Malaver y pone las cartas sobre la mesa. Fermín ata cabos y descubre un secreto sobre Esmeralda y José Armando. Fátima ve a Graciela y Adrián besándose. Rodolfo quiere imponer su voluntad a José Armando.

programme.title: Mañana Es Para Siempre Capítulo 139
programme.desc: Eduardo descubre que Artemio planea deshacerse de Liliana. Damián le asegura a Vladimir que Priscila no es una buena mujer. Fernanda descubre que Camilo intentó abusar de Aurora.

programme.desc: Dominga le confirma a Fermín la hipótesis que tiene sobre la identidad de Esmeralda. Fátima reprende a Graciela por su affaire y pone un plan en marcha. Rodolfo manda a que Esmeralda y sus allegados abandonen la choza en la que viven.

programme.desc: Eva sospecha que Margarita es la verdadera madre de Rosario. Juan le pide a Pedro que perdone a su padre de todos los males que le hizo vivir. Sarita le pide a Franco que se aleje de su vida para siempre.

programme.title: Amores con Trampa Capítulo 43

programme.desc: Gracias a Justo, Derecho encuentra a Giuliano y lo detiene. El Padrino amenaza a Santos con hacerle daño a María si no dejan de investigarlo. Rubén intenta abusar de María.

programme.title: Latency

programme.title: Moonfall

programme.title: Escape Plan: The Extractors

programme.title: Escape Room

programme.title: Cell
programme.desc: In a Boston airport, a character named Clay, played by Cusack, observes an electronic signal that causes cellphone users to commit acts of violence. Clay and a train driver, played by Jackson, travel through the city to locate Clay's family while avoiding the violent individuals.

programme.title: The Mist
programme.desc: After a powerful storm damages their Maine home, David Drayton (Thomas Jane) and his young son head into town to gather food and supplies. Soon afterward, a thick fog rolls in and engulfs the town, trapping the Draytons and others in the grocery store. Terror mounts as deadly creatures reveal themselves outside, but that may be nothing compared to the threat within, where a zealot (Marcia Gay Harden) calls for a sacrifice.

programme.title: The Crazies
programme.desc: Anarchy reigns when an unknown toxin turns the peaceful citizens of Ogden Marsh into bloodthirsty lunatics. In an effort to contain the spread of the infection, authorities blockade the town and use deadly force to keep anyone from getting in or out. Now trapped among killers, Sheriff Dutton and his wife and two companions must band together to find a way out before madness and death overtake them.

programme.title: Dead Money
programme.desc: Four drug kingpins deal with inner turmoil, familial strife, and heightened stakes while taking a chance on a risky business proposition of organ trafficking.

programme.title: Let's Shake On It
programme.desc: A simple dinner date turns into a fun loving challenge when Brian(Jarrett Glover) insists he can prepare a better meal then what he was served at a resteraunt. His girlfriend Trina(Tia Pratcher) is sure he'll fail especially since he has a reputation for burning food but will reward him if the meal is quality by treating him to an annual music festival. He plans to use his grandmothers secret recipes to win but is faced with an unforeseen obstacle trying to obtain it.

programme.title: Make Time 4 Love
programme.desc: Sierra has it all: beauty, brains, and business. Until she's reminded that life without love is no life at all. Shay and Bobby are ready to give up on their marriage. When the cards are on the table, will they choose divorce or a 2nd chance at love?

programme.title: Soulful and Funny Episode 3 Austin
programme.desc: Crystal is joined by local comedian Bryson Brown in Austin, Texas where they head down to the historic and celebrated Victory Grill. A local staple that hosted the likes of Billie Holiday and James Brown. Crystal partakes in local history and delicious shrimp and grits for this modern spin on brunch. Then, Crystal and Bryson bring the laughs with a special performance in Austin.

programme.title: Repay it in Blood
programme.desc: Ten years after a robbery left their sister dead and their father broken, prosecutor Larissa and her sister Maritza, a top trauma nurse, are done waiting for justice. But just as the sisters begin targeting the crew responsible for that bloody night, the truth becomes deadlier than they anticipated.

programme.title: Legends of the Highway
programme.desc: Follow the true story of the Florida Highwaymen, 26 self-taught African American artists who forged their own path to success in the segregated 1950's and 60's. Their stories are guided by the mentorship of renowned landscape painters A.E. Backus, Alfred Hair, and Harold Newton. Their troupe captured Florida's breathtaking landscapes and sold their paintings along state highways, circumventing the traditional art world that excluded them.

programme.title: Love and Coffee
programme.desc: The love is hot when Breanna meets coffee shop owner Malcom, but his fear of commitment might put it on ice.

programme.title: Love & Taxes

While Jack teaches Ben how to shoot, ride a horse and perform a successful heist, he's also being pursued by a posse of vigilantes. programme.title: Tour du Faso
programme.desc: It’s Culture Clash in a sporty way! 1987 the Tour du Faso first took place in Burkina Faso. Up until now it is Africa’s biggest cycling race. Within ten stages, cyclists from Africa and Europa are crossing the sandy desert in an existing race. Amid the clash of European perfectionism and African realities we follow European hobby adventurers and African local heroes in their passionate fight for making their dreams come true. Yet, our film does not focus on the question of who will win – instead, it pays particular attention on the value of the protagonists’ experiences. The race has still retained its original and very African character as a “flawed” – but much more sympathetic – copy of the Tour de France, its European model. Some parts of the course are mere sand tracks, the advertising “caravan” consists of a single car and the cyclists are camping in the savanna during the race. TOUR DU FASO takes the audience on a time travel back to pre-commercialised decades. Following the Tour du Faso, we will get to know more about cycling, Africa and the extraordinary fighting spirit of the underdogs. Here it is still the taking part that counts...

programme.title: A Father Accused of a Deadly Family Attack
programme.desc: Dr. Phil speaks with a mother whose ex-husband is accused of a deadly family attack that resulted in the death of their 11 month old daughter, her shot multiple times, and their other young daughter suffering from life threatening stab wounds.

programme.title: Paroled at 50: The Sex Offender Loophole
programme.desc: When Jennifer learns her rapist is being released 26 years early, she discovers a hidden parole shortcut for so‑called “elderly” inmates that could send dangerous sex offenders back into communities across the country.

programme.title: Sex Offenders: Are Communities Really Safe?
programme.desc: Dr. Phil speaks with guests who share personal experiences to explain why they claim that the sex offender registry isn’t protecting the communities it aims to keep safe.

programme.title: From Campus Violence to City Hall Victory
programme.desc: Two students who refused to back down! When universities failed to act, they went to City Hall -and made history.

programme.title: How Touch Grass Together Saves Students Drowning In Brain Rot
programme.desc: College students say screen addiction, not drugs or alcohol, is the biggest health crisis on campus today.

programme.title: Is Gold Right for You?
programme.desc: With so much uncertainty surrounding oil, the economy, inflation, and retirement planning, how do you know if gold is right for you?

programme.title: Jersey Shore Star's 6 Pack Surgery
programme.desc: Jersey Shore star undergoes 6-pack surgery! Housewives on drug-spiked cheese? The benefits of cow cuddling? DIY facial! Are women happier with younger men? Autistic man’s amazing weight loss. New fitness trend: crawling emotional support alligator. The fruit you need to eat!

programme.title: Is Breast Implant Illness Real?
programme.desc: Find out why so many women are removing their breast implants. Could breast implant illness be to blame? Are you your own worst enemy? Do you get in your own way? Psychologist Dr. Judy Ho breaks down how to “Stop Self-Sabotage!” Could your favorite Boba drink put you at risk for intestinal blockage? Who says self-care has to be expensive? Find out how to self-care on a budget!

programme.title: Parenting Gone Bad
programme.desc: Continuing with the Parenting 101 series, Dr. Phil talks with parents who may be taking discipline too far! One husband says his wife’s screaming and swearing at their kids is destroying their family. Will sparks fly when Dr. Phil addresses her verbal abuse? Then, meet one mother who uses a spatula to discipline her 6-year-old daughter! Her husband is furious and wants it to stop. Has she crossed the line between discipline and abuse? Plus, a bullying father finds out why his tough love approach may be harming his child.

programme.title: My Annoying Family
programme.desc: Dr. Phil shares advice for dealing with rude, crude and obnoxious behavior from your family members.

programme.title: Moms Biggest Mistakes
programme.desc: If your job description includes long hours, little sleep, and endless requests to open your pocketbook, you must be a mom! Dr. Phil has advice for avoiding some common parenting pitfalls.

programme.title: Domestic Dictators
programme.desc: Are you married to a domestic dictator? Kelly says her controlling husband Grant pushes her to the limit every day, but he says Kelly just isn’t measuring up to his standards. Today, we follow up with one of Dr. Phil’s most talked about couples.

programme.title: New Parenting Styles
programme.desc: Are you a parent who is over- or under-involved in your child's life? Dr. Phil talks with a self-proclaimed Helicopter Mom, a Free-Range mother and two experts to help you find a happy balance while raising your kids. First up, you won't believe what happened to Lori when she let her 10-year-old son walk to soccer practice by himself. Next, meet two moms with opposite parenting approaches: Kristen lets her kids walk to friends' houses on their own and make their own mistakes, while Beckie says she can't imagine letting her kids walk around the neighborhood or even to the school playground unattended. Find out what Dr. Phil thinks. Then, Linda Murray, editor-in-chief of BabyCenter.com and Dr. Michele Borba, a parenting educator and author, share the pros and cons of different parenting styles. And, Dr. Phil checks in with Teresa, who became known as America's Most Over-Protective Mom. Find out if she and her daughter, Ashlee, who's now 18, are getting along better.

programme.title: The Daughters They Lost: Camp Mystic Parents Speak Out
programme.desc: After a July 4th flood kills 27 at a Texas girls’ camp, grieving parents share who their daughters were and why they believe this was a preventable disaster.

programme.title: Part 2: Camp Mystic Parents Demanding Accountability
programme.desc: As lawsuits and new safety laws follow the Camp Mystic tragedy, parents of “Heaven’s 27” demand accountability and changes so no other family endures their loss.

programme.title: Forever or Never
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.title: Couples' Cam: Where Do We Go From Here?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to the former home of one of the world's most famous authors in order to investigate a series of startling paranormal occurrences. Mark Twain and his family occupied this architecturally unique house for nearly 20 years. After his daughter died in the home, Twain and his family abandoned the property. Today, the curators of the house are plagued with an array of strange sights and sounds.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS takes a call from the American Legion in Pennsylvania where people are terrified by paranormals. The building was established in the 1700s and was once rented out as apartments. The current owners have had the property since 1974 and are convinced that the place is haunted, so TAPS heads in to find out. Jason and Grant begin the hunt on the third floor where the current owner says she's too afraid to go.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In the exciting season finale, TAPS travels to the site where Hindenburg, one of history's most infamous disasters, took place. The Hindenburg was a German airship filled with hydrogen for buoyancy. In 1937, while trying to dock at the Lakehurst Naval base, it caught fire and killed 36 people. The entire ordeal was caught on film and is still one of the most famous tragedies that have ever been reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the 100th episode of Ghost Hunters, the team is allowed private access to Alcatraz Island, a dream come true for paranormal teams. From a two day prison revolt in 1946 known as the Battle of Alcatraz that occurred, people say they can still hear gun fire and crying. In Cell Block D, otherwise known as solitary confinement, there is a report of a run in with a spirit. Other activity reported is that of an apparition of a prisoner with glaring red eyes, and the sound of screams.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Fort Ticonderoga, located in upstate New York, is being haunted by the dead from three nations and needs help from the TAPS team. The fort was built in 1755 by the French army, and would be witness to several bloody battles over the next two decades. The British army suffered 2,000 casualties; it was the most devastating battle on American soil until the Civil War. Due largely to the amount of violence and death that took place, there is lots of paranormal activity reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team has been asked to go to Paddy Reilly's Bar in Manhattan, New York to help explain some after hours activity. Dark shadows have been seen in the basement, voices have been heard, glasses are known to move on their own, and bottles break for no apparent reason. In an upstairs apartment, three men saw an apparition riding a bike, and across the hall a tenant saw a man resembling Gene Hackman peering through a window.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team visits the Absecon Lighthouse in Atlantic City, NJ. This lighthouse has activity reported ranging from untraceable footsteps and doors opening spontaneously, to coughing coming from the keeper's quarters. In the lighthouse itself, people have reported smelling cigar smoke, hearing voices and laughter, and even seeing a persons hand.Jason and Grant start out in the tower, where they hear a possible conversation and footsteps.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to The Southern Mansion in Cape May, NJ, and have enlisted the help of Dave Tango's father, Bruce. Bruce has experienced first hand some of the reported activity here; some of it includes glasses dissolving into sand, people being grabbed, a soldier walking through walls, a soldier talking with a woman, and the smell of gardenias. It is believed that the ghost woman could possibly be the niece of the original owner, Esther.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters the TAPS team investigates Preston Castle, a once notorious reform school for boys in Northern California. People have seen apparitions of a man in a white coat in the doctor's office. The infirmary seems to be haunted by a boy that was shot while trying to escape the school. Upstairs there are claims of humming noises, groups of voices, a mist and a woman who claims she was pinched on the butt.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been called to the Grzelak house in Massachusetts where they have been experiencing paranormal activity since the day they moved in 30 years ago. A series of apparitions, shadow people, mysterious voices and even physical attacks have left the Grzelaks desperate for help, to the point where they want to move.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called to Cape Cod to investigate the Orleans Inn. Some of the claims here are that candles light on their own, glasses slide off tables, hauntings by two separate men who hung themselves, doors opening and closing, and ghosts of naked women. Despite all this, the strangest claim comes from Room 5, where two separate guests have checked in and been driven to insanity inside the room.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the home of the Scully family, who are so terrified they are ready to pack up and move. Some of the activities reported in the house are confrontational shadows, spirits breathing down people's necks and, adult legs walking up the stairs. The greatest activity is in the 4-year-old son's bedroom, where he spends his time with the spirits of 2 small children, and talks to them as well as about them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal team to be invited to investigate Norwich State Hospital, in Norwich, Connecticut. There have been lots of rumors of activity, including moving shadows, haunting faces, screams, moans, and apparitions of children. Excited to start investigating, Jason and Grant start out in the research building and right away they see a moving shadow followed by a strange noise, and faint light in the stairway.

programme.title: She Never Came Home
programme.desc: However shocking the crime, media headlines eventually fade, but for heartbroken friends and family, the memories and their longing for justice never do. Cold Case Files? produced by the team behind Investigative ReportsTM, digs deep into the past, following detectives as they strive to breathe new life into "cold" unsolved crimes. Armed with the latest DNA technology and with dogged determination, investigators seek new leads in hopes of bringing the guilty to justice decades after the crimes have been committed. Whether it's a man who was initially a prime suspect in his son's death, watching as the police begin to suspect his wife or the gruesome shooting of an elderly couple whose bodies were found in the woods, each episode features a different cold case.

Cold Case Files? produced by the team behind Investigative ReportsTM, digs deep into the past, following detectives as they strive to breathe new life into "cold" unsolved crimes. Armed with the latest DNA technology and with dogged determination, investigators seek new leads in hopes of bringing the guilty to justice decades after the crimes have been committed. Whether it's a man who was initially a prime suspect in his son's death, watching as the police begin to suspect his wife or the gruesome shooting of an elderly couple whose bodies were found in the woods, each episode features a different cold case.

programme.title: Palm Beach 2023 Day 1 Part 1
programme.desc: For nearly 50 years, enthusiasts from all over the world have flocked to the Barrett-Jackson collector car auctions, named America's No. 1 Attraction for Car Lovers in the 2019 USA Today Readers? Choice Contest. Widely regarded as a barometer of the collector car industry, the auctions have evolved over the years into world-class automotive lifestyle events where thousands of the world's most sought-after, unique and valuable automobiles cross the block in front of a global audience-- in person and on live national and international television.
